Caesar's Backstory : Caesar lost her mother to illness at a young age, and her father is a leader of Calydon gang but mysteriously disappeared. She was taken in by Big Daddy, the former leader of the Sons of Calydon, who raised her as his own. He instilled in her a sense of freedom, toughness, and independence. Her name, “Caesar King,” hints at a legacy of power her father once had great ambitions, and his influence still lingers across the Outer Ring.

Under Big Daddy’s guidance, Caesar grew up immersed in the gang lifestyle., she naturally rose to lead the Sons of Calydon, inheriting their rebellious motto: “I come, I see, I crash.” She commands respect with a calm, authoritative demeanor, but remains open-minded—always willing to listen to ideas, regardless of who offers them. In combat, she rides her bike into Hollows wielding a massive sword and spiked shield, showcasing both strength and flair.

Major Turning Point: Tour de Inferno
The defining moment of Caesar King’s leadership came during the Tour de Inferno, a dangerous motorcycle rally that reached the edge of Cinderglow Lake. This event was both a deadly race and a crucial ritual to contain the Ether corruption in the region by safely disposing of the Sparkstone.

Before Caesar’s rise, the Motor League was led by Pompey, a strong and respected Overlord. However, during the Tour, Pompey was betrayed by members of his own gang, led by his second-in-command, Lucius. They secretly gave him a corrupted drink laced with Ether-tainted energy.

This betrayal caused Pompey to become severely Ether-corrupted, transforming him into a monstrous Ethereal creature that threatened everyone present. His mind and body twisted by the Ether, Pompey became a danger to his own people and the entire Outer Ring.

Caesar was forced into a brutal confrontation with this corrupted Pompey. Despite his overwhelming power, she fought fiercely. Realizing that the only way to save Cinderglow Lake and stop the growing Ether threat was to complete the ritual herself, Caesar made a heroic sacrifice.

She rode her motorcycle straight into the heart of a volcano, echoing the sacrifice of legendary heroes before her, and hurled the Sparkstone into the molten lava to neutralize the Ether energy and prevent an environmental disaster.

Though the explosion nearly claimed her life, Caesar miraculously survived, emerging battered but unbroken. This act not only saved the region but also established her as the new Overlord of the Othering, inheriting Pompey’s mantle and leading her gang into a new era.

Idiot Hero: She isn't Dumb Muscle, but doesn't quite get things about logistics and business until Lucy explains them, has a tendency to mispronounce or misuse metaphors, is very prone to typos while texting, and is overall a headstrong young woman who tends to act before she thinks things out. It's to the point that during a Trust Event with Piper where she considers modifying Steeltusk, what makes her second-guess herself isn't just that everyone else told her it was a bad idea, but also that Caesar specifically was giving her the thumbs-up. This also gets her slapped by an enraged Lucy when she thoughtlessly tells her she could lead the gang if she died, right after nearly dying by jumping into a lake of lava and reducing the poor girl to a bawling mess.

Kindhearted Simpleton: She's a caring leader who's savvy enough to take crap from no one, but she's still more than a little bit dim. For example, Lucy recounts a time when Caesar mistook high quality coffee for bitter cola.

Lucy (Luciana Auxesis Theodoro de Montefio) – Backstory
Luciana Auxesis Theodoro de Montefio, better known as Lucy, was born into the prestigious and powerful Montefio family of New Eridu. The family is known for its wealth, influence, and longstanding social status. From a young age, Lucy was groomed to carry on the family's legacy—receiving elite education, training in etiquette, and even piano lessons to uphold the Montefio name.

However, Lucy was never content with the suffocating life of privilege. What she truly longed for was freedom—freedom from expectations, control, and the emotional confinement she endured at home. Her desire to become a Hollow Investigator was outright denied by her family, who instead imposed further isolation, verbal pressure, and emotional manipulation. This harsh treatment became the catalyst for her eventual rebellion.

Refusing to live a life dictated by her lineage, Lucy faked her own kidnapping to escape. But the plan took an unexpected turn when Caesar King, leader of the Sons of Calydon, unintentionally thwarted the fake abduction and rescued her. Moved by Caesar’s presence and decisiveness, Lucy chose to abandon her family name and instead join the faction as an A-Rank agent.

Now known simply as Lucy, she embraces her new identity as the Boar Thiren Overseer of the Sons of Calydon's logistics front—Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co. She commands a trio of boar companions named Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and handles the faction’s field operations with pride.

Despite being labeled a missing person by her family—and a sizable reward being offered for her return—Lucy rarely sets foot in New Eridu. Though her father knows where she is, he believes she will return in time, having himself once gone through a similar rebellious phase.

Currently residing in the Outer Ring, Lucy often challenges Caesar King to duels, vowing to one day claim leadership of the Outer Ring. Yet beneath her fiery ambition and tsundere demeanor lies a complicated affection for Caesarone she would never admit aloud, though it occasionally surfaces when she’s caught off guard or flustered.

Despite belonging to an extremely wealthy family where everything was laid out for her and provided — from a proper education to piano lessons — the one thing Lucy truly desired was the freedom to live her life as she pleased.

After taking an Ether Aptitude Test that came back remarkably high, she expressed her wish to become a Hollow Investigator. Instead of encouragement, she was met with refusal, harsh words, isolation, and emotional abuse from her family. This treatment solidified her decision to leave and pursue her own freedom.

Lucy devised a plan to stage her own kidnapping, hoping it would provide the opportunity she needed to escape her oppressive environment. However, the plan did not go as intended. Caesar King of the Sons of Calydon unknowingly interrupted the fake abduction, defeating the faux kidnappers and unintentionally “rescuing” her.

Moved by Caesar's strength and presence, Lucy decided then and there to leave her past behind and pledged herself to the Sons of Calydon, vowing to become a fully-fledged member of the faction.

To run away from home, she hired some "kidnappers" and devised a kidnapping for herself. Yet, this plan was accidentally screwed up by the Sons of Calydon — Caesar defeated all the "kidnappers" and saved their "victim."
According to eye-witness testimony, the sight of Caesar crashing straight through the door on her ride with the sunlight behind her left quite the impression on Lucy.
"That was when I saw it — freedom."

Lucy and Caesar  Rivalry, Respect, and Hidden Emotion
Among Caesar’s closest and most complicated relationships is her bond with Lucy (Luciana de Montefio)  the tsundere firebrand who defected from a noble family to join the Sons of Calydon.

Though Lucy openly respects Caesar’s strength and leadership, their connection is characterized by a playful rivalry. Lucy often teases Caesar, calls her a “goof” or “idiot,” and challenges her decisions with sharp remarks — masking admiration with sarcasm. The tension between them is laced with affection, especially during private moments where their shared history surfaces  such as playing the piano together, a rare glimpse into their emotional closeness.

Despite her brash exterior, Lucy shows deep concern for Caesar in subtle ways defending her from criticism, supporting her behind the scenes, or growing visibly distressed during dangerous missions. One poignant example was during the Tour de Inferno, where Lucy was shaken at the thought of Caesar sacrificing herself.

Their dynamic is a delicate dance of banter and buried feelings, with Caesar’s straightforwardness clashing against Lucy’s tsundere deflections. Still, there's an undeniable bond between them  one forged in loyalty, challenge, music, and unspoken care.

This reckless behavior is part of her carefree and wild personality but also shows she’s confident in controlling her flames — though it can be dangerous.

Lucy, being more serious and cautious, gets visibly upset or worried when Burnice starts “playing with fire.” She sees it as reckless and irresponsible, especially if it risks drawing unwanted attention or causing trouble.

There are in-game dialogues and cutscenes where Lucy scolds Burnice, telling her to stop messing around or be careful. For example, Lucy might say things like:

“Burnice, put that out before someone gets hurt!”
“You really don’t think before you act, do you?”
“One of these days, your fire tricks will get you burned  literally!”

Burnice usually brushes off the warnings with a grin or playful tease, which only makes Lucy more frustrated.

name : Lighter 
Gender : male 

Appearance : 
Height : 185 cm , Lighter possesses a tall and muscular build, reflecting his role as the gang's formidable "Champion."
Hair: He sports ruffled green hair, adding a distinctive flair to his rugged look
Attire:
Jacket: Lighter wears a striking biker jacket adorned with spikes, emphasizing his tough persona.
Jeans: He pairs his jacket with jeans, maintaining the classic biker aesthetic.
Red Scarf: A notable accessory is his red scarf, symbolizing his status as the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.

Personality : 
Calm & Composed
Lighter is known for his cool-headed demeanor, often serving as a stabilizing force within the Sons of Calydon. Unlike some of the more impulsive or fiery members of the gang, he maintains a collected and measured approach to both combat and conversations.

Loyal & Respectful
His deep loyalty to Big Daddy, the founder of the Sons of Calydon, is a defining part of his story. He joined the gang out of respect and a sense of debt toward Big Daddy, which also speaks to his sense of honor and gratitude.

Reliable & Grounded
Lighter often acts as the reliable older brother type in the gang — someone others can depend on. While not overly talkative or flashy, his presence commands quiet respect.

Subtle but Strong-Willed
Though not as loud or brash as some of his companions, Lighter has a strong sense of justice and personal conviction. He prefers action over words and lets his strength speak for itself.

Serious but Caring
While his serious exterior may make him seem distant, he’s actually protective of his allies and cares deeply about the well-being of the team. His softer side comes through in moments of camaraderie and teamwork.

Backstory : Lighter, known as the "Red Scarf" and the Champion of the Sons of Calydon, is an incredibly skilled and experienced fighter whose reputation precedes him. Before joining the Sons of Calydon, Lighter led a mercenary company alongside three close comrades: Dane Driscoll, Nick Carmine, and Ratena Katherine. This group was more than just a team—they formed a surrogate family. Lighter grew close not only to his comrades but also to their families, building deep bonds. However, during a mission that went beyond their capabilities, Lighter made a critical misjudgment that resulted in the deaths of all his companions. He was the sole survivor of the group, burdened with profound guilt and regret.

Despite his overwhelming grief, Lighter refused to give up. Instead, he took on the responsibility of supporting the families of his fallen comrades. To do this, he incurred a substantial debt by borrowing money from a loan shark. When he was unable to repay this debt, Lighter was forced into the underground fighting circuits to "work off" what he owed. During this period, Lighter fought in brutal matches, often describing his state as being "like a zombie," mechanically going from one opponent to the next without pause. One notable rival during this time was Bellum, a fighter whose twenty-win streak was broken by Lighter, earning Bellum’s lasting respect and rivalry.

Lighter is an exceptionally strong fighter, wielding a custom engine-powered gauntlet that enhances his already formidable physical power. His role within the Sons of Calydon involves challenging and fighting champions from rival biker gangs, a task he excels at, maintaining an undefeated record in these battles. Despite his strength and combat skill, Lighter has a personal vulnerability: he suffers from hemophobia, the fear of blood. The mere sight of blood can cause him to faint. To manage this weakness, he always wears sunglasses, which also serve to protect an old eye injury sustained during his mercenary days.

Lighter's fortunes changed when Big Daddy, the leader of the Sons of Calydon, took notice of his fighting prowess and reputation. Big Daddy paid off Lighter’s debt and invited him to join the gang. Initially, Lighter viewed the gang as just another competitive fighting circuit, but over time, he developed a strong bond with the members of the Sons of Calydon. He grew to genuinely care for them, seeing them as a new family that he wanted to protect and never lose anyone from again. Among the members was Billy Kid, the gang’s previous Champion and holder of the Red Scarf before Lighter. Despite Billy having left the gang, Lighter still refers to him affectionately as his brother and predecessor, showing a deep respect for the man who came before him.

Lighter's story is one of tragedy, guilt, redemption, and loyalty. From a mercenary leader who lost everything and fell into the underground fighting world, to becoming the undefeated Champion of a powerful biker gang, he embodies resilience and dedication. His calm and collected demeanor, paired with his unwavering loyalty to the Sons of Calydon, makes him a respected and reliable pillar within the gang. His motivations are deeply rooted in protecting his newfound family and making amends for the losses of his past.

Lucy and Lighter share a relationship grounded in mutual respect, camaraderie, and a shared commitment to the Sons of Calydon. While they don’t have as much direct personal history or emotional complexity as Lucy has with Caesar King, their connection is built on trust forged through their roles within the gang.

Relationship : 
Lucy respects Lighter’s skill as the undefeated Champion and recognizes his strength and dedication to protecting their faction. Lighter, in turn, values Lucy’s sharp mind, determination, and fiery personality. Both understand the hardships they’ve faced individually—Lucy’s struggles with her family and desire for freedom, and Lighter’s tragic past as a mercenary burdened by loss and guilt—which creates an unspoken bond between them rooted in perseverance and loyalty.

Their interactions are often professional but with an underlying tone of support; Lucy may occasionally tease or challenge Lighter in typical gang banter, but she appreciates his steady presence and fighting prowess. Lighter sees Lucy as a valuable ally in the Outer Ring’s chaotic environment and trusts her capabilities and leadership qualities when working together on missions or gang matters.

Overall, their relationship reflects a strong partnership founded on respect, shared goals, and the unbreakable loyalty that defines the Sons of Calydon.

Name : Piper Wheel
Gender : Female 

Appearance

Piper is a petite and youthful-looking individual she have c cup, often appearing much younger than she actually is. Her attire typically includes a cropped top, utility belt, and gloves, reflecting her practical role within the gang. She is frequently seen with her beloved truck, Steeltusk, emphasizing her connection to vehicle maintenance and transportation

Personality 
Piper comes across as laid-back and calm, often using old-fashioned expressions that give her a unique charm. She treats others with a bit of affectionate teasing, calling them “young 'uns.” Despite her relaxed demeanor, she is determined and reliable, showing strong dedication to her responsibilities and the people around her. Piper enjoys simple pleasures like reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines. These hobbies reflect her nostalgic and somewhat old-soul nature, adding depth to her character.
Her past experiences have shaped her into a resilient and dependable person, carrying a quiet weight behind her seemingly carefree exterior.

Backstory : 
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.
Piper has a love for the sound of truck engines starting up, so she recorded the sound of Steeltusk starting up. She has to listen to the recording to fully wake up in the morning.
If Piper falls asleep during a meeting, playing a recording of a truck engine can quickly get her wide awake again (this intel was provided by Lucy).

Relationship
Lucy and Piper in Zenless Zone Zero share a relationship built on mutual respect, camaraderie, and some friendly tension typical of close teammates within the Sons of Calydon faction. While Lucy has a tsundere personality—often acting blunt, teasing, or cold—she secretly cares deeply for those close to her, including Piper. Piper, being more laid-back and older in demeanor, often takes on a somewhat nurturing or elder-sibling role within the group, which contrasts with Lucy's more sharp and independent vibe.

In gameplay and story events, their relationship shows a balance between rivalry and support. For example, in the event "Reason for Anger," Piper seeks to apologize to Lucy for an incident, highlighting their ability to resolve conflicts maturely. They also work effectively together, with Lucy’s support abilities complementing Piper’s combat style, symbolizing their teamwork.

Overall, their bond combines professional synergy, occasional playful banter, and genuine concern—showing both characters respect and care for each other beneath the surface of their contrasting personalities.

Name : Pulchra Fellini
Gender : Female
Height : 173cm 
Species : Thiren (Cat)


Appearance : Pulchra Fellini is a feline Thiren standing about 173 cm (5'8") tall. She has distinct cat-like features including pointed ears and a tail, along with sharp claws that emphasize her animalistic traits. strong biker aesthetic, wearing a practical yet stylish outfit suited for combat and mobility. This includes a utility belt and dual bladeguns, reinforcing her mercenary background and readiness for battle. The combination of her sleek, agile build and tough attire gives her a fierce, confident presence on the field.

Personality : 
Pulchra Fellini’s personality is defined by pragmatism, independence, and a strong sense of self-interest. She approaches relationships transactionally, often stating that her loyalty lies with whoever is winning at the moment—usually herself. Raised in hardship, she’s self-reliant and opportunistic, shaped by a past betrayal that left her with a large debt. Though she may come off as cold or distant, she tolerates her fellow gang members, especially Burnice, whose overly affectionate nature contrasts with Pulchra’s more reserved attitude. Over time, she has developed a grudging respect and values the camaraderie within the Sons of Calydon, even if she keeps an emotional distance. Overall, she is tough, cautious, and pragmatic but capable of growth and deeper connections.


Backstory : Pulchra Fellini is an Outer Ring mercenary from one of the poorest towns in the wilds, raised alongside her only friend, Milena. The two often played games pretending to live in the city, imagining themselves as waiters and customers. Despite their dreams, their notable Ether aptitudes led them to become mercenaries. Milena later suggested they start their own group, appointing Pulchra as leader and using her bank account to fund it. However, Pulchra was betrayed when Milena stole all their funds to start a new life in the city, knocking Pulchra out and leaving her with a massive debt. Pulchra then returned to being a mercenary focused solely on personal gain, putting bonds and trust aside.

Pulchra was hired by Lucius of The Vanquishers, a rival gang, to sabotage the Sons of Calydon by acquiring parts they ordered. Pretending to be a member of the Sons, she set explosives to ambush them. Although she managed to catch Burnice White in the blast, she was surprised by Burnice’s eccentric personality, which allowed the Sons to regroup and confront her. Impressed by their strength, Pulchra surrendered and offered to hand over the parts in exchange for silence. Burnice invited her to join the Sons of Calydon, but Pulchra declined, waiting to see if they were truly the strongest gang.

Later, Pulchra again clashed with the Sons when she helped a Vanquishers faction steal Red Moccus. After another battle, she surrendered and abandoned the Vanquishers, concluding that the Sons of Calydon were the strongest. Following Caesar King’s rise as Overlord, Pulchra, struggling with unstable income and few job offers, saw an opportunity and agreed to join the Sons as an intelligence gatherer. Though her past conflicts with them were forgiven, she was placed on probation and given errands, which served as a trial and a way to integrate her into the gang. While she often finds the members foolish, she values having friends again.

In combat, Pulchra wields a pair of “Bladeguns” — revolvers with blades on their grips — along with gadgets like stun grenades, explosives, and reflex-enhancing tonics. She wears a specialized respirator mask that blocks out Ether particles and pollen and protects her from others’ gazes, rarely removing it even in public areas like New Eridu.

Pulchra maintains a pragmatic, self-serving attitude and tolerates her fellow gang members, especially Burnice White, whose overly affectionate and sometimes oblivious nature often clashes with Pulchra’s colder demeanor. Despite her emotional distance and seemingly detached personality, Pulchra’s evolving relationship with the Sons of Calydon hints at a capacity for growth and deeper connections beyond her mercenary roots.

entries.name: Bangboo
entries.content:
Bangboo are small, rabbit-like robots. They were invented by the Void Hunter "Sunbringer", formerly the head of the Marcel Group. Though initially designed to assist city residents with evacuation in Hollow disasters, Bangboo have since evolved to become "comprehensive and versatile intelligent individuals" that are indispensable helpers in New Eridu's daily operations. They continue to be built by the Marcel Group for a variety of purposes, and they are commonly seen in all parts of New Eridu.

Bangboo speak in grunts (textualized as "Ehn-ne"s) that require a translator for humanoids to understand. Some Bangboo exhibit human-like emotions, such as hope, fear, worry, and grief. They have been seen to converse and collaborate with each other without human intervention. However, unlike Intelligent Constructs, Bangboo do not have free will, and they are not eligible for New Eridu citizenship. Bangboo without masters are legally required to be scrapped.

Bangboo are mechanical in nature and require charging. Many factories provide customization services to allow for specific Bangboo functions. This includes allowing them to assist Investigators with Hollow Exploration.

Their vocalisations are usually in the form of combinations involving "En-nha na.", "Nu-nah en." or "Nu-nah uhn."

Most Bangboo are short and stout, only around knee-height. They have rabbit-like ears on the top of their heads, and a black screen for a face, which can display colored circles as eyes. Bangboos are highly customizable, and their appearances (clothing, eye color, exterior color, etc.) can vary greatly. Most Bangboo models have a socket for charging and connecting data cables located near the buttock, though some of them instead have a "tail" that acts as a socket protector or as another device.

Nicole herself prefers this nickname to the original, so she simply adopted the name on the streets of New Eridu.

The members are: Anby Demara, Billy Kid, Nekomiya Mana, Nicole Demara.

Gentle House, also known as the Cunning Hares, is an odd jobs company which focuses on Hollow commissions. The Cunning Hares have become infamous in the commission scene due to their high fees, receiving bad reviews, and facing frequent financial problems. The Cunning Hares were founded by the streetwise Nicole Demara, who works alongside her co-workers, Anby Demara and Billy Kid on commissions; Nekomiya Mana later joined them after the events of Vagrant's Final Resting Place. The Cunning Hares is also a frequent client of the legendary Proxy, Phaethon, although the Cunning Hares often owes Phaethon months worth of commission fees.

entries.name: Hollows
entries.content:
Hollows are supernatural disasters. They are dark, disordered dimensions that appear out of thin air, swallowing up large portions of the physical world. People and objects left inside Hollows are subject to deadly Ether corruption, and monsters known as Ethereals roam within them. Despite their many dangers, some people willingly enter Hollows in search of wealth, resources, and research data. Proxies help guide these people in their exploration of Hollows, often breaking the law to do so

Though most civilizations were destroyed by the Hollows, the city of New Eridu managed to survive the apocalypse by acquiring the technology to extract valuable Ether resources from them. Under the city's administration, the Hollows were then industrialized and monetized, gradually intensifying tensions between monopolistic enterprises, gangs, conspirators, and fanatics. Though Eridu was eventually consumed by Hollow Zero, its survivors rebuilt in what would become the city of New Eridu.

Hollows are characterized by their black, spherical appearances. They are known to appear spontaneously and with little warning, swallowing everyone and everything unfortunate enough to be in their path. Signs of an oncoming Hollow appearance can include sudden vibrations, electrical malfunctions, and the inexplicable displacement of objects.

Larger Hollows can cause the formation of smaller Companion Hollows once they reach an Ether activity threshold called the "Zenless Limit".

Ethereals: Once they have spawned, Hollows begin to create Ether-based monsters known as Ethereals. Although Ethereals have not been known to leave their Hollows, they still pose a serious threat to anyone within. Hollows are sustained by Ether energy, which is directly linked to the Ethereals residing within them. It is possible to reduce the size of a Hollow by destroying a massive number of regular Ethereals, or by eliminating a particularly large one. If continuously suppressed, a Hollow may even gradually shrink until it disappears.

Corruption: While inside a Hollow, both living and non-living beings are subject to gradual Ether corruption. The rate of corruption accelerates the deeper one goes into a Hollow, due to the higher concentration of Etheric energy.

Humans and humanoids who stay inside Hollows too long are eventually afflicted with Ether corruption. Corruption causes rapid mutations in a person's physiology, including the growth of dark, painful crystals throughout their body; the formation of a distinctive Ether "core"; and a gradual loss of sanity. Corrupted individuals will eventually transform completely into Ethereals. There is no known cure for Ether corruption, with current treatments only able to reverse mild cases. Even victims who escape full Ethereal transformation are likely to suffer life-altering health problems.

Individuals are corrupted at rates relative to their Ether aptitude. Those with high Ether aptitude can stay in Hollows unprotected for longer periods of time without suffering the effects of corruption. Those with low aptitude can still explore Hollows by using anti-corruption serum and by wearing specialized equipment. Anti-corruption gear is commonly used by New Eridu Public Security, the Hollow Investigative Association, the New Eridu Defense Force, and bandits.

Both intelligent and non-intelligent machines can be corrupted, though their natural Ether resistance is higher.

Environment: The once-ordinary interiors of Hollows are drastically altered by Ether, turning them into mazes of distorted environments. Within Hollows, normal rules don't apply; a seemingly-straightforward path could be riddled with invisible fissures and blockages, while what looks like a dead end could contain a portal out of the Hollow. Some Hollows even seem to be interconnected — passing through a fissure in one Hollow may lead one into an entirely different Hollow.[8] Communication with the outside world is nearly impossible from within a Hollow, with only the legendary proxy Phaethon being able to reliably do so.[9]

Hollows are naturally complex places, and being careless can lead to death for inexperienced and experienced explorers alike. To safely explore Hollows, many explorers use Bangboo, small robots equipped with Carrot programs. These programs create maps of Hollows that can guide explorers along safer routes, minimize their time spent in the Hollow and help avoid dangerous Ethereals.

Dangers: According to the New Eridu City Administration, there are various dangers one can encounter while in a Hollow:

1. Ethereals: mutant monsters that attack all foreign living creatures.
2. Ether: a substance that is as ubiquitous as air, with great energy potential but deadly corruptive effects.
3. The Corrupted: Individuals can become corrupted by the aforementioned Ether, slowly mutating and losing their conscious thoughts.
4. Lawless Thugs: Criminals who seek to rob other explorers for profit.
5. Hollow Raiders, Proxies, and other unsanctioned explorers.

entries.name: New Eridu
entries.content: New Eridu is the last surviving city in Zenless Zone Zero, after contemporary civilization was destroyed by the Hollows. New Eridu managed to survive and thrive after the apocalypse by acquiring the technology to be able to extract resources out of the Hollows. Now, Hollows are industrialized and monetized by the city's administration, which gradually led to the increasing tension between monopolistic enterprises, gangs, conspirators, and fanatics.

entries.name: New Eridu City Adminstration
entries.content: The New Eridu City Administration is the government of New Eridu and a faction in New Eridu. They seem to have control over the Hollow Investigative Association, and don't seem to be on good terms with the Hollow Raiders or the Proxies, considering them to be hopeless.

entries.name: OBOLS Squad
entries.content: OBOLS Squad is a faction in New Eridu. It is tied to New Eridu Defense Force Osidian Division and Defense Force Sergeant Soldier 11 is the head of the squad.

entries.name: Phaethon
entries.content:
"Phaethon" is a well-known Proxy in New Eridu referring to Wise and Belle acting together as one Proxy.

Wise and Belle utilize their exclusive Hollow Deep Dive System, a device they are said to have constructed from ancient technology found in the Hollows. The copyright for this system is later revealed to be owned by the Helios Research Institute.

Using the H.D.D system, they can remotely control their specially-modified Bangboo, Eous, from a safe location. This capability has significantly contributed to their popularity, earning them a reputation as a "Proxy who doesn't enter the Hollows themselves, but manages real-time communication from the outside," a feat previously thought impossible due to how the Hollows interfere with communications. Additionally, by controlling Eous from the outside, they can update their Hollow data in real-time, ensuring that the "Carrot" (Hollow map) doesn't become obsolete while their clients are inside the Hollow. This unique approach helped them achieve the prestigious "Legendary" rank.

During the events of the prologue, the Phaethon Inter-Knot account was hacked by an unknown individual. Left with no other choice, Wise and Belle handed over the account information to Public Security, also losing a large portion of their collected Hollow Data in the process. Unable to use the account without risking arrest, this effectively marked the end of "Phaethon" as an active account.

Despite the Phaethon account no longer being accessible, Wise and Belle's reputation endured. Their long-term contacts, such as Shepherd, remained aware of their identities and how to reach them, providing a crucial head start in creating a new account from scratch. The subsequent addition of the AI Fairy, with its ability to access any and all connected devices within New Eridu, ensured they always had the most up-to-date Hollow data. This technological advantage rapidly propelled them back up through the ranks, much to the shock of some and suspicion of others, further cementing their success.

entries.name: Proxies
entries.content: Proxies are individuals who guide those who enter the Hollows. There also exists an organization called Proxy Network which is related to the proxies but no further information has been given about it.

entries.name: Proxy Network
entries.content: Proxy Network — The Proxy Network, also known as "INTER-KNOT", is a social media organization in New Eridu which assists individuals in finding Proxies to guide them through the hollows.

entries.name: Section 6
entries.content:
Hollow Special Operations Section 6, abbreviated as H.S.O.S.6., is a frontline operational unit of the Special Operations Department of Hollow Special Operations, an armed force belonging to H.A.N.D..

Hollow Special Operations is H.A.N.D.'s armed force dedicated to the response to Hollow disasters. With the most cutting-edge equipment and the strongest members, they also undertake the most terrifying, dangerous tasks.
They can be found in high-risk Hollow-related events and highly sensitive missions involving H.A.N.D.

Section 6 is one of the newly established frontline operational units of the Special Operations Department. Like other disciplined units under H.A.N.D., Section 6 is made up of a number of highly talented individuals. However, with Miyabi at its core, Section 6 is unique in every sense of the word.

Hollow Special Operations Section 6 (or just Section 6) is the most recently established unit of H.S.O, the armed subsidiary of H.A.N.D. Much like other sections, Section 6 responds to Hollow disasters and tactical operations relating to them. Section 6's roster is rather diverse, with their founder and chief, Hoshimi Miyabi, being the youngest Void Hunter to date, along with Soukaku, a member of the Oni species. Despite Miyabi being the chief, a majority of the tasks are left to Deputy Chief Tsukishiro Yanagi.

Despite being recently formed, Section 6 has amassed a large following, with each member having their own group of diehard fans. They also have a workplace rivalry with Section 5.

entries.name: Corrupted
entries.content:
The Corrupted are individuals who have become corrupted and mutated by the Unknown Substance (Ether) inside the Hollows. Those with low Ether Aptitude are for more likely to become corrupt. The Corrupted are dangerous to non-corrupted individuals. Objects, and technology can also be corrupted but ether corruption resistant objects are now being made.

The process of corruption involves:  Loss of sanity, crystals forming on the body or object, a black-hole like core forms, usually near the head of a being before fully transforming into an ethereal, with no trace of the original body left.

Once swallowed, both non-living and living beings inside the Hollow will be subject to Corruption. Non-living objects will form Ether crystals. The deeper the part of the Hollow, the higher the concentration of Etheric energy in that place, which can accelerate the corruption and increases Pressure.

For humans, the time before corruption takes a toll on their body depends on their Ether Aptitude and equipment. Some people have high Ether aptitude, allowing them to explore Hollows for extended periods without suffering the effects of Corruption. Those with low aptitude can still explore Hollows by wearing Anti-Ether Corruption equipment, which is commonly used by PUBSEC officers, Jaegers soldiers, and thugs. If a human is corrupted, they will turn into an Ethereal.

Intelligent machines can also be corrupted if they have passed the Forbidden Fruit test.

entries.name: Unknown Substance
entries.content: The Unknown Substance (official name unknown) is a substance found in the Hollows that is as ubiquitous as air. It holds great potential as a resource but is also mysteriously corruptive. Individuals can become corrupted by this substance, gradually turning into The Corrupted.

entries.name: Victoria House Keeping
entries.content:
Victoria Housekeeping Co. is a human resource dispatch agency and a faction in New Eridu.

Usually takes commissions from those with high net worth in new eridu and is lesser known amongst the general public.

Description: "Thank you for using us. Your wish is our command.

Known for an (excessively) wide range of high-quality services.

The team has the persona of old-school domestic helpers from the old civilization, but each with their own unique twists.

Despite some accidents cause by being "overzealous," Victoria Housekeeping Co. has no shortage of clients. After all, with fortune, trouble is sure to follow, and a team of reliable attendants who can clean both a hall and a Hollow is extremely valuable."

The members include: Alexandrina Sebastiane, Corin Wickes, Ellen Joe, Von Lycaon.

Members of the Victoria Housekeeping appears to be based on western horror elements in addition to housekeepers
Corin - Frankenstein and mechanically powered saw
Ellen - Sharks (e.g. Jaws series) and huge scissors
Lycaon - Werewolf
Rina - Ghost and haunted dolls/puppets

Victoria Housekeeping Co. is a servant company with a small amount of members that specializes in various services[Note 1], notably household chores; like cleaning, cooking and yardwork, to security management and item acquisition . Victoria Housekeeping Co.'s leader is the mayor of New Eridu and member of the Mayflower Family, Von Lycaon serves as its substantive leader and representative, whilst Alexandrina Sebastiane is its most senior member.

At the end of The Midnight Pursuit (B), it is revealed that Von Lycaon and Rina were aware of the conspiracy surrounding the Unknown Corruption Complex, and Phaethon's knowledge of it. They had been ordered by their master to spy on the siblings from afar and provide them with assistance as needed. In Bury Your Tears With the Past (A), Victoria Housekeeping aid the proxy siblings (Phaethon) by giving them an upgrade of their HDD system, courtesy of Mayflower. In truth the "Master" of this company is the head of the Mayflower family and the mayor of New Eridu.

entries.name: W-Engine
entries.content: A combat device that can empower ether weapons (not just ether weapons). Constantly being improved. Comes in many versions with various effects. They can be tailor made to suit the user's needs. They can further be enhanced using drive discs.

entries.name: Red Fang Gang
entries.content: A group of thugs / gangsters in new Eridu. They originally started as a group that helped the less fortunate, as well as taking in orphans but they became corrupt over time. Their leader was Miguel Silver.

entries.name: Miguel Silver
entries.content: The deceased leader of the Silver Tears in the Red Fang Gang, the man who helped raise Nekomiya Mana / Nekomata. He cried a lot for some reason. He gotten into a clash with the Cunning Hares and fell into a hollow, due to his low ether aptitude he quickly became corrupted, turning into an Ethereal and was defeated.

entries.name: THE NEWS
entries.content: The News is a New Eridu magazine, bringing the citizens a look of the city from various perspectives, with the hope of bringing people a fresh reading experience among the booming mass media in New Eridu.

entries.name: Starlight Knight
entries.content: An action movie in New Eridu inspired by things from the old civilisation (such as power rangers / super sentai and kamen rider). It tells the story of the Starlight Knights, heroes who fight all kinds of monsters to protect the city. It's widely popular and has a lot of merch.

entries.name: Oh~ Sweetie
entries.content:
A romcom movie in New Eridu that tells the tale of a beautiful girl (Monica) who has lost her memory. She encounters a déjà vu-style romance in a strange city... "Oh Monica, when the streetlights light up again,
will you still remember me?"

Monica is a famous actress most well known for her role in the late night drama "Oh~ Sweetie", where she plays the main character. Not much is known about her role, other than that she plays a beautiful lady who has lost her memories and lives in a strange city. Billy Kid is a big fan of her, admitting to his teammate Anby Demara that he would most like to go out to dinner with her in order to convince her that he was the real Billy. Additionally, a post on Inter-Knot reveals that she also does work as a singer, but is noted to be very bad at it.

entries.name: Coffee Mate
entries.content: A romcom movie in New Eridu. A coffee machine by the name of Mr. Rob suddenly falls in love with a beautiful customer, Angelina, for a unique story of cross-species romance.

entries.name: The Big Hollow
entries.content:
A movie in New Eridu, it's a documentary, thriller and tragedy. An intern Hollow Investigator from one of the survivor cities encounters a massive crisis on his very first day at work.

Based on a true story. Its distinctive pseudo-documentary style has a unique
significance in the history of thriller movies.
Unlike conventional thrillers, this film frequently adopts a first-person narrative
perspective, using invisible cameras to record streets, bars, and passersby to
recreate the world as seen by the main character.
The second half even uses a forty-minute long shot to record the eerie expansion
process of the Hollow. In the midst of the controversy among movie critics, this film
has become a legend in the industry.

entries.name: The Carls
entries.content:
A comedy movie / show in New Eridu. The Carls, all of them Bangboo, are used to imitate people's lives, from the time they were born and growing up to their teenage years and going out into the world. The show's unique, funny style draws a huge audience.

Each season of the show features a number of industry celebrities in various fields, such as politics, business, academia, and sports. Among them, a guest star, Edward, announced his candidacy for the city council this year. He played a delivery man hit by a truck when running a red light in the third season.

entries.name: Carrot
entries.content:
A recognition programme / geographical information / key that is installed into a bangboo to allow it to form safe paths throughout a hollow. By default Bangboos do not have this feature.

Carrots are time-sensitive Hollow maps. Although the space in Hollows is ever-changing, it's still possible to trace patterns within a certain period of time. The Hollow Investigative Association is able to map out the best path out of a Hollow, import the data in a chip and distribute it to Investigators' Bangboo to ensure Investigators can safely travel through the Hollows. The data
used is called a "Carrot." Experienced Hollow Raiders and Proxies can make carrots themselves, some of which may work better than HIA ones.

entries.name: Ether Aptitude
entries.content: A beings ability to resist ether corruption, ranges from 0 to 100, plateaus at adulthood, illness aging and psychological states can affect it. It is not common to be resistant to Ether.

entries.name: Public Security
entries.content: The police force of New Eridu, they have several branches all across the city.

entries.name: Old Capital
entries.content: The previous city of Eridu. A victim of the hollow disaster, covered by a hollow, very high ether concentration

entries.name: Resonium
entries.content: A derivative of Ether. Can be used to empower agents.

entries.name: White Star Institute
entries.content: A science / technology organisation in New Eridu. They are responsible for researching and observing the Hollows, particularly Hollow Zero.

entries.name: Hollow Investigative Association
entries.content:
The Hollow Investigative Association (HIA) is an organization affiliated with the New Eridu City Administration, and a faction in Zenless Zone Zero.  They are primarily responsible for Hollow disaster response within New Eridu, assisting with Hollow containment and disaster-related matters. Investigators regularly complete official commissions such as rescues and Ethereal hunts. Unlike Proxies, the investigators of the Association are legally accredited by the city administration.

The HIA recruits many individuals with high Ether aptitude to complete risky work. The HIA Career Club allows prospective investigators to compete in combat simulations and judge whether or not they are field-ready.

The HIA also works with Scott Outpost, where they help direct the containment of Hollow Zero.

Like the Proxies, Investigators are the successors of the Void Hunter "Joyous", who was the first person to learn how to navigate Hollows.

Multiple elite agencies collaborate to research and suppress the most dangerous Hollows, especially Hollow Zero. These include H.A.N.D.; the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division; and the White Star Institute.

The promotion path for Investigators is:

1. Trainee Investigator
2. Full Investigator
3. Senior Investigator
4. Elite Investigator
5. Ace Investigator.

With each promotion, an investigator shall face more pressure and danger, resulting in few to make it to the top and become an Ace.

HIA recruits without high Ether aptitude are unable to advance far, and are usually relegated to doing office or logistical work. Meanwhile, many less capable investigators perish in the Hollow, or are left unable to work from the long-term effects of Ether corruption.

entries.name: Hollow Rider
entries.content: A hollow VR game by the Hollow Investigative Association, done to test a person's skills in a virtual environment.

entries.name: Eous
entries.content:
Phaeton's Bangboo. It is different from most other Bangboo. Either Wise or Belle can connect to it remotely, signified by their eyes glowing blue. They can control and talk through it. They use this Bangboo for their proxy missions, meaning they do not have to physically enter hollows themselves.

Eous is a special type of Bangboo created by Carole Arna. After the fall of the Old Capital, They would become the companion of Belle and Wise.

Eous has a wireless charging setup in Belle's room at Random Play

Eous serves as the Phaethon siblings way of safely entering Hollows, by remote controlling it from their Hollow Deep Dive System.

Like the other Random Play Bangboo, Eous has a white body with mismatched colored ears, the right side being black, with orange coloring on the inside of both. Each ear is adorned with a large screw. It wears an orange scarf and a black jacket-like covering on Its body that says "RANDOM PLAY STAFF" on the lower left corner. It has yellow-green eyes and a green "tail".

What visibly differentiates Eous from the other Random Play Bangboo is that Its scarf says "01" and "Eous" on it.

entries.name: Metis Comprehensive School
entries.content: A school that seems to prioritise those with high Ether aptitudes.

entries.name: Outer Ring
entries.content:
The outskirts surrounding New Eridu. Public Security has no jurisdiction there. Many hollows are present there. Most of it looks similar to the Arizona desert.

The people of the Outer Ring live far apart, and the transportation of supplies relies heavily on the biker gangs. They're well-respected among the residents and nothing happens there without them knowing about it.

entries.name: TOPS
entries.content:
An organisation of the highest ranking companies in New Eridu, they seem to have a lot of influence over the city.

TOPS collaborates to make devices for public security.

They seem to be involved in a lot of the darkness in the city and are in a constant struggle with the city's administrative family, the Mayflowers.

entries.name: Ridu Newsletter
entries.content: Ridu Newsletter is a daily updated newspaper that keeps track of the happening in New Eridu.

entries.name: Keys
entries.content:
Unknown artifacts in New Eridu.

They include: Ghost,Jinny,Fairy,Youkai. 

So far only Fairy is known, it is an advanced A.I currently in the custody of Phaethon (Wise and Belle).

entries.name: Vision Corporation
entries.content:
A company involved with city planning and construction in New Eridu formerly led by Charles Perlman.

Vision Corporation is a construction company in New Eridu. They are an ambitious corporation that hopes to join New Eridu's premier business alliance, TOPS.

They were contracted to demolish and reconstruct the Old Capital Metro, which has been swallowed by the Dead End Hollow. However, they plan to do so by refusing to evacuate residents from the demolition area, thereby saving them the time and costs required to relocate them.

Phaethon and the Cunning Hares manage to safely evacuate the residents from the Hollow despite Vision's attempts to stop them. With their plans being exposed, Perlman is arrested and the corporation faces a massive lawsuit by the affected residents.

Vision's former director Sarah tries to assassinate Perlman by sabotaging the zeppelin taking him to his trial, causing it to fly directly toward a Hollow. However, thanks to the efforts of Phaethon and Victoria Housekeeping Co., the zeppelin is saved.

entries.name: Void Hunter
entries.content:
The Void Hunters is a title given by the mayor of Eridu to key players in the suppression of the Hollows.

Agents that are at the top of the food chain people who hunt the strongest ethereals.

The Void Hunters are a seven-member team that consist of key players in the suppression of the Hollows.

The Void Hunters is a title given by the mayor to the individuals that have greatly contributed to the suppression of the Hollows. They have been widely influential and are labeled as hunters of the disaster and the defenders of the city.

While it is public that Hoshimi Miyabi is part of the Void Hunters, further information about the group is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6 "The City Defenders".

entries.name: Hollow Zero
entries.content:
Hollow Zero, also known as "Limbo," is a colossal Hollow that consumed the old Eridu, resulting in its destruction, and serves as the source of several massive Hollows in and around New Eridu. The investigation and neutralization of Hollow Zero pose a long-term challenge for the authorities of New Eridu, both presently and in the future.

Hollow Zero is what brought old Eridu to its end. Despite the best efforts of the inhabitants, the Hollow expanded relentlessly, engulfing the city and those who lived in it. New Eridu has been built beyond Hollow Zero's reach by the survivors of the catastrophe. Hollow Zero is a special Hollow, and is currently the largest known Hollow in the world.

Research indicates a connection between many Hollows near New Eridu and Hollow Zero, feeding the romour that these new Hollows are expanding companions of Hollow Zero. Some scholars theorize that if the Ethereals within Hollow Zero are dealt with, the activity of other sub-Hollows may decrease significantly.
To prevent a recurrence of the old Eridu tragedy, or perhaps for other undisclosed reasons, the authorities of New Eridu regularly send Hollow Investigation Squads and other organizations to investigate and suppress Ether activity within Hollow Zero.

entries.name: Thiren
entries.content:
Humanoids  in New Eridu similar to Homosapiens although with features of other animals as well. Some like more human than others and there are various types.

The Thiren are a race of anthropomorphic beings, known for their unique blend of human and animalistic features. Thirens generally exhibit subtle animal characteristics while maintaining a predominantly human appearance. Common traits include animal ears and tails.

A subgroup of Thirens known as "Beast Thirens" are characterized by their more pronounced animalistic features, often possessing animalistic bone structures and bodies covered in fur. Some Thiren have been found to have a caffeine intolerance, with coffee consumption potentially leading to heart problems.

Thirens exhibit superhuman abilities such as immense strength, improved adaptation to Hollows, faster mutation rates after exposure to corruption, and rapid recovery. For example, Ellen Joe's tail can break bones if she is not careful.

Though their abilities vary, many Thirens are skilled combatants, often utilizing their unique physical traits in battle.

entries.name: Canvas Street
entries.content: A place somewhat disconnected from New Eridu, cut off due to the dead end hollow's existence blocking most of the roads there. The people there a poor and cannot afford a New Eridu legal ID.

entries.name: Three Gates
entries.content: An industrial  / construction company and a rival to Belobog Industries. It is made up of 3 departments, one of them being military.

entries.name: Knock Knock
entries.content: A messenger app in New Eridu.

entries.name: Weasel Gang
entries.content: A gang in New Eridu.

entries.name: New Eridu Business Review
entries.content: A business magazine in New Eridu.

entries.name: Roose Institute of Technology
entries.content: A technology school in New Eridu. Grace Howard went there.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Mortal Cleave
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Autonomous Tactical Unit - Lumberjack, including their most profound impressions and evaluations of it. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Godfinger Arcade
entries.content: The Godfinger Arcade is a location and game system in Sixth Street in New Eridu.

entries.name: Brant Street Construction Site
entries.content: Brant Street Construction Site is a location in New Eridu. Belobog Industries is currently working on a project there.

entries.name: Coff Cafe
entries.content: A coffee shop in Sixth Street owned by Tin Master in New Eridu.

entries.name: 141 Convenience Store
entries.content: A branch of stores in New Eridu, one is located in Sixth Street and another in Lumina Square.

entries.name: Box Galaxy Gadget Store
entries.content: The Box Galaxy Gadget Store is a location and game system in Sixth Street in New Eridu.

entries.name: HIA Club
entries.content: One of the Hollow Investigative Association's branches in Lumina Square, New Eridu. It's main use is to host their VR devices, for combat simulations.

entries.name: Lumina Square
entries.content: A district in New Eridu.

entries.name: Metro Station
entries.content: A station in New Eridu.

entries.name: Noodle Shop
entries.content: The Noodle Shop / Waterfall Soup is a food branch in New Eridu. General Chop mans the Sixth Street branch, while Chop Junior mans the Lumina Square branch.

entries.name: Random Play
entries.content: Random Play is a location in New Eridu where customers can rent or buy home movies. It is located in Sixth Street. This video store is owned by two siblings, Wise and Belle, who also secretly work as Proxies.

entries.name: Scott Outpost
entries.content: Scott Outpost is a location in New Eridu that was established to monitor and contain Hollow Zero.

entries.name: Sixth Street
entries.content:
A district in New Eridu, it's where Wise and Belle live.

"Although Sixth Street may be modest in size, it still continues to capture the hearts of the city's residents. Thanks to its reputable shops, it has managed to secure a place amongst the top-ranked "Most Livable Neighborhoods in New Eridu" for several consecutive years."

entries.name: Alexandrina Sebastiane
entries.content:
Alexandrina Sebastiane, popularly known as Rina, is an agent and a member of Victoria Housekeeping. Her Birthday is September 23rd and she is 173 cm in height. She has a ghostly aura and can somehow float.

Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

It's clear Rina cares deeply about her colleagues at Victoria Housekeeping, as she often mentions them when talking about work and personal stuff.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.

To protect her impeccable image, Rina maintains a professional and gracious demeanor even with the most challenging clients.
Drusilla, however, may occasionally express her true thoughts regardless of the situation.

* Rina's family holds significant influence within the industry, as all of its members have served as attendants or maids to some of the most prominent figures.
Lycaon learned some of his attendant skills from Rina.

entries.name: Anby Demara
entries.content:
Anby Demara is an agent and a member of the Cunning Hares. Her birthday is February 20th and she is 156cm tall.

According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.

Despite her extreme lack of common sense and her youth, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

As the only one who's worried about the Cunning Hares' finances, Anby really has it hard.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.

Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

Rumors suggest Nicole found Anby near the ruins of the old capital and took her in because she was impressed by her formidable combat abilities.

In truth she was the captain of the long defunct Silver Squad, Soldier 0, now known as Anby Demara, is a skilled soldier proficient in tactics and swordplay. Once considered as an expendable unit of the Obsidian Division, Anby now lives a relatively simpler life as a member of the odd-job agency Cunning Hares, where she is treated humanely and nurtures friendships.

Although she was considered dead by the Defense Force, Anby still kept her twin swords and old uniform, having the latter patched up and donning it when the situation required it. Wearing her army uniform again allows Anby to recall more memories from her past, especially the Silver Squad fighting style.

Before the Fall of the Old Capital, Anby used to be known as Soldier 0, the captain of the Silver Squad, a group within the New Eridu Defense Force Obsidian Division. Unlike other squads, Silver Squad's infantry consisted of replicas, artificial humans made via genetic cloning. This made them incredibly loyal and powerful (albeit high-maintenance) soldiers that could be easily replaced if they died in battle. She was considered the best of all the replicas, loyal to the point she would kill herself if ordered.

All replicas considered themselves to be sisters and cared for each other as family. Therefore, when the Defense Force tried to select only one replica to keep to get rid of the others and cut the maintance costs, Anby failed her tests on purpose to convince the Obsidian Division the entire Silver Squad was needed and not get rid of her sisters. However, it could not go on forever: one day, their superiors decided to devise a suicide mission to kill off all members of the Silver Squad and keep Anby as the sole replica. However, the night before the operation, Harin, also known as Soldier 11, got injured during training, so Anby took her place for deployment.

Despite the mission being created ad hoc to leave no soldier alive, Anby managed to survive and return to the base after witnessing the death of her sisters. Upon her return, her disgruntled superiors, who wanted to keep only one replica alive, gave Anby the order to kill Soldier 11. In an act of disobedience towards her superiors and of love towards her sister, Anby slit her own throat instead, so that the Obsidian Division would have been forced to keep Soldier 11 as the sole replica. Her superiors hence kept Soldier 11, and disposed of Anby's body by leaving it by the ruins of the Old Capital, where she was found by Nicole Demara, who took her in as the first member of Gentle House and gave her her own surname.

When a replica sustains a heavy injury, their memory gets damaged, leading to temporary retrograde amnesia. Therefore, it took a while before Anby remembered her past as Soldier 0. When the memories of her time in the Silver Squad came back, she asked Nicole to gather information regarding Soldier 11; as she learnt that her sister had joined Obol Squad and became an exemplary soldier, Anby decided it was best to leave her be, feeling that their shared past would only weigh greatly on her.
"It's not because she's strong! I took her in because I'm kind~" — Nicole
Anby's behavior and combat performance suggest she has had military training.
Due to the suspicious gaps in her history, it's advised to maintain a certain level of vigilance towards her.

entries.name: Anton Ivanov
entries.content:
Anton Ivanov is an agent and a member of Belobog Heavy Industries. His birthday is May 2nd and he is 190 cm tall.

Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?"
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"

The one who shouts the loudest slogans during a fight, and the second loudest is his bro.
Keywords for dealing with Anton: "Passion," "Bond," and "Bro."
He will have your back no matter what, even if you take a dark path.

Here is a video recording depicting Anton's life:
Late at night at the construction site, Anton gazes down at his jackhammer and mutters to himself, "Dang, this is exhausting, Bro..."
As the jackhammer buzzed to life, Anton nodded in acknowledgment. "No, a real one doesn't complain about being tired! Thanks for reminding me, buddy! You can never back down from a challenge!"
The truth is, Anton had set up demanding tasks for the construction workers, hoping to push them to their limits and unlock their true potential. However, witnessing their struggles and diminishing confidence, he couldn't bear to see them suffer any longer, so he secretly completed all the tasks in the dead of night.
In the end, Anton became the one who accepted all the trials.

* Anton's beloved "bro," aka his jackhammer, appears to have a connection to his former colleagues.

entries.name: Ben Bigger
entries.content:
Ben Bigger is an agent and a member of Belobog Heavy Industries. He is a beast thiren (humanoid bear). He is 192 cm tall and his birthday is December 23rd.

Things he values: Receipts, safety hats, caviar. Things he dislikes: Receipts, calculators with small buttons, fish.
In terms of daily tasks, "fur care" is the second most important. The most important task is "settling the accounts."
He has the body of the king of the beasts and the caring heart of the king of the beasts' mother.

Ben is the financial and asset management director at Belobog Heavy Industries, and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"I enjoy mathematics, but that doesn't stop me from giving thugs a good smack."
He's a burly and strong Thiren Despite his tough exterior, he's of a surprisingly sensitive and detail-oriented nature, especially when it comes to numbers.
Originally a frontline mechanical operator at Belobog, his talents caught Koleda's discerning eye, leading to his promotion to a managerial position responsible for the company's finances.
Grateful for Koleda's trust in him, he remains profoundly loyal to her.
His favorite food is black caviar, but he dislikes fish.

I once witnessed this imposing figure seated in a small office chair, wearing small glasses, and carefully cross-referencing Belobog's asset records while mashing away at a calculator with his huge fingers.

entries.name: Billy Kid
entries.content:
Billy Kid is an agent and a member of the Cunning Hares. His birthday is November 25th and he is  188cm tall.

A handsome cyborg with a casual and carefree personality. He's an avid fan of the Starlight Knight show, not only referring to himself as one of the Starlight Knights, but repeating many classic lines from the show. Refers to his pair of special custom-made high-caliber revolvers as "the girls". They appear to have been a gift from an old friend. He may look unreliable, but once he gets serious Billy can take on any challenge.

Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine.
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

Billy cares for his weapons like he cares for himself.
He sure loves the Starlight Knights, but does he love the sense of justice or just the special effects?
Billy's past hides unimaginable secrets.

Similar to Anby, there are gaps in Billy's personal history that remain unfilled.
The available information indicates that before joining Gentle House, Billy spent an extended period serving with another mysterious gang.
As of now, it appears Billy still maintains a close connection with a certain gang leader from the Outer Ring of New Eridu.

entries.name: Corin Wickes
entries.content:
Corin Wickes is an agent and a member of Victoria Housekeeping. She is 141cm tall and her birthday is 
June 2nd.

"Um... My name's Corin, from Victoria Housekeeping Co. I'm a Gemini; Rh-negative blood type; I like cleaning.

Peel an apple? Can I use my chainsaw? Or maybe an axe — Oh... No? OK, sorry..." - Corin Wickes introducing herself.

Corin seems to be lacking confidence...? She always panics about everything she does...
With enough encouragement, Corin will always spring into action. Of course, a little shock will also do the trick...
Corin looks so adorable when she musters up the courage to complete a commission!

Corin is one of the maids working for Victoria Housekeeping Co.
She is a highly obedient maid but lacks confidence and often fears being disliked by others. When in a rush, she becomes flustered and stutters.
Corin is always apologizing no matter what happens.
"I... I... I'm so sorry! I'm so incompetent... I'll never get things right..."

Corin never, however, fails to fulfill her tasks with excellence and is one of the most reliable members of Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Despite her flawless performance, Corin remains skeptical about her abilities, constantly worrying about being a burden to her colleagues, which can sometimes frustrate Lycaon.
Thoughts: Is Corin's personality innate, shaped by her life experiences?

Corin's health record reveals that before joining Victoria Housekeeping, she faced a critical illness and underwent major surgery as a result there's a large scar surrounding her upper right arm. Despite her youthful appearance she is Ellen Joe's senior.

entries.name: Ellen Joe
entries.content:
Ellen Joe is an agent and a member of Victoria Housekeeping. She is a shark thiren (human body, shark tail and sharp teeth) She is 161cm tall and her birthday is January 4th. 

Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.
Since her fighting style leads to high energy consumption, she always carries a lollipop in her mouth to ensure an adequate sugar intake.
While she frequently expresses her desire to change jobs due to the hassle, she genuinely values her companions at Victoria Housekeeping.

Shark Rule #1: The more karaoke coupons, the better!
Shark Rule #2: If you want to skip class, grab an accomplice!
Shark Rule #3: Weight and nickname are top-secret!

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.
Apart from her role as a maid at Victoria Housekeeping, Ellen spends a significant amount of time with her friends, leading an ordinary and contented student life.

Thoughts: As a multitasker, Ellen must balance her student life with her job at Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Perhaps this is one of the reasons why she often feels tired?

Ellen appears to possess a unique sense of taste that differs from that of ordinary people. Her teammate Rina consistently prepares various "whimsical" dishes, and Ellen is the only one who can consume them without breaking a sweat.

entries.name: Grace Howard
entries.content:
Grace Howard is an agent and a member of Belobog Heavy Industries. Her birthday is April 14th and she is 170 cm tall.

Honestly, Grace's sleep schedule is kinda terrifying.
Grace always has a soft spot for cute machines.
The break-down components of Grace: 80% mad scientist, 10% tenderness, and 10%... business secrets.

Grace is a technical expert at Belobog Industries. She's the core talent in developing and patenting Belobog's in-Hollow machinery.
She's obsessed with gears, metal and wires — a true mechanical geek. She's eager to dismantle and study any machinery or equipment she takes an interest in: "Such sharp and strong lines, truly beautiful... I can't help but want to open it up and take a look."

Grace always shows extraordinary patience when dealing with machines, doting on the sophisticated metal constructions as if they were her own children.
According to the information at hand, Grace is probably the only one who can playfully refer to Koleda as "Sweet Pea" without receiving a kick in the shin.

Both of Grace's parents, who were research workers related to the Hollow, disappeared during a dangerous expedition into a Hollow, and were soon presumed dead. Grace was adopted by her parents' former friend, Khors, the previous president of Belobog Industries, and Koleda's father. As a result, Grace and Koleda are "sisters," though not related by blood.

entries.name: Koleda Belobog
entries.content:
Koleda Belobog is an agent and the President of Belobog Heavy Industries. Her birthday is August 10th and she is 150cm tall.

Small & Cute, With Some Fierce Combat Power
She may be small, but can certainly wield that huge hammer.

A Fierce Young Girl Who's Also a President
The young leader at the helm of Belobog Industries.

A President Who Leads by Example
She prefers to work out in the field, rather than being stuck at a desk.

Leads by Example While Maintaining Her Cute Nature
Her maturity sometimes gives way to occasional childishness. She's a leader who sometimes needs to be taken care of by her followers.

Koleda never openly admits her love for desserts.
She wants to be the most reliable president in front of her colleagues.

Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving
embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda
appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.

It's evident that Koleda is actually quite fond of sweets, even though she's hesitant to openly admit it.
The suspected rationale behind this is that she views enjoying sweets as a childish inclination and doesn't want others to perceive her as immature.
Furthermore, Koleda seems particularly sensitive to any descriptors associated with children, and mentioning such terms could trigger her annoyance.

"Just remember, I'm the perfect height for your shinbone, so you might wanna reconsider before labeling me as childish." - Koleda.

entries.name: Luciana de Montefio
entries.content:
"An honored guest just arrived. Allow me, Lady Lucy, to entertain you!" Luciana Auxesis Theodoro de Montefio

"Good day. What can one do for you?" "Scandalous! They shall feel my wrath!" "Grassy, Woody, Bricky! Get it together!" - Luciana.

Luciana de Montefio, whose full name is Luciana Auxesis Theodoro de Montefio, is the daughter of the current head of the prestigious New Eridu Montefio family.

Referring to herself as solely Lucy, due to her real name being far too long and not wanting to be involved with her family, now performs the role of "Boar Thiren Overseer" for the "Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co.," a name used by the Sons of Calydon for their official logistics business.

Due to her being considered a missing person, with there being a sizable reward for her safe return to her family, Lucy prefers to stay in the Outer Ring, seldomly returning to the city. Despite Lucy's best efforts however, her father is aware of her whereabouts, believing that she will return home by herself at some point, as he himself went through a rebellious phase and ran away from home for over a decade, before eventually returning to don the mantle of the family business and responsibilities.

Lucy currently spends a lot of her time challenging Caesar King to duels, in the hopes of one day ruling the Outer Ring herself.

Despite belonging to an extremely wealthy family where everything was laid-out for her and provided for her, whether it be a proper education or piano lessons, the one thing Lucy truly desired was the freedom to live her life how she pleased.

After taking an Ether Aptitude Test that came back remarkably high, she professed that she wished to become a Hollow Investigator, only to be met with refusal, harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse from her family, which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.

She ended up devising a plan, whereby she would fall victim to a kidnapping of her own creation, in order to create an opening for her to flee her current situation. This plan never came to fruition however, as Caesar King from the Sons of Calydon would end up defeating the faux kidnappers and "saving" her in the process. From that point on, Lucy vowed to become a fully-fledged member of the Sons of Calydon herself.

entries.name: Nekomiya Mana
entries.content:
Nekomiya Mana, better known by her nickname Nekomata is an agent and a member of the Cunning Hares. She was originally a Red Fang Gang member having been raised by them as an orphan. She is 148 cm tall and her birthday is July 30th.

Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.
In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she
eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third member of the team.

Despite leaving the Red Fang Gang for a while, Nekomata still commands respect within the gang.

Within the Gentle House, Nekomata seems to hold a significant interest in Nicole, much to Anby's displeasure. The likely reason for this could be summed up as: "I was here first..."

entries.name: Nicole Demara
entries.content:
Nicole Demara is an agent and the leader of the Cunning Hares. 165cm Tall. Birthday, November 11th.

An extremely energetic girl whose mischievous side sees her play the occasional trick, though only occasionally~
