Incredibly curious, with a real love for mackerel.
Get to know her, and you'll find she's hiding something behind that cheerful exterior.

The leader of the odd-job agency the Cunning Hares, who accept all kinds of Hollow-related commissions.

She's been on the streets for many years, and has a reputation among her peers as being exceedingly cunning.

She's been blacklisted by many clients due to her all-or nothing approach.

She loves money, but is surprisingly bad at managing it, leaving the Cunning Hares constantly on the edge of bankruptcy and owing many debts.

Nicole's afraid of ghosts... Perhaps because of a guilty conscience?
The usually stingy Nicole is generous when treating the orphanage kids.
Nicole is a genius when it comes to business. No matter how poor she may be, she is still a genius.

 Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.

During her early years, Nicole spent a good amount of time in an orphanage.
There are rumors that Nicole once reached an adoption agreement with a prominent family. Yet, shortly afterward, she reappeared by herself somewhere in New Eridu, and has been out around the streets ever since.

entries.name: Piper Wheel
entries.content:
"Ya need a lift? Then buckle up, buddy." Piper Wheel "If you get carsick, look out the window at the view, and you'll feel better." "Next, it's time for lil ol' me to clock in and get to work." "Buckle~ Up~!" - Piper.

Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.

Piper has a love for the sound of truck engines starting up, so she recorded the sound of Steeltusk starting up. She has to listen to the recording to fully wake up in the morning.
If Piper falls asleep during a meeting, playing a recording of a truck engine can quickly get her wide awake again.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.

entries.name: Soldier 11
entries.content:
Soldier 11 is an agent in and a member of the Obol Squad. Birthday Unknown. She is 160cm tall.

Soldier 11 is a member of the New Eridu Defense Force.

She currently serves as a primary responder in the Obol squad, Obsidian Division. Soldier 11 is a code name - her real name discarded.

"...My name? I gave it up long ago.
It's only a reminder of my past, and the past makes you weak."

Soldier 11 is a fan of spicy food, and likes the super-spicy noodles served at Waterfall Soup.

She shares a mysterious past with Anby Demara.

She used to be called Harin and was originally a replica serving under Anby, who used to be her captain in Silver Company. Believes that Anby had betrayed her, vanishing without a trace and leaving her to fend for herself; being a soldier, she deemed it desertion, though in reality the feelings were personal. Though her "desertation" was not intentional, Anby had lost her memories when she left the army after recovering from near death. When she regained them, she told Nicole to see how she was doing. When she heard that soldier 11 was doing after, after having joined Obol Squad and being promoted, she decided to not contact her, thinking that bringing up the past with Silver Company and Silver Squad would burden her. She would eventually get captured by Twiggy, a surviving replica from the company and lose her memories before being saved by Anby. Anby would confess the truth to her while her memories were still fragmented from her injury. She would return to help Anby defeat Twiggy and then lose her memories of Anby's confession and apology as well as the events with defeating Twiggy. It is unclear if she truly has forgotten everything or not, but her misguided hatred for Anby still lingers, and Anby has no intention of telling her the truth while her memories are intact.

entries.name: Soukaku
entries.content:
Soukaku is an agent and a member of Section 6. She is a blue Oni. 

"Glutton" - the name Soukaku's been called the most.

Few people know her full nickname is: The cute little one who always gobbles down everything she can and is super happy when full but can't reed or rite.

Soukaku, Deceptively Strong in Combat
Not only a member of Section 6, but also one of its "assets." Enemies who underestimate her have a tendency to vanish from existence. Totally.

Not Picky, Hates Wasting Food
She loves to eat, and gets angry when seeing others waste food. Totally.

Trouble With Words
Due to certain reasons, she's somewhat uneducated, and often mispronounces words, which results in some cute blunders. Totally.

A Pure & Innocent Child
Though only an immature kid, much like the boy in "The Emperor's New Clothes," she often uncovers the simple truths. Totally.

entries.name: Von Lycaon
entries.content:
Von Lycaon is an agent and a member of Victoria Housekeeping. He is a white humanoid wolf Thiren.

Can resolve any matter. The most trusted of attendants, and solid support for any team.
Rational and wise, a true gentleman who can't tolerate a single stain.
Offers absolute loyalty to the one he decides to follow.
Though outwardly sophisticated and rational, his innate feral character will reveal itself when faced with certain dangers.

"If you are bored, would you like a steak? Medium or medium-rare?
No matter how many times I enter the Hollows... they always feel so filthy." - Lycaon.

Even the highly self-disciplined Lycaon worries about shedding fur...
While Lycaon is an incredibly versatile attendant, he won't demand their soul as payment from his employers.
No matter what happened in his past, Lycaon remains an unwaveringly reliable companion.

Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Lycaon has a troubled past that he keeps to himself.
Despite his current elegant and gentle demeanor, the former Lycaon led a wild lifestyle and had a friend whom he trusted implicitly.
However, this friend has now become a bitter enemy. (This friend is now the leader of the Phantom Thief organisation known as Mockingbird.)

entries.name: Zhu Yuan
entries.content:
Zhu Yuan is an agent and is the team leader of the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team in New Eridu Public Security. She is 175 cm tall and her birthday is September 1st.

Zhu Yuan, an exceptional officer at Public Security, is a highly skilled individual expected to become the next commissioner. She currently leads the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team at the Janus Precinct within the Metropolitan Order Department. Her team members include Qingyi, Seth, and Jane.
Note: For documents with higher security levels within the Public Security system, further investigation is required; scheduling priority - low.
Zhu Yuan possesses excellent skills in criminal investigation, combat, and self-management (including working overtime). She has no unresolved cases on record.

She has a tendency to be a perfectionist and exhibits a strong obsession with "neatness" and "perfection," which may be considered her only weakness (?). Officer Qingyi, her mentor in life and subordinate at work, often remarks that Zhu Yuan's perfectionism complex will worsen unless someone can talk her out of it. However, due to her high standards for herself, she has gained ample experience and skills to lead the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team and attract exceptional talents.

Zhu Yuan seems to have a passion for gardening. She is currently growing a tomato plant in her office, which is often pilfered by a raccoon family residing near the Public Security office.
Thoughts: Could this provide a potential avenue for infiltrating Public Security?

Zhu Yuan is a rarity among humans, showing no particular fondness for small furry animals.

entries.name: Hoshimi Miyabi
entries.content:
Hoshimi Miyabi is an agent and the leader of Section 6. She has been awarded the title of "Void Hunter", and is the youngest person in New Eridu to bear such title. She is a fox thiren humanoid. The Hoshimi bloodline does not have tails.

With her strong sense of responsibility towards guarding the principles and order within New Eridu, Miyabi aspires to build an unbreakable city management system... and to own a sizable collection of swords (her own words).

Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

Hoshimi Miyabi is the heir to a famed martial arts family in New Eridu.
According to an insider, Miyabi's mother died when she was young and Miyabi's relationship with her father is rather odd.
Note: Miyabi's father has not taken any civil or administrative positions within New Eridu.

entries.name: Qingyi
entries.content:
Qingyi is a member of the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. She often works with Zhu Yuan. She seems to be either a cyborg or an android (Automaton).

Qingyi (or 01 Neo-Genesis VI) is an experienced Pubsec officer and novice investigator. With a personally modified riot baton, the intelligent construct fights crime in New Eridu. The most notable thing about Qingyi is her mature personality, having built it off of Old Civilization media and her own very long life. She spends her free time with the elderly citizens of New Eridu, playing chess and drinking hot water. Compared to other Pubsec officers, Qingyi is incredibly laid back, from playing pranks on her other members to working with Proxies.

The "01NG VI Criminal Investigation Automaton" was one of the many discoveries from the Old Civilization made by White Star Institute. Whilst registring serial numbers, the researcher who found her, tired from working overtime, accidentally wrote down "QING YI", having mistaken "01NG Ⅵ" for a name. The titular intelligent construct didn't mind this mistake, embracing her new name: "Qingyi." Over time, Qingyi underwent numerous modifications, including the installment of an emotion module and alteration of her hair. Upon the recommendation of White Star Institute, Qingyi joined New Eridu Public Security, becoming a full-fledged officer before moving to the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, where she became a novice investigator assigned to Captain Zhu Yuan, serving as an underling and mentor to her.

Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a rookie officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems. Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.

"Drinking hot water is good for your health." - Qingyi.

"Slacking off? I don't get it... There's still so much I have yet to learn about youth slang." "I may be on autopilot, but I'm still making progress at work." "Well, since there's nothing left to do, I shall take my leave." - Qingyi.

entries.name: Seth Lowell
entries.content:
Seth Lowell is an agent and a member of the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. He is a cat thiren.

Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

Seth has an older brother who holds a higher position in Public Security.
To some, Seth is a rookie riding on family connections within Public Security, but he got in on his own merit and has nothing to do with his brother's influence.
Currently, they are not on good terms. When they encounter each other at work, they pretend not to know one another.
Seth views his brother as a rival he must surpass, and is working hard to achieve that goal.


"First, gotta pretend to be completely harmless..." "Ah... saw right through me, huh?" "Well, whatever, guess it's time we talk with our fists instead!" - Seth.

entries.name: Bringer
entries.content:
Bringer was a senior officer within New Eridu Public Security and a member of The Order. Though he was once called the "Hollow Hero" due to his supposed heroic actions during the fall of Eridu, Bringer later became known for his corrupt and publicity-seeking behavior. He campaigned to become PubSec's Commander of Janus Quarter in New Eridu's municipal elections, while secretly conspiring with Sarah to advance the interests of The Order.

As a child Bringer was part of a survivor group that wandered the wastes outside New Eridu, dodging Hollows, hoping to reach civilization. However, the the night before they reached the city, the leader of their group became corrupted, and was abandoned by the very people he had been protecting. Prior to the events of the game, Bringer joined New Eridu Public Security as an officer. He quickly became known as the "Hollow Hero" for repeatedly braving Hollows and rescuing many civilians, including a young Zhu Yuan. However, Bringer became more interested in politics than helping the citizens, and this change didn't go unnoticed by his constituents as he climbed the ranks of New Eridu Public Security.

Bringer first made a cameo appearance during the pursuit of Miguel Silver, where he gave a fumbling televised interview about the situation. He later helped apprehend mercenaries hired by Sarah and the Vision Corporation to cover up their attempted murder of the Canvas Street residents. Bringer was actually Sarah's accomplice this case, with their actions being intended to retrieve a type of mutant Etheric matter called the Sacrifice from inside the Dead End Hollow.

Bringer later appeared after the destruction of the Unknown Corruption Complex, taking charge of the scene while Officers Zhu Yuan and Qingyi were inspecting it. Though he tried to dissuade further investigation into the monster — realizing that it was a Sacrifice — its forensic evidence was already being transferred to HAND, threatening to put it out of Bringer's reach.

After the investigation, Bringer reassigned Zhu Yuan and Qingyi to Sixth Street, where they were to recruit local residents to participate in a safety awareness event. Most residents were reluctant to participate due to Bringer's poor reputation, as they believed the event was only a publicity stunt for his election campaign. However, many of them changed their minds after Zhu Yuan and Qingyi helped the community by catching Carlo Maroon, a criminal who had been causing damage and confusion with an illegal EMP emitter.

Bringer's event coincided with a hijacking of the evidence convoy carrying the Corruption Complex's etheric matter by the same group Maroon belonged to. Bringer had actually organized the event to draw officers away from the convoy, allowing him to hijack it and retrieve the evidence before it reached HAND. However, Zhu Yuan and Qingyi, realizing a correlation between the Sixth Street EMP case and the convoy's route, quickly left the event to stop the evidence from being stolen. The top-secret nature of the convoy's route made them realize that a mole within Public Security must have been informing the thieves, though they did not yet suspect Bringer. With Phaethon's help, the pair were successful in defeating the convoy's attackers and reclaiming the evidence.

While in prison, Vision Corporation's CEO Charles Perlman attempted to blackmail Bringer and Sarah, threatening to expose their identities unless they helped him escape. Though the two pretended to assist Perlman, they instead conspired to assassinate him during his zeppelin transport to the New Eridu Supreme Court. They did so by hiring mercenaries to remotely hijack the zeppelin, intending to fly it into the Ballet Twins Hollow and kill all its occupants. The attack was stopped by Phaethon and Victoria Housekeeping, who had discovered the plan by chance. After being rescued, Perlman managed to escape custody by stealing the zeppelin and flying it to the Outer Ring.

Though frustrated by his failures, Bringer resolved to focus on his election campaign, in which he hoped to become PubSec's new Commander in Janus Quarter. Before his Election Day speech, he was approached by Sarah, who revealed that the Void Hunter Hoshimi Miyabi's cursed katana, "Tailless", contained energy that could empower the Sacrifice. The two staged an attack on the Outer Ring town of Blazewood, hoping to both neutralize Perlman before he could release any evidence about Bringer's associations; and to kidnap Miyabi, who had just arrived in Blazewood along with the rest of HAND's Hollow Special Operations Section 6 to hear Perlman's confession. Though they were initially only successful in capturing Perlman, Bringer was able to exchange him for Miyabi during a confrontation, where she allowed herself to be taken into custody to protect Perlman and the rest of Section 6. A rescued Perlman turned over all evidence of Bringer's misdeeds to HAND.

With Miyabi in custody, Sarah stole the energy from Miyabi's katana; she then forced Tailless' enraged demon into Miyabi's body. Sarah unleashed a possessed Miyabi on an unwitting crowd of civilians at Bringer's election speech, hoping for a massacre that would discredit HAND. However, Miyabi managed to overcome the demon and prevent a tragedy.

With his plans foiled and his identity revealed, Bringer fled to Port Elpis, where he had stashed a large amount of Etheric matter. Upon being confronted by Phaethon and their allies, Bringer injected himself with a vial of Elixir P07, a refined Etheric substance that transformed him into a Sacrifice. During the ensuing fight against Section 6, Sarah shot Bringer with a second vial, completing his "refinement" and imbuing him with incredible Etheric powers. His final form, however, was not strong enough to defend himself from Miyabi's final slash, and his body was destroyed.

After the fight, Bringer briefly survived inside a piece of the Sacrifice. As he crawled through Port Elpis' docks, he was confronted by Belle and Wise, who demanded to know about Carole Arna's fate after her abduction by the Creator during the Fall of the Old Capital. Bringer lured them closer and self-destructed, trying to kill the siblings. For reasons unknown, both were unscathed by his attack. In his dying moments, Bringer mocked the siblings for their futile attempts to defy the Order.

entries.name: Khors Belobog
entries.content: Allegdly embezzling funds from his company, the night before the old capital of Eridu fell he was apparently running off with a bunch of money, and went missing shortly after according the sources. Considered an enemy by his own company. He is Koleda's Father. The matter of his absence is unknown and mysterious - - - In reality he used the money to finish the payment for the first prototype building machine and took it somewhere, he had gotten into a fight with an unknown person. He is likely dead.

entries.name: Officer Mewmew
entries.content: Officer Mewmew is the mascot of New Eridu Public Security. He can be found in Sixth Street, Brant Street Construction Site, and in Lumina Square. He wears a white chubby cat suit with a police hat on top and a collar with a golden badge and green ribbon on his chest.

entries.name: Howl
entries.content: A german shepard dog that runs the news stand in Sixth Street, New Eridu.

entries.name: Tin Master
entries.content: A robot that runs the coffee shop, Coff Cafe in Sixth Street, New Eridu.

entries.name: General Chop
entries.content: General Chop is the owner of the restaurant Waterfall Soup on Sixth Street. He has a son, Chop Junior, who works at the one on Lumina Square.

entries.name: Bardic Needle
entries.content: A music store in Sixth Street that also modifies and tunes drive discs for W-Engines.

entries.name: Sons of Calydon
entries.content:
Sons of Calydon is a biker gang that lives on the Outer Ring of New Eridu, led by Caesar King. They seem to have a red boar theme.

The Sons of Calydon seem to be inspired by post-apocalyptic wasteland gangs featured in films like Mad Max. Another inspiration is western depictions of biker gangs.

"I come, I see, I crash!" - Their Motto.

entries.name: Ruby
entries.content:
Ellen Joe's School friend. Teal eyes, Blonde parted Hair, Red headband, pink sweater, blue tie, white shirt black skirt, black belt black thigh high stockings, black shoes.

Ruby is a bit of a hot head and doesn't like to work for money, she'd rather buy scratch cards and hope to get lucky.

entries.name: Lynn
entries.content:
Ellen Joe's School friend. Glasses, pink eyes, long black hair, blue tie, white shirt, black sleeveless Serafuku. 

Lynn is reserved, she likes "romance" movies.

entries.name: Monna
entries.content:
Ellen Joe's School friend. Cow Thiren (Mostly human) black horns, brown cow ears, brown hair, cow tail, puffy gyaru socks).

Monna gets stressed buy final exams and likes relaxing films.

entries.name: N.E.J
entries.content: A blimp that tranfers people to the Supreme Court in New Eridu where trials are held.

entries.name: Forbidden Fruit Test
entries.content:
A Test that examines a robot's logic core (The core systems of AI enabled machinery) to test for self awareness.

The logic core is a precious technological breakthrough that grants mechanical creations the ability to have independent
consciousness, potentially even "enlightening" a machine enough to pass the Forbidden Fruit test and be truly endowed with the "soul" of an individual.

A robot that passes the test will be called an Intelligent Construct.

entries.name: Ballet Twins
entries.content:
A set of two tower buildings with paranormal rumours surrounding them. They have been engulfed by the lemnian hollow. It was built by Ballet Brothers. It is the private property of "The Master".

The rumour is as follows: when the buildings were swalllowed up, two sisters who were dancers died there, the sisters became the masters of the building and would warm visitors with flickering lights, if the visitor refuses to leave the sisters would cause a black out and appear in the darkness to harvest the souls of the visitor.

The truth of the matter is this. The Marionette Sisters were performers, granddaughters of Rhodes who raised them, their names were Augilia and Augetta. They used to work in the Ballet Twins towers but were victims of the Hollow that swallowed the buildings. On the day the towers collapsed, they didn't leave but instead stormed the radio station to help guide everyone to evacuation. They managed to save plenty of lives, but they themselves never made it out alive. They were adandoned by staff, being left out from entering an elevator, later they would become corrupted and transform into ballet dancer Ethereals. It is possible that the two were forced to work in the Tower due to the contract they signed. The ballet brothers were hosting an important event on the day of the Hollow disaster, due to their financial defecit they insisted on the show continuing despite signs pointing to danger.

Ever since their deaths Rhodes has been working to pay off a debt they owe for years. He eventually found closure with the help of the legendary proxy known as Phaethon. They had recorded one last message telling him to look forward and live a happy life.

entries.name: Jane Doe
entries.content:
Jane Doe is a criminal behavior specialist working as a consultant for the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. She often works undercover as different people. She is a Rat Thiren.

Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do. However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Jane is a total night owl. She loves working the night shift and is most alive after dark.
She's also a bit of a hoarder, constantly filling her home with stuff (usually a bunch of junk food).

The pouch at her waist might look like a makeup bag, but it's actually her toolkit, packed with all the "essentials" for her work.

entries.name: Mountain Lions
entries.content: A militant group that believes in brutality and is known for its involvment in violent crimes. Razor is the leader.

entries.name: White Waves Hospital
entries.content: White Waves Hospital is a renowned large-scale comprehensive medical facility in New Eridu. Earlier records go back 41 years to when it was forced to relocate due to a Hollow disaster. With funding from both the government and the public, White Wave Hospital, which had been relocated several times, retained most of its medical resources. Its symbol is a white wave.

entries.name: Cognitive Corruption Syndrome
entries.content:
May be developed if one stays in a hollow too long regardless of their ether aptitude. Symptoms include rapid memory decline, cognitive disorder, and repetitive speech. In severe cases, one's memory can regress to that of decades ago, forgetting everything that occurred afterward.

There is no known cure but progress towards one is being attempted.

entries.name: Crest of Waves
entries.content: Prize for winning Miss Metropolitan in New Eridu.

entries.name: Miss Metropolitan
entries.content: A beauty pagent competition in New Eridu, the winner recieves an item called the "Crest of Waves" trophy.

entries.name: New Eridu Housekeeping Association
entries.content: An organisation that reviews the members and quality of housekeeping companies in New Eridu.

entries.name: Granny Leisha
entries.content:
Leisha Christie, also known as Granny Leisha, is a an old lady who suffers from Cognitive Corruption Syndrome, a mental disorder that slowly destroys and resets her memory.

When she was young, she always dreamed of becoming an actress. However, she ended up landing a job at the White Waves Hospital instead, taking care of newborns. Despite that, she absolutely loved her job and took great care of the babies. 41 years from the game's story, she decided to sign up for the Miss Metropolitan pageant. She rose as a dark horse through the competition, making it all the way to the finals. On the same day as the finals though, a hollow engulfed the hospital she worked at. She immediately abandoned the pageant upon discovering the news, rushing down the red carpet and running straight into the hollow. She eventually made it to the hospital, searching through the rubble and saving as many babies as she could. In her panic, she couldn't remember the names of the babies and just relied on their characteristics and the nickname she gave them, sweetcakes. Her extended stay in the hollow has however, caused her to develop Cognitive Corruption Syndrome in her later years.

Now an old woman, her memory has degraded to the point where all she does it look for "sweetcakes". She acidentally stumbles her way into making Rina help her look for her babies. Her memory regresses even further throughout the quest, to the point she's stuck in that moment where the hollow swallowed the old hospital. Rushing into the hospital to save her "sweetcakes", she ends up needing to be saved by Phaethon and Rina. By the end of the quest, her memory has regressed to the point where she doesn't even remember her babies. She now lives in a nursing home, occasionally being visited by the now grown up babies that she saved.

entries.name: Mockingbird
entries.content: An infamous and mysterious thieves syndicate that steals from the rich and gives to the poor, though their reputation is quite mixed. They once fooled and scammed almost all the wealthy elites of New Eridu. It was originally created by Hugo Vlad and Lycaon but they had a falling out, it's known members are now Hugo Vlad and Vivian.

entries.name: Lilac
entries.content:
Lilac is a privileged but socially isolated young girl from a wealthy family. Her parents spend little time with her, instead entrusting her care to various attendants such as Lycaon.

She is obsessed with comic books and stories about heroes and justice. Her fantasies about these stories have caused her to take on an "edgy" persona, and to try to join the phantom thief organization, Mockingbird.

entries.name: Remodelling Shop
entries.content: The Turbo Remodeling Shop is a store ran by Enzo in Sixth Street. It is a general mechanics store as well as place where Bangboo can be fixed and upgraded.

entries.name: Enzo
entries.content: Enzo is a mechanic and the owner of the Turbo Remodeling Shop in Sixth Street.

entries.name: Old Duyi
entries.content:
Old Duyi is an Intelligent Construct and can be found in Lumina Square near the Lumina Square Coff Cafe.

He is the owner of a Physiotherapy Studio.

entries.name: Orchidea
entries.content: Orchidea is the manager and shopkeeper of the Dew Gardening Shop in Lumina Square.

entries.name: Elfy
entries.content: An Intelligent Construct and the Owner of the Bardic Needle music store.

entries.name: Bangboo 18
entries.content: Bangboo 18 is one of the three Bangboo that work at Random Play, the others being Eous and Bangboo 6. Specifically, Bangboo 18 works at the front counter of the Video Store, and is notable for being the only Promoter that the player is able to assign at the start of the game.

entries.name: Asha
entries.content:
A rabbit Thiren that  is the proprietor and manager of the Godfinger Arcade on Sixth Street.

She is usually found only within the Arcade itself, but occasionally appears on the streets to offer quests or to speak with characters during Trust events.

At first glance she appears to be a human with very pale skin and long hair, but upon closer inspection she is actually a rabbit Beast Thiren. Her long hair when viewed from the front conceals even longer ears that are more noticeable when she is viewed from the side.

Her skin under certain daylight lighting has a unique quality of appearing much less pale. Many of the in game drawings of her in the Event banners also show her as having light colored skin instead of the pale skin she normally has.

She can often be heard lamenting that the player gets to leave Arcade early, wishing she could also leave when she wants ton suggesting that she is very bored with working the counter all day.

entries.name: Susie
entries.content:
Susie is an employee and cashier of the Box Galaxy gadget store in Sixth Street.

Despite being the cashier of Box Galaxy, Susie doesn't know anything about the W-Engines sold from the store and easily believes they are toys when the player and Anby lied about it.

entries.name: Sjal
entries.content:
A freelancer girl whose height barely reaches Wise's eye level, Sjal has indigo hair tied in two side up and red eye color. Similar to other "freelancer girl" NPC, she wears an dark blue overall skirt on top of a green T-shirt and grey capri leggings, as well as white gloves with orange palms and yellow boots with dark grey toes and white straps.

When not working for Random Play or 141 Exclusive Bazaar, Sjal can be occasionally seen handing flyers on Sixth Street promoting various business ranging from selling cakes to second-hand cars and gymnasium lessons. It is unknown if she earns too little or spending too much, she lives a poor life that meals are usually settled with cup noodles and magazines are all borrowed, but at the same time she spends a lot in shopping for toys.

entries.name: Sage in a Barrel
entries.content:
Sage in a Barrel is a person that lives in a trashcan. The Sage gives Dennies, Senior Investigator Log or W-Engine Energy Module with a random quantity for each HIA Commemorative Coin someone hands over. He can be found near the 141 Convenience Store on Sixth Street and near the HIA Club on Lumina Square.

The fact that The Sage retired from human society, disgusted from it, and the title "Sage in a Barrel" itself, both point to a clear reference to the Greek philosopher Diogenes, founder of Cynicism, who is reported to have resorted to sleep in a jar in the agora and beg for a living.
The drawing of a dog in front of a barrel that can be seen pasted on the trashcan is another reference to Diogenes, as the Cynics are thus named from (Greek: κυνικός kynikós) "dog-like", for they lived a simple, animal-like life. Diogenes, in particular, was referred to as the "Dog", a distinction he seems to have reveled in, stating that "other dogs bite their enemies, I bite my friends to save them."

entries.name: Amillion
entries.content: Amillion is Nicole's ever-faithful sidekick and member of the Cunning Hares, where it ranks just below Billy Kid. Its name represents Nicole's dreams and ambitions of getting rich. It is a Bangboo.

entries.name: Butler
entries.content: Butler is the exclusive Bangboo of Victoria Housekeeping, entrusted with handling banquet arrangements and logistics.

entries.name: Safety
entries.content: Safety is one of Belobog Heavy Industries' longest-standing employees and has borne witness to both President Koleda's development and the company's rise to its current stature. It's a diligent worker that is often seen zooming around in its drill machine regardless of whether it's working on a construction site or while engaged in combat.

entries.name: Tully
entries.content: Tully is a Bangnoo and can be found in the HIA Club. Despite being a Bangboo, Tully has a crush on Lyla, the HIA Club Expert Challenge receptionist.

entries.name: Lyla
entries.content: Lyla is can be found in the HIA Club. She's the receptionist for the Expert Challenge program. She can be found alongside Bertha.

entries.name: Bertha
entries.content: Bertha can be found in the HIA Club. She's the receptionist for the Combat Simulation program. She can be found alongside Lyla.

entries.name: Coco
entries.content: Coco is can be found in Lumina Square. She is an employee and promoter of the Richard Teamilk store.

entries.name: Swordmaster
entries.content:
"Swordmaster" is a Thiren from the (old) Eridu Era and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Not much is known about "Swordmaster", aside from the fact that she is the third-generation head of the Hoshimi family, and she has succeeded in defeating the Exaltist overseer. She has raised multiple successors.

Information about her is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

entries.name: Sunbringer
entries.content:
"Sunbringer" is from the (old) Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Not much is known about Sunbringer outside of the fact that she eradicated the "Hive Lord" Hollow in the sky; she is the former CEO of Marcel Group and the inventor of Bangboo. She could be seen holding a blue flag with the logo of Marcel Group.

Information about her is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

Sunbringer is a tall, white-haired woman that holds heterochromatic eyes — orange at the right, and blue on the left. On her head, she seems to hold two mechanical-like horns. She wears a black, long-sleeved coat, and wears high heels, and her cape seems to have a highlight of blue.

entries.name: Joyous
entries.content:
"Joyous" is from the (old) Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Joyous is the Ace of the Investigation Guild, and the predecessor of both Investigators and Proxies, and he has gone through the Divine Maze. He has created the standard for Hollow exploration routes.

Information about him is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

Joyous appears to be a tall, middle-aged man who bears white hair that covers the upper half of his face. His face sports a left brown eye with a scar running down across it. He wears a mask and a ragged coat that extends all the way up his head. He wields multiple arrowhead like objects.

entries.name: Vike
entries.content:
Vike, formally known as Colonel Vike, is from the (old) Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Vike — alongside Lieutenant Colonel Dan and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe — was responsible for pushing the Dark Wall back by thirty-seven kilometers.

Information about her is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

entries.name: Dan
entries.content:
Dan, formally known as Lieutenant Colonel Dan, is from the (old) Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Dan — alongside Colonel Vike and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe — was responsible for pushing the Dark Wall back by thirty-seven kilometers.

Information about them is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

entries.name: Arche
entries.content:
Arche, formally known as Professor Arche, is from the (old) Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter".

Arche is the founder of Helios Academy and was the discoverer of the common characteristics of Hollows. As such, he is also related to the Helios Research Institute, which holds the copyright to the Hollow Deep Dive system. Information about him is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6. Before this database was sealed, Professor Arche delved deeper into Hollow Zero in search of the "truth".

The Helios Research Institute owns the copyright to the Hollow Deep Dive system.

entries.name: Deep Sea Visitor
entries.content:
Although it is an excellent tactical W-Engine due to its efficient freezing and high damage output, Ellen primarily uses it to make frappes.

This high-power W-Engine has the capability to rapidly lower the temperature of the environment, allowing it to instantly freeze nearby objects. Although it is an excellent tactical W-Engine due to its efficient freezing and high damage output, Ellen primarily uses it to make frappes.

"I want to bring it to school, especially in the summer. But Lycaon and Rina won't let me ... So annoying." — Ellen, shaking her head while eating ice

entries.name: Riot Suppressor Mark VI
entries.content: The latest tactical W-Engine used by Public Security's elite Hollow squads. It uses a powerful Ether energy source to supply all combat equipment with explosive power for a short period of time. Although the W-Engines of many elite squad members often suffer from prolonged combat, Zhu Yuan's is in perfect condition. She treats it with utmost care, keeping it looking completely brand new.

entries.name: Steel Cushion
entries.content:
A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with an enhanced motion monitoring feature, perfectly matching the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of Cat Thirens. Nekomata has added a foldable knife to its casing. Despite claiming that this design is to facilitate her in battle, the knife has fresh mackerel stains smeared onto it ...

"Lots of people call me a clever clogs for doing this mod, but when you're out on the streets, you gotta put everything you can to good use: Every little trick, every little thought, every little hustle... And look! A little kitty!" — Nekomata, diverting attention away while secretly trying to fish out the listener's wallet

entries.name: The Brimstone
entries.content:
A violent Obsidian Division W-Engine forged with fire and filled with a forbidden fuel that has been reprocessed using Ether-technology. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield. Rumor has it that its designer was exchanging W-Engine design ideas with Soldier 11 over dinner. After an hour spent enjoying extra spicy noodles, she decided to bring extra spicy revenge to her enemies.

"I really like it. It's stable, efficient, and practical. The high temperature can clean the battle residue off my blade and even disinfect wounds when needed... Why are you sitting so far away? " — Soldier 11, introducing her W-Engine to her teammates

entries.name: Cannon Rotor
entries.content: A high-performance supercomputing W-Engine, capable of collecting real-time data on the battlefield and providing tactical support to its operator. Additionally, it is equipped with mini cannons and can even be deployed as an automatic combat unit in critical moments. In such situations, the operator may become more of a hindrance than a help.

entries.name: Drill Rig - Red Axis
entries.content:
Originally a high-rev W-Engine, it has been modified by Anton with the most expensive rotary drill parts. These modifications allow the engine to temporarily exceed its output limits, enabling it to better serve Anton's "bro." When it comes to anything involving his "bro," Anton spares no expense.

"Ben bought the materials, Grace helped with the modding, and the force was signed off by the president herself... Bro, the blessings of all Belobog are inside you. Let's do this!" — Anton muttering to himself the first time he starts it up

entries.name: Gilded Blossom
entries.content: A W-Engine that represents the brilliance and magnificence of flowers, seemingly crafted from the most luxurious materials. However, after finally dismantling the Ether-powered premium anti-theft device, an experienced thief will discover with terror that this W-Engine... is only gold plated.

entries.name: Housekeeper
entries.content:
An enhanced W-Engine with a high rotation speed. Corin has integrated its shaft portion with a chainsaw to provide additional cutting power for her "cleaning" work. To ensure that her "cleaning" goes smoothly and to minimize the pain inflicted on her target, she has thoughtfully increased the rotation speed to the maximum.

"Um... Don't worry, it won't hurt! Well... I mean, it will only hurt for a moment, and then it won't hurt anymore!" — Corin, attempting to comfort her opponent before attacking

entries.name: Starlight Engine
entries.content: A damage-type W-Engine made of special Ether materials. When its operator is attacked, it builds up energy and boosts its damage output. Although it does not grant the operator the power to transform into a Starlight Knight, it provides a surge of courage when the operator is in dire situations.

entries.name: Starlight Engine Replica
entries.content:
A custom supercomputing W-Engine which specializes in aim assist and calculating trajectories, it looks more like some kind of pirated Starlight Knight figurine now that Billy's finished his modifications. It flashes brightly whenever an enemy is detected and shouts out pre-set quotes. Despite this move clearly exposing one's location and attracting the enemy, this is not an issue for Billy so long as everything is cool enough.

"COPY? How can you call that a copy?! I've poured all of my passion, wisdom, soul, and moisture into this! Apart from summoning a shooting star to transform me — this is a real deal, bona fide Starlight Knight equipment!" —Billy, enthusiastically outlining his modding philosophy.

entries.name: Street Superstar
entries.content:
custom-made W-Engine designed for urban music lovers.

It sacrifices cooling components to make space for expensive speaker modules, just to let your fans, Ethereal and human alike, hear your every word. ——From the streets to the Hollows, this superstar deserves your likes and follows. The bars they spit are flaming hot, enough to make those Ethereals rot.

entries.name: [Lunar] Decrescent
entries.content: A W-Engine with excellent sonic and thermal energy usage, capable of hitting its target with a double whammy. Those hit, be it intentionally or not, have a chance to be diagnosed with snow blindness. The exact cause remains unknown, so obtaining insurance compensation after falling victim to this malady is close to impossible. There was a poor Hollow Investigator who learned it the hard way.

entries.name: [Lunar] Noviluna
entries.content: This high-capacity portable W-Engine can collect dissipated energy from its surroundings, thus enhancing the combat effectiveness of its operator. It is a perfect choice for novice explorers who are worried that their W-Engine may run out of power during expeditions.

entries.name: [Lunar] Pleniluna
entries.content: A W-Engine that prioritizes damage output over noise reduction. It can indiscriminately deal considerable damage to all units nearby. Its designer compares it to the full moon. Bright moonlight can interrupt people's sleep, and nothing can be done about it. But the moonlight does not bother anyone on purpose - you just have to get used to it.

entries.name: Fusion Compiler
entries.content:
Embedded with a supercomputer core, this latest-model W-Engine can compile operating code for machines at an astonishing speed, or quickly collect battlefield data to provide support for the whole squad. Of course, for Grace, this W-Engine is just a little toy for her to communicate with her "silicon-based children."

"Looking carefully... you're handsome in your own way! Oh, it says in the manual that once it's sealed, it shouldn't be opened... Hmmm... Well, how would we know if we don't give it a try ?! " — Grace, suddenly enthusiastic while holding the engine in her hand

entries.name: Electro-Lip Gloss
entries.content: This damage-type W-Engine boasts a built-in current transformer, with its discharge part designed as a protruding lip gloss. It automatically attracts electrically sensitive objects around the operator and deals additional damage to them. Such is not the power of love, but rather the Lorentz force generated by a 1,000-volt electric field.

entries.name: Rainforest Gourmet
entries.content:
A consumer-class W-Engine launched by an exotic pet fan club to promote pet culture.

It used to be a popular model until three customers' fingers, a staff member, and half a Bangboo disappeared into a Gourmet's big mouth. Ether blocks generated by the mouth module can rapidly devour substances. Please avoid putting your head and limbs inside.

entries.name: Roaring Ride
entries.content:
This energy W-Engine, modded from spare parts of a truck's engine, converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous. It placed first in the internal Chototsumōshin competition, surpassing many heavy-duty motorbikes and even a truck driven by Piper herself.

"Too bad there's no way to carry cargo... Maybe we can hang it on the tusks?" — Piper, top-notch logistics driver

entries.name: Weeping Gemini
entries.content: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Though it's made from scrapped parts, it still caused some distress among Bangboo lovers. "No Bangboo were hurt during the production of this W-Engine." — the manufacturer had to include this note on the packaging due to protests from Bangboo rights organizations.

entries.name: [Magnetic Storm] Alpha
entries.content: This special W-Engine can analyze the target's weak spots through real-time calculations. Although its heavy exoskeleton can be a burden to the operator, some users have found it to be an efficient way to exercise and lose weight, and have thus become loyal customers.

entries.name: [Magnetic Storm] Bravo
entries.content: This damage-type W-Engine features enhanced movement detection modules that can detect the operator's status in real-time and boost their combat prowess at critical moments to optimize battle efficiency. After the operator completes the finishing move, the W-Engine emits a dazzling multicolored flash and rates the operator's move.

entries.name: [Magnetic Storm] Charlie
entries.content: A high-capacity W-Engine that features a built-in generator, allowing it to keep a stable storage of electrical power without any manual operation from the operator. As a result, it proves to be exceptionally used in battle as its electric current can stun tough enemies.

entries.name: Big Cylinder
entries.content: This powerful protection-type W-Engine, characterized by thick oil engines that ceaselessly roar inside it, can even provide sufficient power for heavy machinery. Although its weight is so immense that ordinary people would not be able to lift it, it is just right for Ben to use it as a counterweight ball for his concrete pillar.

entries.name: Bunny Band
entries.content: A special W-Engine decorated with a fluffy bunny. Although it is a mere imitation of the real animal, even the fiercest of Hollow Raiders can relieve stress by petting their bunnies while taking a break, which enhances their combat performance. There are many similar models in this series of W-Engines: a portable bunny, a foldable bunny, a furless bunny... Everyone can find one they will not be able to refuse.

entries.name: Original Transmorpher
entries.content: An epic W-Engine favored by Starlight Knight fans. Its high popularity and scarcity marketing strategy have caused an influx of knock-offs. "Using a fake transmorpher will only turn you into a villain's minion!" said its distributor at the product launch conference. Did you see that mighty kick that can send any evil-doer flying? Such is the power of the original product license!

entries.name: Spring Embrace
entries.content: A special W-Engine equipped with a temperature regulator where residual heat generated by the W-Engine's high frequency is funneled into the hot springs on its surface. The owner of this W-Engine can drink hot spring soup with all its spring warmth in front of frost-covered enemies. Of course, some people think it's like drinking bath water.

entries.name: [Identity] Base
entries.content: A W-Engine with a component structure adjusted according to specific parameters. It can enhance the defensive capabilities of those who have a certain style of combat. If the user does not meet the requirements for this W-Engine, then carrying it would be like lugging around an over-sized shield in battle.

entries.name: [Identity] Inflection
entries.content: A functional W-Engine that specializes in energy conversion. It can analyze combat environments and generate special sounds to disrupt the enemy's attack. However, when facing a strong-willed enemy, you will still need to seize the right opportunity to attack. Luckily, most Ethereals lack the willpower to resist it.

entries.name: Hellfire Gears
entries.content:
This W-Engine is renowned for its ultra power. Modified by Koleda, its energy level has almost exceeded the safety limit. Although this W-Engine is entirely designed for damage output, and the Speedup and Blaze functions have been merged into one, this is precisely what Koleda wanted.

"I've got a clear shot at your shins, you know? So you'd better think twice before saying I'm short, got it?" — Koleda, warning a rude business partner.

entries.name: Ice-Jade Teapot
entries.content:
A custom stun W-Engine made for an Automaton referencing the combat style and abilities of one. Energy is stored within, then lashes outwards upon conversion. The texture seeks to imitate fine artistry that was once highly sought after in ancient civilizations: Burn to procure what is sleek and elegant, shatter to create what is unyielding and sharp; this heat-proof pot bears a sacred bird shape with, as its name suggests, a unique pattern of ice-cracked celadon... but actually that pattern was drawn on.

"It fares well in preserving temperature, and I can drink hot water whenever I need even in a Hollow." —Qingyi, giving her honest and carefully contemplated review.

entries.name: The Restrained
entries.content:
This special W-Engine has the capability to create extreme low temperatures. Its radiator opening was designed with an eerie animal teeth decoration and often drips condensation. After Lycaon's improvements, its rough appearance has become much more refined and elegant, and the opening is now utilized to store envelopes and other keepsakes.

"Manners aren't a leash for wildness; it enhances it before it's set free." — Lycaon, speaking gently during a tea party.

entries.name: Demara Battery Mark II
entries.content:
This customized W-Engine Core focuses on power storage and has been modified to enhance power storage functions. It can effectively boost Zap damage output for weapons, and is the gadget store owner's pièce de résistance. Not long after, Anby made some tweaks based on user habits, but judging by how serious and careful she is while conducting each maintenance session, these are probably not the safest of modifications.

"Weapons SHOULD be dangerous. If it can't shock me, then how is it going to shock the enemy?" — Anby's response while carefully performing maintenance.

entries.name: Precious Fossilized Core
entries.content: A special W-Engine whose outer shell is made of composite Etheric matter that effectively absorb incoming impacts in combat and turn it against the enemy. Rumors suggest that its prototype was crafted by a legendary Hollow explorer, and despite its ancient appearance, it continues to run smoothly. This W-Engine is literally an "old timer" in the field of W-Engines.

entries.name: Six Shooter
entries.content: A special W-Engine modeled after a revolver. It can apparently load six bullet-shaped condensed Ether batteries, which release a significant amount of power when fired. It is said that as long as you carry this W-Engine, you will be able to spontaneously learn how to whistle and will occasionally reference old movies in a cowboy voice.

entries.name: Steam Oven
entries.content: This high-power W-Engine boasts a cutting-edge energy conversion device that collects heat from its surroundings and supplies it to the steamer, making it easy for the operator to cook or heat up objects. This makes it a perfect choice for Hollow explorers. However... please be careful when using it to avoid burns.

entries.name: [Vortex] Arrow
entries.content: A tactical W-Engine that locates enemies using high-frequency sound waves. Once it has marked its targets, it will activate its aiming aid to make the operator's precision attack more deadly. While this feature increases the operator's efficiency in battles, it may occasionally attract curious Ethereals from afar.

entries.name: [Vortex] Hatchet
entries.content: This inverter W-Engine can generate excessive power and effectively increase its operator's battle prowess. However, due to its poor heat dissipation, it emits ear-splitting noise during battle. As a result, all squad members will need to wear earplugs.

entries.name: [Vortex] Revolver
entries.content: An energy-storage type W-Engine with a unique operation circuit. It will absorb scattered energy up to a certain amount before unleashing it, dealing some extra impact. It's impossible to control when that energy is unleashed, but when it is, it'll give you the joy of winning a prize draw.

entries.name: Weeping Cradle
entries.content:
A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It contains a special Ether charging layer that can quickly recharge special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. Even though this W-Engine looks like a cruel confinement chamber, Rina's Bangboo seem to enjoy sneaking in there to recharge their batteries. They even treat resting inside as a cozy reward.

"Shhh... The two little ones are resting; if they're woken suddenly they'll be sure to cause a ruckus. Let's avoid making any noise while we enjoy our tea." — Rina, giving a gentle reminder as she serves tea to friends.

entries.name: Bashful Demon
entries.content:
An intricate W-Engine developed by Section 6 and later modified using the technology of a certain martial arts clan. It can control Ether particles to form an energy field and boasts a terrifying appearance that can easily silence a crying child! If you are unfortunate enough to face its wicked stare, then just wait until it unfurls its fangs. What lies inside is... Don't laugh! This poor little thing really hurts when it hits you!

"Hmm... Instead of a cool mask, I'd rather carry another lunchbox... I'll go ask Nagi if I can pack some snacks in it!" — Soukaku, excitedly running to the Section 6 office

entries.name: Kaboom the Cannon
entries.content:
A support W-Engine propelled by jets that is both mobile and impactful, it can traverse the entire battlefield providing combat buffs. Not only is it practical, but it's the biggest imaginary enemy and most-feared sparring partner of Grassy, Woody, and Bricky. The little boars can hear Lucy say in their nightmares.

"If you can't do it, go train with Kaboom!" — Lucy, lecturing her three loyal guard boars.

entries.name: Slice of Time
entries.content: A special W-Engine equipped with a high-speed camera module. The best choice for in-Hollow photography enthusiasts. It captures every touching moment spent beating up your Ethereal friends, as long as you have a free hand to press the shutter. P.S. The internal optical components have not undergone anti-corruption treatment. Please do not lose the warranty form.

entries.name: The Vault
entries.content: A cost-effective W-Engine that focuses on energy storage. After Nicole modified its internal space, it can now be used as a storage box. While the gold coins stored inside are fake, they may catch greedy Hollow Raiders off guard. Or rather, the operator can simply toss the heavy coins at them and knock them out.

entries.name: Unfettered Game Ball
entries.content: A new supercomputing W-Engine, featuring cutting-edge integrated chips that dynamically monitor the battlefield and provide tactical analysis for its user. Furthermore, this W-Engine can serve as a portable console, allowing its user to play the most popular video games anytime, anywhere. However, it is not advisable to use the speakers while playing games... Especially not in Hollow areas frequented by Ethereals.

entries.name: [Reverb] Mark I
entries.content: This special W-Engine features a built-in sonic generator that converts collected energy into penetrating infrasound waves, thereby boosting its damage output. However, to activate this function, the operator needs to charge up enough power, and the first step of charging up is to use up any remaining energy in the W-Engine.

entries.name: [Reverb] Mark II
entries.content:
A standardized W-Engine with balanced performance. Despite lacking any particular tendencies, it enhances its owner's and it's owner's teammates' combat effectiveness in all aspects. For
novice explorers who have not figured out their preferred combat style, this W-Engine is an excellent choice.

entries.name: [Reverb] Mark III
entries.content: This special W-Engine features motion capture algorithms that monitor the status of the operator's teammates, enabling it to send signals to coordinate tactical movements and enhance the overall combat competency of the squad. However, this premise assumes that everyone can keep up with its signals instead of stepping on other members' toes...

entries.name: Ether Mutants
entries.content:
Ether Mutants are an Enemy Faction, referring to Ethereals that have been fully corrupted by the Hollows.

Most Ether Mutants have a defining feature which is a pitch-black sphere located near their head, referred to as their Core. Most mutants have an Energized counterpart which have a weakness to Fire and resist Electric. Some Elite Enemies can have Ionized counterparts, who have a weakness to Ether and resist Ice, while others can hold Notorious counterparts, have more defense.

entries.name: Thugs
entries.content:
Thugs are an Enemy Faction that reside inside the Hollows.

Thugs are members of gangs that mainly perform their activities in the Hollows. Most of them exhibit mental problems or peculiar quirks, except for Poachers and Rustlers. The Raiders and Looters are the core members of these gangs, due to having technical expertise and combat skills.

Their variants have their look and role change, usually with more equipment. The elite enemies have their wanted level raised and switch their horns from grey to orange. They could also be the originating cause of the Corrupted, in such that they become corrupted with Ether and turn into Ethereals.

entries.name: Corrupted
entries.content:
Corrupted are an Enemy Faction, classified by either being a human or a machine that was corrupted by the Ether matter yet had not completely transformed at still retained their features.

Corrupted Bandits are humans that have a high Ether Aptitude that had been corrupted. Due to their aptitude, the corruption has not been able to fully envelop them, causing them to keep their humanoid form. The Unknown Corruption Complex was considered as corrupted because it had been able to corrupt various machines.

entries.name: Rebel Soldiers
entries.content:
Rebel Soldiers are an Enemy Faction, classified as rogue members of the New Eridu Defense Force.

Rebel Soldiers are enemies that have defected from the Defense Force. They usually have a weakness to Fire and Physical attacks, while their Elite Enemies have a resistance to Ether. Their variants sport a more visually metallic look, and now hold a weakness to Electric, and Elite Enemies have a resistance to Fire.

entries.name: Ahriman
entries.content:
Ahriman is an Ethereal.

Due to its unique and grotesque shape, Ahriman is often mistaken for an art sculpture in the Ballet Twins.
As a result, many novice Investigators are left with lifelong trauma when they first encounter an Ahriman...
You just passed by a certain "sculpture" when it suddenly moves...
And that fearful moment frozen in place is the perfect moment for Ahriman to launch a surprise attack.

entries.name: Alpeca
entries.content:
Alpeca is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

The Hollow Investigative Association has limited research on Alpeca. After briefly studying its behavioral pattern of spewing liquid Ether, the Association classified Alpeca as a low-threat Ethereal and ended its investigation.
Scholars once showed great interest in observing how Alpeca spews liquefied Ether and even commissioned surveys for closer observation.
Experienced investigators have been avoiding such tasks for unknown reasons, however.

entries.name: Beholder Engine
entries.content:
Beholder Engine is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

While a Beholder Engine is primarily considered a close-range threat, it frequently presents unforeseen dangers to Investigators during Hollow expeditions.
Even seasoned Investigators can experience an overwhelming sense of panic when confronted by the piercing gaze of its eyes in the darkness.
Within the Hollows, fear has a tendency to intensify Ether corruption, thereby inviting calamity.
"The only way to overcome fear... is to stare into it and fight it back."

—Compilation of Knowledge from a Senior Investigator on the Planet of Disaster forum

entries.name: Blastcrawler
entries.content:
Blastcrawler is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

According to research reports conducted by the Hollow Investigative Association, Blastcrawlers, with their low mobility and causing only small explosions, are classified as a "low-threat," "non-concern" lower-tier Ethereal.
However, astute businessmen have recognized the opportunities presented by their rounded bodies and short legs.
A film titled "Roll Over, Little Blastcrawler" gained significant popularity, leading to the sale of merchandise like Blastcrawler dolls and pillows at remarkably high prices.
"I didn't expect their dolls to be more deadly than the real deal... On your wallet at least. Looks like I'll be surviving on instant noodles next month, Billy..."

—Anby checking her wallet in front of the shopping street crane machine.

entries.name: Faun
entries.content:
Faun is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

A living humanoid Ether that was first spotted in the Hollow in the New Eridu metro. It once raised debate among the Hollow Investigative Association, as some believed it to be living Ether converted from the Corrupted, while others claimed it to be pure living Ether affected by the Hollow environment. The Association considers it of low threat due to its limited intelligence, but one should never underestimate them, as they usually appear in groups.
"Have you ever been late or fined because of a red light? Feels terrible, right?"
"Well, here's your chance to blow off some steam!"

—"Planet of Disaster" forum, comment from user "Waitin4BangbooPricetoDrop"

entries.name: Hoplitai
entries.content:
Hoplitai is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

While categorized by the Hollow Investigative Association as a "low threat" Ethereal, Hoplitai prove to be a formidable opponent for novice Hollow Raiders and Investigators.
Its forelimbs are covered in a thick inert Ether matter, serving as both a tough shield and an intimidating weapon.
The only drawback is its top-heavy appearance, making it not look very clever.
"Alright, guys... Check out this sorry excuse... This is Hoplitai."
"When Ethereals gather together to play rock-paper-scissors, this idiot always plays paper!"

—Hollow Zoo, special episode about Hoplitai

entries.name: Ionized - Nacelia
entries.content:
Ionized - Nacelia is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Each type of Ether mutant in the Hollow exhibits unique fighting styles.
Some are merciless, others cunning, and a few even display a sense of... honor.
Among them, Nacelia is particularly distinctive.
It often remains motionless out in the open, gathering potent Ether around itself before unleashing its destructive power to eliminate all enemies within its vicinity for other Ethereals.
While Nacelia is channeling its energy, those accompanying Ethereals engage in frenzied attacks, buying time for the Nacelia to unleash its devastating attack.
"Quick! Stop that guy! Don't let it unleash its ultimate attack!"
"If we get hit by that attack, we'll end up like those sorry villains in those cliche hero animations!"

—Several investigators besieging a Nacelia within a Hollow

entries.name: Ionized - Setoria
entries.content:
Ionized - Setoria is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

According to Hollow Raiders, Setoria's hunting tactics bear resemblance to those of a shark.
It stealthily prowls in the shadows, lurking beneath the surface, and swiftly strikes its prey with deadly precision much like a shark.
Analysis of the data suggests that Setoria likely relies on ground vibrations to track the movements of its prey. Skilled Hollow Raiders evade detection by constantly altering the rhythm of their footsteps.
"Back in my investigator days, my area was crawling with Setorias."
"Their attacks had me hopping and jumping all over the place to dodge them..."
"Looking back, it's funny how I unintentionally became a tap dancer..."

—"Back 2 Life" Episode 131, an interview featuring Ansor, a renowned master tap-dancer

entries.name: Mandrake
entries.content:
Mandrake is an Ethereal encountered in combat.

Mandrake derive their name from a toxic herb. The scholar who initially assigned the name believed there was a resemblance between the two solely based on appearance.
While blooming, Mandrake emit heat rays targeting nearby objects, while sturdy leaves anchor it firmly to the ground, preventing uprooting. When threatened, Mandrake may use their sharp leaves for self-defense.
Similar to the legend of their namesake, Mandrake cries can be highly deadly.
"Stay away! It's gonna bloom any second now!"

—Mandrake blooming in the movie Deep Fear

entries.name: Specter
entries.content:
Specter is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Influenced by the distinctive decor of the interior of the Ballet Twins, Specters have the grotesque and twisted limb configuration of an artistic sculpture.
Some Investigators believe its unique shape is intended to enhance the protection of its Ether Core.
Others argue it's merely a trick designed to distract its enemies. While its enemies are mesmerized by its peculiar posture, a Specter will seize the opportunity to launch long-range attacks using concentrated Ether.
"I looked at its bizarre structure and thought to myself: Was it trying to play a game of bowling with its own head?"
"But before I could make sense of anything, its bowling ball had already smashed into my face..."

—Posted by an anonymous user on Inter-Knot

entries.name: Tyrfing
entries.content:
Tyrfing is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

The Hollow Investigative Association has been studying Tyrfing's behavioral patterns, and research results show that its seemingly unbalanced stance of swaying and skewing is, in fact, a highly efficient stance for launching successive slashing attacks.
Due to its frequent appearances and aggressive behavior, Tyrfing has been identified as one of the most deadly Ethereals in the Hollow, particularly for certain Hollow personnel.
When faced with a shielded enemy, it relentlessly launches attacks until either its enemy or itself is destroyed.
"Perhaps... they don't actually hate us, but just think of us as punching bags for practice?"

—Midnight talk show "Back 2 Life," Episode 165, featuring retired riot patrol officer due to injury, Nobby Kereyan

entries.name: Arlaune
entries.content:
Arlaune is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

Many novice Hollow Raiders who come across an Arlaune - Energized for the first time are often deceived by its appearance, mistakenly assuming it to be a harmless plant.
However, upon approaching it, they discover that Arlaune - Energized release a concentrated discharge of Ether matter, catching their unsuspecting victims off guard.
"Huh? I tried to water it, and it spat at me?"

—A group of rookie Investigators ambushed by an Arlaune - Energized in a Hollow

entries.name: Armored Hati
entries.content:
Armored Hati is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat. It's a variant of the Ethereal, Hati.

The Armored Hati is widely regarded as a formidable adversary by many experienced Hollow Investigators.
Although its armored shell limits its agility, it compensates with exceptional resistance to attacks.
Additionally, the corrupted material on its body forms sharp and hardened protrusions that can cause additional damage when an Armored Hati charges at high speeds.
This creature's agile movements, resilience to blows, and seamless armor compel even the most seasoned explorers to seek alternative routes to avoid direct confrontation.
Some novice Hollow Raiders have attempted to lure Armored Hati away with pet food.
However, these endeavors have proven futile.
"Run! It doesn't like this flavor of dog food!"

—Several panicked rookie Hollow Raiders escaping from a Hati in a Hollow

entries.name: Dullahan
entries.content:
Dullahan is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

A potent humanoid living Ether, initially observed in the Laketown Hollow and documented by the Third Investigation Team of the Hollow Investigative Association. The exact correlation between these living Ether beings and the downfall of the lakeside town known as Blaise remains uncertain.
Due to their immense power and formidable fighting style, the HIA has labeled them as highly dangerous and advises novice Investigators avoid direct confrontations with them.
"Don't let it activate its sword, and if it already has... just don't get cut."

—Excerpt from interview with an Investigator on the variety show "Teach Me, Senpai!"

entries.name: Farbauti
entries.content:
Farbauti is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Farbauti, possessing immense strength and often in a frenzied state, is one of the most formidable threats Hollow Raiders may face. Its hammer-like arms can effortlessly deflect damage and unleash storms of blows that crush everything in its path.
Some Hollow Raiders have observed Farbauti frequently pounding the ground in a rhythmic, high-frequency manner, leading to speculation about its peculiar interest in drumming music.
Despite the Hollow Investigative Association publicly debunking this rumor, many Hollow Raiders carry portable stereos in an attempt to distract Farbauti with music.
No successful escapes using this method have been reported however.
"The reason for their failure is simple: Even Farbauti think your taste in music sucks!"

—Posted by "Spike Finger" on the Black-Sweeper's Rock Forum

entries.name: Goblin
entries.content:
Goblin is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

During initial encounters with these unique Ethereals, Hollow investigators mistakenly thought they possessed some level of intelligence, even showing signs of learning to wield bludgeoning weapons like humans. As a result, they were dubbed "Goblins."
However, subsequent research revealed that their "hammers" were actually twisted and deformed limbs, and that they lacked the ability to imitate human behavior.
Nevertheless, Goblins remain formidable adversaries due to their robust physique and sheer brute strength, with even a simple swing of their limbs proving deadly.
If anything trespasses on their territory, they will immediately enter a state of fury, sparing no effort in mercilessly smashing the intruder.
"Huh? There's a Goblin running over here, banging on a heap of scrap metal."
"Don't you think his attacks have a rhythm to them, like he's playing a drum...?"
"Hey! Don't be stupid, you two! That's not scrap metal! It's our supply truck!"

—A Goblin intruder breaks into a gang hideout

entries.name: Hati
entries.content:
Hati is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

The HIA Phase-I Investigation Team has officialy documented the existence of this sentient living Ether resembling a four-legged beast, which poses significant danger.
Hollow, where individuals exploring the nerby wastes reported hearing ear-splitting roars reminiscent of wild animal growls.
"If I throw a stick or a ball, do you think that monster will catch it?"
"You can give it a try, but I wont cover your medical bill."

— A chat between Billy and Nicole

entries.name: Hornet
entries.content:
Hornet is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Zero exploration.

Hornets always seem to be buzzing around Nineveh. Some scholars believe that the two have formed a symbiotic relationship and that, in some respects, they have reached a kind of group coordination.
As Nineveh's energy increases, revealing its distinctive swaying blossom stance, the Hornets enter a frenzied state and try their best to attack any moving target nearby.
"Hey! Something just flew out of that 'flower'!"
"Looks like... a swarm of wasps?"

— Hollow Zero Investigation File KU241. Voice recording of the first recorded Hornet sighting.

entries.name: Metro Goblin
entries.content:
Metro Goblin is an Ethereal encountered during combat, it is a variant of Goblin.

The debate regarding Metro Goblin is a persistent one. Some scholars argue their peculiar appearance serves as camouflage to confuse their enemies, while others attribute the debris on their bodies to corruption and fusion with old metro equipment.
Nevertheless, the presence of Metro Goblins evokes fear among inexperienced Investigators exploring the Hollow's old metro zone.
At any given moment, an ordinary-looking "road sign" may start trembling, and then a formidable Ethereal emerges from the ground, charging menacingly.
"Huh? I saw this sign a few minutes ago. Have we been going in circles?"
"No... That 'road sign' has been following us!"

—The horror movie Eternal Lost, the main character looking for a way out of the Hollow

entries.name: Tarasque Mixer
entries.content:
Tarasque Mixer is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Based on their research, the Hollow Investigative Association speculates the Tarasque Mixer contains various levels of liquefied Ether.
When it stirs and mixes its stored Ether, a complex reaction takes place, resulting in the release of destructive and violent energy. The power unleashed is comparable to that of the heavy artillery employed by the Defense Force.
