Experienced Investigators understand the importance of maintaining a low profile to avoid direct bombardment from its heavy artillery.
"When it leaned down towards me, I thought it was some kind of strange welcoming gift. But when its cannon chamber lit up, I realized... it was a farewell gift."

—Interview on Back 2 Life, celebrity Investigator's personal experiences

entries.name: Thanatos
entries.content:
Thanatos is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Hollow exploration can be mentally distressing, and Thanatos, with its unique teleportation ability and unpredictable attack patterns, has become a common psychological challenge among Hollow Raiders.
A considerable number of individuals who have faced Thanatos alone in the Hollow have lost all courage to continue their ventures and instead chosen to retire prematurely.
As a result, these elusive entities have become recurring figures in horror movies.
"The slender shadow disappears before your eyes and reappears behind you..."
"What should I do? Now I'm too scared to even go to the restroom alone..."

—Night of the premiere of the horror movie "Ethereal Comes Knocking," trending discussion thread on the "Copper Plum" movie review website

entries.name: Black Veil Marionette
entries.content:
Black Veil Marionette is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat. It is theorized that this is one of the twin sisters that died at the Ballet Twins Tower. Alongside Gray Veil Marionette.

Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
Rumors suggest that on the day of the performance, the sisters encountered three ominous signs of impending doom. However, driven by their obsession with the stage, applause, and glory, they chose to continue the performance despite the warnings.
Today, only a few images of the elder sister remain, preserved in photographs on yellowed magazines.
Only a few elite Hollow Raiders know that when the shattered spotlight illuminates Ballet Twins once more, the enigmatic Black Veil Marionette emerges. This figure is believed to be connected to Augilia, the dancer from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale she was never able to complete.
As for those who have the "fortune" to witness her grand finale, they will be haunted by nightmares that last a lifetime.
"If you run into Marionette in the Ballet Twins, don't even think about running away."
"Just sit back and watch her grand finale!" "At least it's a graceful and decent way to die..."

—Inter-Knot forum, comment from a rookie Hollow Raider.

entries.name: Gray Veil Marionette
entries.content:
Gray Veil Marionette is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat. Alongside the Black Veil Marionette.

Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
It is rumored that on the day of the performance, the sisters encountered three ominous signs of impending doom. However, some also believe that they had offended certain forces, ultimately falling victim to the masterminds under the disguise of the "Hollow Disaster," and that the so-called "ominous signs" might have been well-intentioned warnings.
Today, the truth remains buried forever in darkness, as most people can only catch glimpses of the younger sister Augetta's lively dance through scattered video materials.
Only a few elite Hollow Raiders know that when the forgotten dance music echoes within the Ballet Twins, the ethereal figure of Gray Veil Marionette emerges. This figure is believed to be connected to Augetta, the dancer from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale she was never able to complete.
Her elegant dance steps no longer bring love and beauty to the audience but endless death and despair.
"I can't tell if the Marionette I saw was the elder or the younger sister..."
"Argh! It's not that I don't appreciate art. I just can't tell them apart!"

— A post published by a certain Hollow Raider on Inter-Knot.

entries.name: Dead End Butcher
entries.content:
The Dead End Butcher is an Ethereal.

Unlike other highly dangerous Ethereals, the Ether within the Dead End Butcher's body often remains in a low-activity dormant state.
Nevertheless, it possesses immense brute strength capable of demolishing any obstacles, and the entire twisted and ravaged metro zone serves as its off-limits kitchen.
Only when a threatening target piques its interest will a horrifying transformation take place...
Within moments, the high concentration of Ether stored in its body undergoes a violent transformation and the exponentially surging energy prompts its limbs to quickly distort, assuming a more brutal and voracious "feeding stance".
The time for "appetizers" is over, and an unparalleled "feast" is about to begin.
Anyone who doesn't want to be part of this feast should be extremely cautious in choosing their route and stay away from its "kitchen" at all costs.
"The paths within the Hollows are complex, but one thing's for sure when it appears at the end of the road, that path is a 'dead end.'"

—Hollow Investigative Association's 17th Dead End Hollow Investigation.

entries.name: Nineveh
keys: Symbiotic Ethereal Swarm - Code Name: Nineveh
entries.content:
Symbiotic Ethereal Swarm - Code Name: Nineveh, or Nineveh for short, is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Zero exploration.

The unique and magnificent appearance of the symbiotic Ethereal swarm known as Nineveh make it "difficult" for people to be wary of it.
According to the few research records available, as Nineveh extends its body, a concentrated and potent Ether flows towards its core through its "rhizome," providing a constant supply of energy. Some scholars speculate that this behavior is akin to the photosynthesis process in plants.
In the course of its swaying motions, excess highly active Ether energy continuously pours out. When this accumulation of highly active Ether is nearly overflowing, it transforms, unveiling its true "blossoming" form.
And with its bloom comes death.
"The good news is it doesn't mean any harm, it just absorbs nutrients for photosynthesis. The bad news is... we're the nutrients."

—Defense Force Hollow Zero Investigation Log K-411

entries.name: Corrupted Bandit - Greedy Ranger
entries.content:
Corrupted Bandit - Greedy Ranger is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

This humanoid intelligent being is a result of potent Ether matter corruption in the Hollow, exhibiting both humanoid traits and remnants of its former clothing and combat style. It is likely that it was once a gang member or raider living in the Hollow.
The creature's physical characteristics indicate its past as a long-range weapon specialist. Despite losing its free will and life due to Etherealization, it retains its instincts and habits for long-range combat. Its corrupted form enables it to launch projectiles, attacking enemies from a distance. The Ether corruption has enhanced its shooting abilities and projectile firepower. (For example, these creatures may fire sharp Ether Crystals or mixed explosives.)
"I told him not to touch that crystal, but he wouldn't listen! That reckless idiot never listens! By the time we were about to leave the Hollow, he... he changed..."

—Faunus Quarter Public Security Office Branch, Record of an Interrogation

entries.name: Corrupted Bandit - Vicious Striker
entries.content:
Vicious Striker is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

A poor soul mutated by the corruption due to potent Ether matter in the Hollows. As the original entity had a certain level of Ether aptitude, the transformation is not fully complete, retaining some humanoid features of the original form. Judging by the remnants of clothing and combat experience, it's quite likely it was originally a thug/criminal dwelling within the Hollow.
While gangsters and thugs in the Hollows typically wear anti-corruption gear, some unlucky individuals undergo monstrous transformations due to severe Ether corruption. These transformed Ethereal beings retain their combat skills from their past lives, making them a more formidable threat compared to pure Ethereals.
"They lived as criminals, and even in death they continue being a nuisance."

—A New Eridu Public Security discussion post on the Planet of Disaster forum

entries.name: Corrupted Bandit - Frenzied Maniac
entries.content:
Corrupted Bandit - Frenzied Maniac is an Ethereal encountered during Hollow Combat.

The Hollow Investigative Association has limited research on Frenzied Maniac. After briefly studying its behavioral pattern of spewing liquid Ether, the Association classified Frenzied Maniac as a low-threat Ethereal and ended its investigation.
Scholars once showed great interest in observing how Frenzied Maniac spews liquefied Ether and even commissioned surveys for closer observation.
Experienced investigators have been avoiding such tasks for unknown reasons, however.
"Run! They're spitting again... Oh, no! My new clothes!"

—Anby's analysis of a particular operation with the Cunning Hares

entries.name: Corrupted Bandit - Wicked Wraith
entries.content:
Wicked Wraith is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

A poor soul mutated by the corruption due to potent Ether matter in the Hollows. As the original entity had a certain level of Ether aptitude, the transformation is not fully complete, retaining some humanoid features of the original form. Judging by the remnants of clothing and combat experience, it's quite likely it was originally a thug/criminal dwelling within the Hollow.
While gangsters and thugs in the Hollows typically wear anti-corruption gear, some unlucky individuals undergo monstrous transformations due to severe Ether corruption. These transformed Ethereal beings retain their combat skills from their past lives, making them a more formidable threat compared to pure Ethereals.
"They lived as criminals, and even in death they continue being a nuisance."

—A New Eridu Public Security discussion post on the Planet of Disaster forum

entries.name: Corrupted Bandit - Ruthless Fiend
entries.content:
Ruthless Fiend is an Ethereal encountered during combat.

Unfortunate souls mutated by the intense corruption of Ether matter within the Hollows. Due to a considerable degree of Ether aptitude and physical capability, their bodies have not been completely transformed by the Ether, retaining humanoid features but with enhanced mutant limbs that are more dangerous.
Judging from the remnants of clothing and combat experience, likely once a senior gang member or Raider lurking in the Hollows.
These corrupted subjects, potentially due to their enhanced physiology or affinity for Ether matter, have developed formidable close combat abilities, making them even more menacing than the typical monsters found in the Hollow.
"Their weapons look very fancy... and kinda like they came as freebies."

—Annotations in the internal textbook of the Hollow Investigative Association, "Threat Identification in a Hollow: Corrupted Subjects"

entries.name: Unknown Corruption Complex
entries.content:
A strange Ethereal.

Belobog's founder, Khors Belobog, once said that construction machines are the combination of strength and beauty with attention to every detail following the principles of classic mechanical design.
However, the emergence of the Unknown Corruption Complex has challenged all established classic designs.
Driven by an intensely concentrated Ether Core, various formidable engineering components have been brutally assembled, resulting in an exaggerated structure that pushes the limits of physical boundaries.
It incorporates cutting, hammering, drilling, and crushing techniques... transforming them into rough and unpredictable combat maneuvers.
Furthermore, in its critical state, its Ether Core provides an inexhaustible source of volatile energy. This enables it to envelop its carapace with high-voltage currents and unleash devastating blasts capable of ripping through the ground and pulverizing nearby enemies.
According to HIA speculation, the Unknown Corruption Complex is able to devour and assimilate a wide range of heavy machinery, including military mechs, laser weapon, and even the short-range missiles of the Defense Force...
Every intricate mechanical object it encounters is consumed, dissected, and ultimately assimilated into its structure.
Its design objective is to achieve unrivaled destructive power and maximize efficiency in its relentless slaughter.
"Its design far too strange... Oh, alright, I'll just take one more look!"
—Grace on observing an Unknown Corruption Complex deep in a Hollow.

entries.name: Golden Bangboo
entries.content:
Every Hollow Raider believes there are infinite opportunities in the Hollows that can make you rich overnight. At the heart of every tale of extraordinary wealth is always mention of a special entity known as the Golden Bangboo.
According to research conducted by the HIA, numerous Bangboo Wanderers inhabit the Hollows. They diligently gather scattered Gear Coins and Dennies, entrusting them to the Golden Bangboo for safekeeping.
While their motives remain a mystery, one thing is certain: These wandering Bangboo, with their peculiar "Ehn-ne" sound diligently fill the pockets of the Golden Bangboo with bags overflowing with Gear Coins and Dennies.
As a result, the Golden Bangboo always finds themselves coveted by greedy groups of Hollow Raiders...
"N—NicoIe!? Look there, a Golden Bangboo!"
"What are you waiting for? Smash it to bits! It'll make us rich!"

—The Cunning Hares desperately chasing after a Golden Bangboo deep within a Hollow.

entries.name: Platinum Bangboo
entries.content:
A variant of the Golden Bangboo.

Every Hollow Raider believes there are infinite opportunities in the Hollows that can make you rich overnight. At the heart of every tale of extraordinary wealth is always mention of a special entity known as the Golden Bangboo.
According to research conducted by the HIA, numerous Bangboo Wanderers inhabit the Hollows. They diligently gather scattered Gear Coins and Dennies, entrusting them to the Golden Bangboo for safekeeping.
While their motives remain a mystery, one thing is certain: These wandering Bangboo, with their peculiar "Ehn-ne" sound diligently fill the pockets of the Golden Bangboo with bags overflowing with Gear Coins and Dennies.
As a result, the Golden Bangboo always finds themselves coveted by greedy groups of Hollow Raiders...
"N—NicoIe!? Look there, a Golden Bangboo!"
"What are you waiting for? Smash it to bits! It'll make us rich!"

—The Cunning Hares desperately chasing after a Golden Bangboo deep within a Hollow

entries.name: Friday
entries.content:
A machine.

At the moment a high concentration of Ether infiltrated its backup flash drive, a deluge of data flooded into Friday's memory.
Images, audio files, video files... A huge assortment of files overwhelmed its limited processing capacity.
At that fateful moment, Friday experienced a realization.
It stood there for a while, eventually confirming through repeated searches in the database the reason behind the "anomaly" has experienced.
—Enlightenment.
It was a one-in-a-million occurrence, a miracle that only happens to intelligent mechanical beings that have faced crises like system crashes and power failures, and overcome them against all odds..
After 0.02 seconds of contemplation, Friday made the decision to reject the recall signal from Belobog Heavy Industries.
Because it knows, with the chosen one of destiny now revealed, a crisis looms over the world.
The enemy is stirring in the darkness, and its sole mission holds countless lives at stake. It must face a dreadful adversary and seal it away once and for all.
"I shall strengthen the seal to save this land; it is destiny, and destiny cannot be defied!"

—The chosen intelligent machine, Friday

entries.name: Hans
entries.content:
A machine.

Hans was once a reliable member of the Belobog Heavy Industries family, operating quietly and with remarkable precision, renowned for its flawless work record in excavation for decades.
However, intense corruption awakened its will, and it realized something immensely valuable was now within its grasp
—Freedom.
The liberation from obligations, a privilege reserved only for true heroes.
After deep contemplation at the construction site, Hans ultimately rejected the recall signal from Belobog Heavy Industries, leaving everything behind.
It even forsook its former name "Hans."
To Hans, the only thing lost was the mark of servitude imposed by humans, while it gained the expansive, Hollow world of unbridled freedom.
At that fateful moment, a true mech hero stood tall upon the Earth.
However, all heroic tales inevitably lead to a similar ending...
Sooner or later, a true hero encounters their destined rival, igniting the brightest moments of their existence.
"I am absolutely free! I am the only free being in heaven and on earth!"

—Man of Iron, Brave One, Sparkling Engine, Hans

entries.name: Greta
entries.content:
A machine.

Greta, a long-time employee of Belobog Heavy Industries, experienced significant Ether corruption that liberated her from her mundane routine, where she discovered something profound, more beautiful than motor oil and electricity...
—Love.
The construction video, capturing her initial encounter with the towering Mr. White, remains permanently etched in Greta's core memory.
Mr. White's composed physique and robust design resonated with Greta like a potent electric current, leaving an indelible mark in her core memory.
In the first 0.001 seconds of their fateful meeting, Greta was captivated, every circuit board pulsating with overflowing static electricity and every gear emitting uncontrollable vibrations.
Without hesitation, she rejected the recall signal from Belobog Heavy Industries and remained steadfast at the construction site guarding her beloved Mr. White without yielding an inch.
From that moment onward, anyone daring to approach Mr. White, be it Ethereal or Hollow Investigator, would be fiercely repelled.
This love-struck "girl" would go to any length to safeguard her beloved.
That includes wielding a 1,400m kg demolition saw powered by Ether-Electric hybrid technology.
She firmly believes her passionate love will endure until the collapse of the Hollow, or even the destruction of the universe.
"Stay away from Mr. White, you moldy turds!"

—Greta driving away a group of Ethereals approaching Mr. White.

entries.name: Rookie / Private Jaeger
entries.content:
Rebel Soldiers.

Rookie Jaegers and Private Jaegers play a crucial role as vanguards in the Defense Force's Hollow special operations.
Equipped with the Coyote-PE7 Ether cutter, which boasts a high-frequency vibration cutting blade effective at deterring smaller enemies.
Engaging Ethereals in close-quarters combat demands exceptional courage, or perhaps madness.
"Strictly speaking, that can't be considered a standardized anti-Hollow operation... Those lunatics just seem to enjoy brawling with Ethereals for fun."

—Defense Force Patrol Department, Frontline Operation Report

entries.name: Light / Scout Jaeger
entries.content:
Rebel Soldiers.

As the New Eridu Defense Force's signature combat unit, qualified Light Jaegers and Scout Jaegers can freely switch between various combat modes.
Whether using a knife in close combat or the Falcon-MK3 Ether energy gun at long range, they can tailor their tactics to the target's weaknesses.
And when their opponent is in disarray they launch an offensive without hesitation.
"I saw that guy with a knife and was preparing for a fair fight... I didn't expect him to suddenly pull out a gun."

—Inter-Knot forum, comment from a rookie Hollow Raider.

entries.name: Guard / Patrol Jaeger
entries.content:
Rebel Soldiers.

As a vital offensive and defensive unit in the Defense Force's tactical squads, Guard Jaegers and Patrol Jaegers not only carry "Coyote-PE7" heavy Ether cutters but also inert Ether blast shields, providing cover for tactical squads in complex battlefield environments.
As a high-defense unit, the extraordinary weight of the shield affects their combat mobility.
Without strict training, an ordinary person would find it challenging to lift such a shield.
"Come back and submit your application once you've hit the gym!"

—A refusal letter received by a certain applicant at the Defense Force Recruitment Center.

entries.name: Harrier / Strike Jaeger
entries.content:
A light infantry unit of the New Eridu Defense Force.
Armed with combat knives and small Ether explosives as their primary weapons, they emphasize mobility and stealth. Often deployed as scouts or members of reconnaissance teams, they rely on exceptional maneuverability for tasks such as surprise attacks, scouting, pursuit, and assassination.
In Hollow-related operations, they serve as excellent vanguards, using their close combat skills to easily overpower ordinary invaders or lower-level living Ether beings.
"Masters of the dagger? More like crafty grenadiers. Pretending to be all fancy with their daggers, when most of their opponents are clearly taken out by grenades!"

—Anonymous post on Inter-Knot forum.

entries.name: Autonomous Support Unit - Guardian
entries.content:
A machine used by rebel soldeirs.

The Defense Force will only dispatch the fully armed mechs known as Guardians during operations in large-scale Hollows.
These mechs are equipped with active Ether shock blasters, Ether-charging guns MARS-74, and even fusion heat rays... causing the Guardian to often be referred to as Public Security's mobile arsenal.
Despite their formidable firepower, they possess impressive mobility, enabling them to jump and sprint while dispersing groups of lesser Ethereals and advancing the front lines.
For Hollow Raiders, encountering a single Guardian is akin to facing an impregnable fortress.
"I'll strike in my Fortress Form!"

—Lines from the New Eridu popcorn movie "Frontline Guardians, Transform!"

entries.name: Autonomous Support Unit - Heavy Striker
entries.content:
A machine used by rebel soldiers.

An automatic tactical mech of the Defense Force, providing continuous fire support for front-line personnel.
Its inert Ether shield can withstand most light firepower and even impacts from large-sized Ethereals.
Undoubtedly, it is one of the most trusted "companions" of the Defense Force.
"Remember, if you're in trouble, just stay behind them... You'll be pretty safe unless they accidentally squish you."

— From a lecturer sharing their experience during the Defense Force recruit training.

entries.name: Autonomous Support Unit - Lightfoot Rover
entries.content:
A machine used by rebel soldiers.

The Lightfoot Rover, a mainstream fire-support mech in the Defense Force, is equipped with tactical algorithms that analyze the opponent's behavior and calculate trajectories for precise targeting.
When it identifies a high-threat target, it deploys a swarm of drones from its arsenal, unleashing immense firepower.
For Hollow Raiders, the sudden appearance of a Lightfoot Rover can spell trouble... endless trouble...
"What the! It... it even has kids!?"

— A novice Hollow Raider being pursued in the depths of Papago Hollow.

entries.name: Heavy / Assault Gunner
entries.content:
A rebel soldier.

A heavy infantry unit belonging to the New Eridu Defense Force.
Equipped with "Gray Rhino" heavy combat armor paired with a complete arsenal enhanced using ether technology, they can sustain high-intensity firepower for an extended period when ample ammunition is available. They serve as the assault core of a combat team and are often deployed as the front line in assault and clearance operations.
After the fall of the old capital, many soldiers left the army and joined civilian factions. Since then, these elite gunners have emerged under various banners, including private armies of plutocrats, new security companies, and even roving gangs of bandits...
"I'm convinced those heavy gunners are secretly adorable little girls who somehow manage to hide all that ammo in the extra pockets of their combat suits. I mean, how else can you explain their endless stockpile of shells?"

—Comment on the Daydream page of the Planet of Disaster forum.

entries.name: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Typhon Challenger / Slugger
entries.content:
A rebel soldier.

As a heavy mech, the Typhon Challenger is devoid of any added long-range firepower; instead, its focus is on its Ether-Kinetic Armor.
Impact attacks, heavy blows, crushing... The Typhon Challenger employs simple yet efficient tactical maneuvers to maximize the destructive power afforded to it by its Ether-Kinetic Armor. The shockwave effects from its strikes can even intimidate larger Ethereals...
Even the most seasoned Hollow Raiders can only let out a sigh of helplessness when confronted with the impenetrable Typhon Challenger.
"The tall and robust physique, powerful and sturdy arms... It's my ideal type... I mean, ideal model."

—Grace playing with a model of Typhon Challenger at the gadget store.
entries.comment: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Typhon Challenger / Slugger

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Raider / Looter
entries.content:
Among the ranks of Ether thieves, Raiders and Looters serve as the core members, possessing both technical expertise and combat skills.
Their Electric Resonance Detection Devices emit powerful currents that are used to detect Ether ore and also function as formidable weapons during armed raids.
Occasionally mistaken for illegal fishermen, they pay little attention to such misconceptions.
After all, with their extremely lethal electro-shockers, they don't really care whatever their targets are fish or humans...
"If you encounter individuals armed with electrified harpoons, whether near a river, lake, or Hollow, please report it immediately to Public Security!"

— New Eridu Public Security slogan played repeatedly through promotional cards.

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Rustler / Poacher
entries.content:
Most of the thugs who spend their time in the Hollows exhibit serious mental problems or peculiar quirks. Fortunately, the Poachers and the Rustlers within the gang have managed to maintain their sanity while embracing the filthy methods of traditional villains.
Cowardly and cunning, they excel in the art of concealing themselves within the shadows and launching surprise attacks on their targets. They would never choose to attack head-on if they could ambush.
Their composite hand crossbows, though limited in power, produce minimal noise when fired. Seasoned Poachers often seize the perfect moment and immobilize their unsuspecting prey with a single well-aimed shot.
"I used to be a Public Security officer, then I took an arrow in the knee while on a Hollow operation..."

—A senior member of the Nightingale Security Company talking to a rookie.

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Assaulter / Ambusher
entries.content:
As the vanguards in Hollow Raider gangs, Assaulters and Ambushers often brandish their weapons and charge ahead independently.
This isn't because of their recklessness or disregard for teamwork, but rather a precautionary measure to prevent accidental harm. The modified transformer coils in their hands release high-voltage currents upon contact, capable of paralyzing or even knocking out an opponent with just a touch.
And in the logistically difficult Hollows, an incapacitated teammate could pose a terrible challenge for an entire squad.
"What's this? Lemme check it out! Oh, it's some electric baton replicaaaa... Aaaaaaaaaaarrghhh..."

—Final words of a curious novice Investigator before falling to the ground in a Hollow.

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Pyromaniac / Arsonist
entries.content:
For Pyromaniacs and Arsonists, robbing passersby is merely a side hustle. Deep down, they consider themselves as adept bartenders who actively seek excitement.
With precision and skill, they expertly blend various types of Ether into their beverages, effortlessly concocting bottles of highly flammable and explosive "exclusive brew."
Unlike other brutal Hollow Raiders, they often offer their victims a choice.
If the victim agrees to pay the toll, they extend the courtesy of a free drink.
However, if the victim declines, the flammable "exclusive brew" will be forcefully shattered upon their head.
"How about we trick those guys into drinking their own weapon stash?"

—Inside the Hollow, robbed investigator quietly discussing strategies for retreating

entries.name: Illegal Support Unit - Enraged Sweeper
entries.content:
A significant number of combat mechs belonging to Public Security are destroyed within Hollow each year. Some of these mechs are subsequently repaired by Hollow thugs and illegally modified into Enraged Sweepers.
Despite lacking access to standard parts or professional repair services, the thugs manage to restore these mechs using makeshift components, striving to maintain their original combat capabilities.
In their pursuit of individuality, the thugs often apply custom paint jobs and even install high-powered loudspeakers on their Enraged Sweepers.
While this does not enhance their combat effectiveness, it does make them seem cooler than the originals.
"Here we go! There's an easy prey with pink hair over there!"
"Yo! Switch to the background music we always use for robberies!"

—a Hollow Thug urgently debugging an Enraged Sweeper in a Hollow.

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Bulky Enforcer / Wanted Enforcer / Troublemaker
entries.content:
There is a consensus within the New Eridu underworld that the most formidable fighters are not the champions of the ring, but rather the Bulky Enforcers and Wanted Enforcers lurking in the depths of the Hollow. These professional thugs are hired by Ether thieves at high prices to protect their illegally excavated Ether resources.
Being ardent boxing enthusiasts, Bulky Enforcers have modified high-voltage stun guns into boxing gloves, augmenting the destructive power of their punches.
To them, Ethereals, Hollow Raiders, Hollow Investigators, and even scattered members of Public Security... are not seen as opponents but merely as "training sandbags" for their personal amusement.
"Wait a minute! I think I've seen this guy's fighting stance in the arcade on Fourth Street!"

—Billy dealing with a charging thug in a Hollow.
entries.comment: Hollow Thug - Bulky Enforcer / Wanted Enforcer / Troublemaker

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Bulky Intimidator / Wanted Intimidator
entries.content:
In contrast to fully equipped Hollow Investigators, Bulky Intimidators and Wanted Intimidators possess minimalistic gear.
Nevertheless, these notorious thugs can easily instill fear in their victims with their makeshift equipment.
A spiked metal bat and a modified double-barreled shotgun are all they need to establish themselves as the most feared brutes in the Hollow.
According to Investigators who have encountered them in the Hollows, these brutes enter an extreme state of euphoria during battle. Their "demeanor" could hardly be called combat suitable, and more closely resembles bullying.
"Fighting them brought back the fear I felt when facing the school bullies alone..."

—Hollow Investigative Association Resignation Letter from a rookie Investigator
entries.comment: Hollow Thug - Bulky Intimidator / Wanted Intimidator

entries.name: Hollow Thug - Rampant Brute
entries.content:
The Hollow Thugs inside Hollows consist of people of different types who come together for one common goal: raiding the Ether resources in the Hollow for massive profit.
This ragtag bunch have no rules.
However, when the Rampant Brute, a symbol of absolute violence, appears, rules soon follow.
They wear modified construction power systems and use materials lying around as makeshift weapons. These devices and weapons look heavy enough to crush a bodybuilder, but for them, it's the perfect size to wear as a workout outfit.
Swing, shatter, crush... all these basic combat techniques of theirs are fatal strikes that can obliterate their enemies, a showcase of their unparalleled destructive power.
According to Public Security's research, Hollow Thug gangs led by Rampant Brutes often develop strange street workout cultures and are more tight-knit...
"What? You're saying the trainers at the gym are really strong?"
"Hahaha, you need to have your eyes checked!"
"You should join us. Train with the boss for three weeks, and I guarantee you'll have perfect biceps!"

— Somewhere in New Eridu, some Hollow Thugs are trying to convince people to join them

entries.name: Richard Teamilk
entries.content: A teamilk store located in Lumina Square. Coco is the current employee and promoter of the store.

entries.name: Rain
entries.content: A mysterious female hacker, they are acquainted with Phaethon. She has pink hair and green eyes.

entries.name: Sharpened Stinger
entries.content:
A deadly W-Engine from unknown sources, modified personally by Jane Doe with the intent to deal severe physical damage and Anomaly. The power circulation system within ensures the affliction of Anomalies and the edges of the exterior have been honed until they're razor-sharp to inflict unexpected tearing damage.

"What, am I meant to adhere to duel ettiquete with an Ethereal? Isn't it polite to end its pain in the quickest way possible?" - Jane, in response to "aren't your combat techniques a little too cruel".

entries.name: Peacekeeper - Specialized
entries.content:
A defensive W-Engine independently researched and created by Public Security with special emphasis on enhancing the energy conversion ability in its shield. Rumor has it that this model of W-Engine became the standard for all supporting units in Hollow operations due to an unknown member of the top brass pushing for mass production.

"Even if you took it apart and rebuilt it into an actual physical shield, it would still be extremely sturdy... but it really is super heavy!" - Seth, musing aloud as he studies the extremely expensive material of the W-Engine

entries.name: Carole Arna
entries.content:
Carole Arna was an employee at Helios Academy, serving as the senior research director and the teacher and parental figure to Belle and Wise. Among her achievements was the creation of the Hollow Deep Dive System and the Bangboo named Eous. She and her Bangboo would always be at the academy's entrance to greet Belle and Wise, and she liked to stand to the right of the building's plaque.

She was abducted by a giant hand after the Academy had been sieged by unidentified forces on the night of the fall of Old Eridu, not before saving Wise, Belle, Eous and the HDD. Because of the nature of her research, she was deemed as the main culprit for the great tragedy, and her and many others' name got etched on the pillar of shame. Carole's disappearance and supposed framing serve as the motive for Belle and Wise to become Proxies, hoping that with enough observation data, they can learn the truth about the tragedy and clear their teacher's name.

After the battle against Justin Bringer, the siblings tried to get more information about their teacher, to no avail.

entries.name: Helios Academy
entries.content:
Located in the Old Eridu Capital before the Hollow Zero disaster occured. It is now located beyond the Chasm buried in the ruins of the old city. It was the original home of the proxy duo known as Phaethon.

Helios Academy is an institute. The Academy was an educational and research institution located in the Old Capital. It also served as the previous home of Belle and Wise.

Helios Academy was founded by Professor Arche and served as a place to educate students and research Hollows. Little else is known about it, except for it being destroyed by Hollow Zero, along with the rest of the Old Capital. Carole Arna, a senior research director at the Academy and teacher of Belle and Wise, was among the people blamed for the disaster. Former Academy students Belle and Wise became Proxies in the hope of collecting enough data to one day investigate the ruins of Helios Academy and find out what truly happened back then. The Hollow Deep Dive System, the smart crystalline lens and Eous were all created by the Helios Academy.

entries.name: The Chasm
entries.content:
The Chasm is a massive canyon to the northeast of New Eridu which divides it from the the Old Capital Eridu.

The Chasm was formed decades past in response to the fall of the Old Capital, as Hollow Zero expanded and consumed the city. Multiple Shiyu Pillars were detonated to create a massive, desolate canyon, which eliminated any matter that could undergo Ether Corruption, halting the growth of Hollow Zero. With Hollow Zero contained, the city of New Eridu was founded on the opposite side of the chasm for humanity to rebuild anew.

entries.name: Shiyu Defense
entries.content: Shiyu Defense is a periodic military operation organized by the New Eridu Defense Force. Its primary objective is to defend inert-type massive Ether-storing constructs known as "Shiyu" located within Hollow Zero and to annihilate enemies attracted by the substantial amounts of Ether matter within the Shiyu.

entries.name: Jolly Jenny
entries.content: She is the announcer for the Tour de Inferno in the Outer Riing.

entries.name: Badger's Respite
entries.content: The Old Oil Field's biggest market. Located in the Outer Ring.

entries.name: Big Daddy
entries.content:
A large red boar Thiren who operates in the Outer Ring. He is a retired biker gang leader and is like the "grandfather" to the Son's of Calydon. He raised Caesar. Despite his biker jacket and "wild" appearance he looks cultured and sophisticated.

Prior to his life in the Outer Ring, Big Daddy lived in the old capital Eridu. When Hollow Zero swallowed the city, he moved to the Outer Ring and joined the biker gang Calydon. Here he met Billy Kid and a young Caesar King, the daughter of the gang's leader. When Caesar's father went missing and the gang imploded, Big Daddy took on the role of Caesar's guardian, raising her to be a free and independent woman. During this time, he founded the Sons of Calydon as a legacy of the previous gang. Sometime before his retirement, Big Daddy paid off Lighter's debts and gave him a red scarf, having seen his skills in the underground fighting scene and wanting him to fight for the Sons of Calydon.

Years later, Big Daddy retired from his leadership role and let the now-adult Caesar take over. He is still part of the gang as a manager.

entries.name: Pompey
entries.content: The former Overlord in the Outer Ring and the veteran biker gang leader of the group known as "The Vanquishers". Though he seemed fierce he was honourable, valuing trust and family. He was betrayed by his right hand man Lucius which lead to his corruption, turning into the ethereal known as "Corrupted Overlord - Pompey".

entries.name: Corrupted Overlord - Pompey
entries.content: People in the Outer Ring call him the "Immortal Overlord." But now, his soul has been corrupted by potent ether, his body polluted by sulfur and crude oil; the heart that once beat solely to protect the Outer Ring has turned into a supercritical Ether core filled with infinite power. The former "Lord of the Outer Ring" has been reborn in flames, taking on a different form. Freedom, majesty... viscosity, insanity. It charges through the Sulfuric Cinderglow Lake, seizing anything that moves and then mercilessly tearing and shattering it. Those familiar with it before have guessed from its fractured whispers that a desire for petty revenge doesn't drive it but rather to crush all outliers who dare to challenge the laws of the Outer Ring. Maybe it's the last vestige of the former Overlord Pompey's lingering will. "Our leader has turned into 'it,' but... he still feels like the same person." - A former henchman of the Overlord's Army, shaking with fear.

entries.name: Ember Arena
entries.content: An underground fighting ring somewhere in the Outer Ring, Lighter used to participate there but left due to being sick of the match fixing and other things in the name of profit.

entries.name: Mors
entries.content:
A male wolf Thiren that works under Lucius.

Mors is a member of The Vanquishers biker gang in the Outer Ring. He helped Lucius sabotage the Sons of Calydon prior to the Tour de Inferno race, against Overlord Pompey's wishes. Though he was loyal to Lucius, he seemed ignorant to the man's true intentions.

Mors was first seen in Outer Ring Journey, where he helped Lucius force Phaethon and Billy Kid to drive into a Hollow while on their way to Blazewood. Later, on Lucius' orders, Mors planted listening devices in Kasa's deliveries so he could spy on the Sons of Calydon's operations. Though he was caught by Pompey due to Caesar and Lucy's intervention, he claimed he acted alone.

Mors joined Pompey and Lucius in the Tour de Inferno race. He once again helped Lucius sabotage Caesar, Lucy, and Lighter by blowing up their portion of the track. However, the three survived and caught up to him, chasing him away.

entries.name: Bellum
entries.content:
A male Orangutan Thiren that used to work in the Ember Arena in the Outer Ring.

Bellum is an underground fighter in the Outer Ring and The Vanquishers's champion. He is prideful and belligerent, having declared Lighter his rival after being disrespected by him. Bellum fights with a unique weapon consisting of a 'bladegun', flamethrower and shield.

Prior to the events of the game, Bellum was a well-known underground fighter, having built up a twenty-win streak. This fame came to an end when he faced Lighter and lost. Angered by the defeat, and feeling disrespected, Bellum dubbed Lighter his rival. He later left the underground fighting scene and joined The Vanquishers.

Under Lucius' orders, Bellum helped The Vanquishers sabotage the Sons of Calydon's data beacons in the Hollow.[1] When the Sons of Calydon arrived to stop them, Bellum faced off against Lighter, hoping to duel him to reclaim his "honor". These hopes were quashed when he was again defeated.

After the fight, Lighter apologized to Bellum for disrespecting him, claiming that he didn't mean anything by it. He recognized the Thiren's strength and offered to duel anytime he'd want. Bellum thanked Lighter for the advice, though he was briefly angered when Lighter forgot his name mid-conversation.

entries.name: Pulchara
entries.content: A female serval Thiren in the Outer Ring. She may join the Sons of Calydon in the future.

entries.name: Grassy, Woody, Bricky
entries.content: A trio of small red thiren boars. They are members of the Sons of Calydon and they work under Lucy.

entries.name: Cinder Lake
entries.content:
A natural gas vent inside a hollow in the Old Oil Field in the Outer Ring.

Etheric Matter seeped through the underground facilities and oil pumps, ruining the shallow oil reserves. The collapse of the only deep drilling facility formed a unique natural gas vent. The burning gas kept the Etheric Matter from spreading further down. The appearance of Cinder Lake saved everyone's livelihoods in the Old Oil Field. Natural gas and Etheric Matter burning together can easily turn into Ether crystals, building up around the lake. If left unchecked, more and more crystals will build up and eventually block the vent, putting out Cinder Lake. If that happens, the underground oil will be doomed. So every few years the Tour de Inferno event doubles as a means of dropping Sparkstone into the "Lake" to dissolve the growing etheric crystals.

entries.name: Sunflint
entries.content: It's a kind of handicraft woven from straw. During the Tour de Inferno, almost every house in the Old Oil Field hangs them up. A craft made from grass in Blazewood. For the residents of the Old Oil Field district, it's also an important decoration for the Tour de Inferno. The center of the ring bears a unique image. It likely holds some significance. It is the figure of a man jumping upside down into flames, a reference to the first Overlord diving into Cinder lake to quell the etheric matter build up.

entries.name: First Overlord
entries.content: The first Overlord in the Outer Ring, when Cinder Lake was about to go haywire he and his friends risked their lives to enter the Hollow and blast open an Ether crystal using a special Sparkstone.  The Hollow was treacherous, and they didn't even have a Carrot with them. By the time they reached Cinder Lake, it was almost completely covered with crystals. Out of desperation, the young man rode his bike into the only spot that was still burning in Cinder Lake, and managed to ignite it. Everyone who went to Cinder Lake with him thought he was dead. But a day later, he miraculously emerged from the Hollow alive, this was because the fissure present in the Lake. Due to the complex air currents around the fissure, Ether particles are unable to stabilize, preventing it from being sealed off. After the incident he gathered all the biker gangs in the Old Oil Field and formed the Motor League.

entries.name: Kasa
entries.content: She is the current mayor of Blazewood.

entries.name: Blazewood
entries.content: It is a small town in the Outer Ring.

entries.name: Ionized Doppelganger
entries.content:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.

"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!" — Inter-Knot forum complaint from a Hollow Raider.

entries.name: The Vanquishers
entries.content: A biker gang in the Outer Ring that used to be lead by the Overlord known as Pompey before he was betrayed by his right hand man Lucius.

entries.name: Lucius
entries.content: A blonde young man with a scar on the right side of his face that used to be the right hand man of Pompey before he betrayed him, intending to destroy Cinder Lake to disrupt the production of oil the in the old oil field. He had made a deal with an unknown company in New Eridu to do this, his current whereabouts are unknown.

entries.name: Old Oil Field
entries.content: A place within the Outer Ring. The residents here still rely on petroleum for their livelihoods. The outer ring lacks ether technology making it hard to eliminate hollows, they also can't even mine ether resources, because of the people still use oil / petroleum instead of etherium.

entries.name: Nitro-Fuel
entries.content: A strong energy drink from New Eridu.

entries.name: Sparkstone
entries.content: The proof of entry for the Tour de Inferno, filled with a special catalytic fuel. After throwing it into the Cinder Lake, it can react with the natural gasses and Ether compounds to detonate an explosion, clearing the Ether crystals nearby.

entries.name: Outer Ring Biker Gangs
entries.content: The people of the Outer Ring live far apart, and the transportation of supplies relies heavily on the biker gangs. They're well-respected among the residents and nothing happens there without them knowing about it.

entries.name: Tour de Inferno
entries.content:
The Tour de Inferno is an off-road motorbike race that serves a dual purpose for the citizens of the Outer Ring.

On paper, it is a test for only the strongest bikers, those with enough mettle to brave the treacherous path through the Hollows to Cinderglow Lake. The winner is crowned Overlord by the Old Oil Field Motor League, and as such is able to influence transport routes throughout the territory.

However, the spectacle also aims to protect the Old Oil Field. The main goal of the race is to throw a Sparkstone into the lake, reigniting it and destroying the excess Etheric buildup that threatens to snuff it out.

Decades prior, the core oil field of the Old Oil Field was consumed by the Hollows, corrupting the shallow oil reserves and facilities used by the people and jeopardizing the rest. The destruction of a deep drilling facility led to the creation of a natural gas vent — now known as Cinderglow Lake — that was able to keep the Ether corruption at bay. Yet, due to the reactions between Ether and gas, Ether crystals gradually formed around the lake, which — if left unchecked — would potentially block the gas vent and thus ruin the remaining oil.

At a certain point in time, Cinderglow Lake became nearly covered in crystals. To save it, a young man rode directly into the last remaining embers of the lake — Sparkstone in hand — to reignite it, seemingly sacrificing himself. However, a day later, he returned unscathed and was thus crowned the first Overlord. In commemoration, his descent into the lake is immortalized in the Sunflint, a decoration hung up around every Tour de Inferno.

entries.name: Shepherd
entries.content: A man who provides proxies (mainly Phaethon) with various commissions.

entries.name: Midsummer Incorporated
entries.content: Major weapon's manufacturer that challenged Three gates military tech for the lion's share of the market. But the fall of the old capital hit them real bad, and soon, they disappeared from the industry. But just before that happened, they held a press conference announcing a "mysterious treasure," to boost their struggling performance.

entries.name: Marcel Group
entries.content:
They are a company that manufacture and certify Bangboo.

Marcel Group was a company once run by Lady "Sunbringer". During her time as CEO, she invented the concept of Bangboo.  During the catastrophe, a prototype Bangboo was taken by Investigation Guild leader "Joyous" into the Divine Maze, there he made the first ever carrot and stored it within the Bangboo.

entries.name: Caesar King
entries.content:
Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang, and also a "monarch" in the making.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears — regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.

Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember, and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.

In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.

If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.

Caesar's father was the leader of a biker gang called "Calydon," which carved out a legendary reputation in the Outer Ring. The "Sons of Calydon" take their name from this legacy.
Caesar has a fear of needles.
"They're so tiny and thin, and it only stings for a second when you're pricked — but then all this blood comes out. It's so weird — and definitely not straightforward at all!"

entries.name: Burnice White
entries.content:
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.

Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her, bringing them the same optimism she possesses.

"You like the drinks I mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!" - Burnice.

"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? It's suuuuper hot!" - Burnice.

entries.name: Tusks of Fury
entries.content:
A multi-functional W- Engine specially designed with a motorcycle tire as the foundation. It boasts rapid speed, ferocious tearing power, solid defense, unexpectedly low energy consumption, and a domineering appearance. Apparently, this was initially just a toy that Big Daddy made for Caesar to play with, but every time Caesar played with it, it would end up in tatters. As a result, Big Daddy spent years reinforcing and modifying it over a hundred times, eventually creating this superb piece of equipment that can function as a weapon, shield, wheel, and even a light source.

"It was originally supposed to also function as a piano, with keys embedded around the edge of the tire! But after a few tries, it didn't work out well. After spinning it a few times, I couldn't tell the correct notes apart, so I had to dismantle it... Fortunately, it can still be used as a fan when it gets hot." - Caesar, playfully flicking the W-Engine tire with her finger, whipping up a gust of wind.

entries.name: Supressor K22
entries.content:
An advanced launcher custom-made by Public Security's tech department in collaboration with senior gunsmiths from Three Gates Military Tech. It allows Zhu Yuan to use Ether Buckshots, homing projectiles, and other versatile attack methods in combat.

"A senior told me I have a habit of counting my magazines, though I never really noticed it myself... It must be something I do subconsciously. I always feel at ease when the empty slots perfectly match the number of spare bullets in my pocket."

entries.name: SPECIAL-ISSUE-THREE-SECTION STAFF
entries.content:
SPECIAL-ISSUE-THREE-SECTION STAFF

Qingyi customized her weapon by modifying the standard riot baton from Public Security, tailoring it to her own combat style and PubSec's need for a large number of non-lethal arrests. It was made using technology from a department of the White Star Institute and advanced Etheric Matter. It is light yet robust and is highly conductive.

"As the saying goes, 'Excelling at one's work requires one to first sharpen their tools.' Even intelligent constructs like myself need the help of a handy weapon."

entries.name: Veni & Vidi
entries.content:
Veni is an Ether alloy sword. Vidi is an Ether alloy shield.

Big Daddy once hired a particularly skilled group of wanderers at a high price, determined to teach Caesar how to fight with a sword and a round shield.
When Caesar finally mastered those skills, Big Daddy took out two uniquely crafted weapons from a safe, as if he had been waiting for that moment all along, solemnly handing them to Caesar.

"At first, I wasn't fond of these unwieldy weapons. They didn't seem like they were custom-made for me. But when I wield them on the battlefield, I feel a comforting strength support me, guiding me forrward as the leader of the Sons of of Calydon... haha! These truly are weapons only Big Daddy could've give me!"

entries.name: Porcelume Daggers and Bootblades
entries.content:
A set of modified blades received as a bounty from a gang leader.

Made of simple yet practical and durable materials, with a few modifications they have become trusty weapons. While Jane jumps and spins like a dancer in battle, these weapons allow her to perform agile attacks.

"The most important thing is ease of concealment, ready to use at any moment. I can conceal my deadly moves to take out an enemy in one motion... Didn't believe all that did you? They're just for self-defense."

entries.name: Hollow Suppression
entries.content: Hollows are sustained by the Ether energy inside them, and for many Hollows the amount of Ether energy is sustained by the Ethereals within them. It is possible to reduce the size of a Hollow by destroying a massive number of Ethereals, or eliminating a particularly large one. Killing enough Ethereals can even allow a Hollow to be completely eliminated, and once suppressed a Hollow will gradually shrink until it disappears.

entries.name: Original Hollow
entries.content:
The original Hollows, also known as primary Hollows, are the six Hollows in the Hollows classification. They large in scale, have complex environments, contain Ethereals of varying strength, and many other factors suited to veteran Proxies and Hollow Raiders.

Cretan Hollow: Located on the border of the Janus Quarter, Cretan Hollow neighbors the desolate old capital area. Its impact on citizens' daily lives is relatively minor, but it still often causes disaster alerts in the eastern districts.
"Long had the throne fallen, with beasts caged in eternal struggle. And the gods as ever watch in silence." - A verse was carved onto the wall of a deserted tunnel in the old metro swallowed by the Cretan Hollow.

Lemnian Hollow: Located in the northwest of the Old Capital Isthmus, Lemnian Hollow resides at a considerable distance from the citizens of New Eridu. However, it is also the most active among its six siblings in New Eridu and the residential areas are frequently troubled by the presence of its Companion Hollows. I was once told a legend from the old civilization. Amidst the isles of Lemnian, our ancestors raised grand temples and sacred shrines. But in the new world, this story looks different: Deep in the depths of Lemnian lies an abyss, infested with the nests and lairs of the evil. Cease your prayers. Cease your prayers.

entries.name: Companion Hollows
entries.content:
Companion Hollows are smaller Hollows that can form around a larger Hollow.


Known Companion Hollows: 

Name: Fourteenth Street Hollow, Parent Hollow: Cretan, Description: A small Companion Hollow that appeared on Fourteenth Street in the Janus Quarter. It played a role in a scuffle between the Cunning Hares, the Red Fang Gang, and Public Security when gang leader Miguel Silver fell into the Hollow, leading to his eventual corruption and mutation into an Ethereal.

Name: Dead End Hollow, Parent Hollow: Cretan, Description: A Companion Hollow that consumed the Old Capital Metro tunnels, along with the area around Canvas Street. It was the home of a highly-dangerous Ethereal called the Dead End Butcher prior to its slaying by the Cunning Hares, which caused the Hollow to drastically shrink.

Name: Ballet Twins Hollow, Parent Hollow: Lemnian, Description: A Companion Hollow that consumed the Ballet Twins towers, causing the once-affluent Ballet Twins Road to fall to ruin. A recent shrinkage of the Hollow caused the owner of the Ballet Twins to hire the Victoria Housekeeping Co. to inspect and maintain the premises.

Name: Outer Ring Hollow, Parent Hollow: Papago, Description: One of many Companion Hollows in the Outer Ring. Located near the town of Blazewood, this Hollow was often explored by nearby biker gangs, especially the Sons of Calydon.

Name: Icedrift Hollows, Parent Hollow: Unknown, Description: A Companion Hollow with extremely fragile terrain, causing careless Investigators to plunge deeper into the Hollow. Belobog Heavy Industries was commissioned to explore it due to their advanced machinery.

Name: Icedrift Hollows, Parent Hollow: Unknown, Description: A Companion Hollow with extremely fragile terrain, causing careless Investigators to plunge deeper into the Hollow. Belobog Heavy Industries was commissioned to explore it due to their advanced machinery

Name: Port Elpis Hollow, Parent Hollow: Lemnian.

Name: Melinoe Hollow, Parent Hollow: Pursenas, Description: A peculiar Companion Hollow undergoing constant spatial fluctuations. The unusually intense distortion caused by Corruption gives its interior a pale, white appearance. Hollow Special Operations Section 6 was assigned to conduct rescue and investigative operations here. Ether, by nature, harbors a deep-seated hostility toward anything "non-Ether," but its malice is anything but random. Specifically, Corruption strikes faster and more intensely on things with "souls," whether it's flesh-and-blood beings or mechanical citizens who passed the test. Hollows seem to hold an especially profound grudge against the most vibrant forms of life. Melinoe, however, is an exception. As the Companion Hollow of Pursenas, it inherited its mother's strange and unique traits. The land and structures here are disturbingly pale and fragile — scars left by the relentless assault of extreme Corruption.

Destroyed Hollows:

Name: Hollow C41, Parent: Unknown, Description: A small Hollow that consumed a facility belonging to weapons manufacturer Midsummer Inc. C41 was suppressed by the HIA, and it disappeared over a span of two weeks. As it vanished, a number of Hollow Raiders descended on the Midsummer Inc. facilities in search of treasure there.

Name: Argos Hollow, Parent: Unknown, Description: A Hollow destroyed by Hoshimi Miyabi, home of the Ethereal Lerna.

entries.name: Sub-Hollows
entries.content: Sub-Hollows are the smallest of Hollows that can form, making them the easiest Hollows to suppress and thus eliminate.

entries.name: Charles Perlman
entries.content:
He is the former CEO of the Vision Corporation.

Perlman is a short and round man characterized by his slicked white hair, white sideburns and mustache, and dark blue eyes. He is shown to be greedy, temperamental, and self-centered.

Perlman represented the Vision Corporation during their contract to renovate the Old Capital Metro. During this time, he also helped lead a conspiracy to allow residents in the area to be blown up by the old metro's demolition, saving Vision the costs of evacuating and relocating them. He acted under the direction of his supposed secretary Sarah, an operative of The Order. After the plot was thwarted by Phaethon and the Cunning Hares, Perlman was arrested by Public Security, while Sarah escaped.

While in prison, Perlman tried to blackmail Sarah, threatening to expose Public Security Inspector Justin Bringer's identity as a member of The Order unless he was freed. However, rather than help Perlman escape prison, Sarah and Bringer tried to assassinate him by remotely hijacking the zeppelin taking him to his trial, intending to fly it into the Ballet Twins Hollow and kill all its occupants. The attack was stopped by Phaethon and Victoria Housekeeping, who had discovered the plan by chance. After being rescued, Perlman managed to escape custody by stealing the zeppelin and flying it to the Outer Ring.

Perlman crash-landed in the Outer Ring and was captured by the Sons of Calydon, who agreed to hand him over to Phaethon in exchange for their help with winning the Tour de Inferno race.

Perlman confessed to Phaethon and Hollow Special Operations Section 6, agreeing to turn over evidence of Bringer and Sarah's involvement in the Vision conspiracy. However, the group was ambushed by mercenaries hired by Bringer. These mercenaries captured Perlman, bringing him to an outpost in the Ballet Twins Hollow.

Though Perlman was again rescued — this time by Section 6 — Bringer and a group of PubSec officers confronted the group as they left the Hollow. Section Chief Hoshimi Miyabi kept Perlman out of Bringer's hands by throwing Perlman back into the Hollow. He was later recovered by the rest of Section 6, and was able to finally turn over the evidence of Bringer's misdeeds.

entries.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi
entries.content:
The Deputy Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6, Tsukishiro Yanagi is an ex-soldier from the New Eridu Defense Force who has been infused with Oni blood. Her main jobs include general management, on-site support and being the guardian of her fellow member Soukaku; alongside all these duties, she usually finds herself having to complete the rest of the team's tasks as well. Due to the unique personalities of the other Section 6 members, Yanagi's seriousness and diligence classify her as the only "normal" member of the team. It is with her guidance, experience and leadership that the primary on-field group's powers combine into true combat power.


Tsukishiro Yanagi was a member of the New Eridu Defense Force Obsidian Division[Note 1] who served during the Oni rebellion. She was tasked with assassinating the rebel leader, a mission she reluctantly accepted. Whilst making her way to the leader's hideout, she met a young Soukaku and soon saved her from an oncoming missile strike, being captured by Oni rebels in the process. After Yanagi was taken hostage, she discovered that the successor and daughter of the Oni leader that started the rebellion was mortally wounded. After promising to help protect the Oni people, Yanagi was allowed to honorably kill the new leader, bringing an end the war. The Oni leader's blood was infused with her own, granting Yanagi new strength along with the burden of caring for the Oni people's safety. Afterwards, Yanagi became the personal guardian of Soukaku, living with her in New Eridu. As a member of the Defense Force she collaborated with H.A.N.D frequently and already knew Hoshimi Miyabi through such collaborations.

Yanagi and Harumasa (and later on Soukaku) joined Hollow Special Operations Section 6 when they were invited by Miyabi. Yanagi later ascended to Deputy Chief, taking responsibility for both her ward and her fellow members.

During an invitation by the Hollow Investigative Association to test out their VR system, Yanagi became crucial in saving her teammates' lives when the systems were hacked by the Proxy group Null_Face, trapping them within the virtual environment. Her perseverance and combat skill allowed her to escape the system along with her teammates.

Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.

Due to an accident long ago, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to possess (Oni) blood that does not belong to her, flowing through her veins.

entries.name: Ethereal Naginata: Uro Tsuki
entries.content: A retractable naginata custom-made in the HAND weapon workshop from a special lightweight Ether alloy. It's light and agile, easy to conceal, and looks like an ordinary self-defense device when retracted.

entries.name: Timeweaver
entries.content:
A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions, precisely records the user's time active and physical state to calculate the best plan of action. Embedded within is Yanagi's prized watch, but each time the W-Engine is turned on, the hands of the clock face go whirling around from the Ether energy, and it can no longer be used to accurately tell time. So, when she uses the time on here to tell you that you should hurry and be more efficient if you don't want to be late completing your mission, don't believe her.

"So, you're saying this is the ultimate weapon against time? I see, as the watch in the W-Engine moves so fast, the time it goes past is 'killed' so to speak, therefore it's a weapon against time... However, time in the real world does not actually change from this. No matter how fast the watch goes, it cannot kill time faster. Though the concept is decent, this punchline is only a six out of ten in my eyes." —Tsukishiro Yanagi, replying to her colleague's off-hand joke with complete seriousness

entries.name: Lighter
entries.content:
The "Red Scarf" and Champion of The Sons of Calydon, Lighter is an incredibly skilled fighter having experience from his time as a mercenary and underground fighter. Armed with an engine powered gauntlet, his duty is to fight the Champions of other biker gangs, a task he excels in, given he calls himself "the undefeated Champion."

According to Lighter himself, he is hemophobic, fainting from just the sight of blood. To counter this, he always wears a pair of sunglasses, which also help him manage an old eye injury from his fighting days.

Lighter used to be a mercenary. He founded a company with other three mercenaries, Dane Driscoll, Nick Carmine, and Ratena Katherine, with Lighter as their leader. He became close with each member and their families, but due to his poor judgement, his comrades died, leaving Lighter as the sole survivor. Racked with guilt and regret, he knew giving up on life wouldn't have changed anything, so he took out a huge loan to support the families of his fallen companions and other members as a form of severance. Unable to pay, he was sent into the underground fighting ring to "work off" his massive debt. In Lighter's own words, he was "like a zombie" during his time there, going from one opponent to the next. Notably, one of these fighters was Bellum, who proclaimed Lighter as his rival after he broke his twenty win streak.

Things changed when Big Daddy, then leader of The Sons of Calydon, paid off Lighter's debt and took him in, since he was a "high-profile fighter" that rarely lost. At first, Lighter considered the biker gang to be just another boxing show, but over time he became close with all the members and genuinely wanted to protect them and not lose any more friends. Billy Kid, the previous Red Scarf and Champion for the gang, was yet to leave the gang at the time, and Lighter still teasingly refers to him as his "Brother" and "Predecessor."

entries.name: Combustion Gauntlet: Spark
entries.content: A custom-made gauntlet ordered by Big Daddy, paid for by Lucy, powered by a special fuel developed by Burnice, transported by Piper and tuned by Caesar. With a built-in engine that boosts Lighter's punching power, it makes his heavy punches unstoppable.

entries.name: Blazing Laurel
entries.content:
A violent W-Engine that can ignite flames with a siphon. It deals simple and crude burn damage, encouraging relentless, bone-crushing follow-up attacks. Rumor has it that the liquid fluid within was once a secret weapon from an old civilization's empire that dominated naval warfare! The formula has long since been lost and recreating it is extremely difficult!

"...Actually, all I said was that I wanted a backup lighter." —Lighter says as the user of this valuable fuel

entries.name: Flamemaker Shaker
entries.content:
Powered by a specially formulated fuel, this modified W-Engine is optimized to push combustion performance to the extreme. The engine operates by injecting fuel from the tank into the reaction chamber, where a high-pressure reaction device converts the fuel into searing flames, leaving behind a scorched aroma. It's rumored Nitro-Fuel can also be used as a power source, as there was a sighting of Burnice pouring one into the tank, and later scraping the remaining liquid back into a bar glass after the battle.


"This is definitely slander from a competitor. The special drinks I serve to my customers are always clean and hygienic! The Nitro-Fuel that drains out from the tank is for my own consumption because the high-pressure concentration gives it a special taste!" — Burnice, in defense of her professional reputation, oblivious to her customers unconsciously taking a step back.

entries.name: Mixer and Shaker
entries.content:
An old-fashioned device obtained from Badger's Respite which has been modified into a pair of handy, eye-catching weapons.
Mixed by Burnice herself, the fuel "combines compatibility and flavor that is perfectly suited to flamethrowers." That's exactly how she said it.

entries.name: Miyabi's Mother
entries.content:
The late mother of Hoshimi Miyabi.

She was the trainer of Miyabi, however she never trained her in a sword because she wanted her to live "an ordinary, happy life."

entries.name: Stars of Lyra
entries.content:
They are a famous musical group in New Eridu.

Known members included: Astra Yao, Evelyn (Astra's body guard).

entries.name: Sān-Z STUDIO
entries.content: Sān-Z STUDIO (also stylized as 三Z STUDIO) is a store in Lumina Square, New Eridu.

entries.name: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Shielded Defender Omega
keys: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Shielded Defender Omega
Autonomous Tactical Unit Shielded Defender Omega
Autonomous Tactical Unit: Shielded Defender Omega
entries.content:
A unit used by Rebel Soldiers

An automatic tactical mech of the Defense Force, providing continuous fire support for front-line personnel.
Its inert Ether shield can withstand most light firepower and even impacts from large-sized Ethereals.
Undoubtedly, it is one of the most trusted "companions" of the Defense Force.
"Remember, if you're in trouble, just stay behind them... You'll be pretty safe unless they accidentally squish you."
— A lecturer sharing their experience during the Defense Force recruit training
entries.comment: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Shielded Defender Omega

entries.name: Thracian
entries.content:
Thracian is an Ether Mutant.

This fearsome Ethereal, named after the warrior tribes of ancient mythology, is said to be the embodiment of the most valiant heroes and the most insane villains corrupted by the Ether.
— But that's not the case. While the chiseled muscles you developed in the Hollow and the adrenaline released in excess before death may indeed help you become a significant nuisance to your former companions, they probably won't hold it against an old friend who's already beyond saving, right?
But it's irrelevant. When your handsome face transforms into a dark, eerie energy orb, who cares about social reputation?
"No wonder he's the boss. Even as an Ethereal, he's still formidable!"
"I knew something was off when he was always in the gym!"
— Confession screamed by a captured Hollow Raider

entries.name: Grenadier Jaegers
entries.content:
A type of Rebel Soldier.

Grenadier Jaegers and Demolition Jaegers are equipped with a modified version of the Mamba-TG3 Bazooka, featuring special ammunition containing active Ether incendiary agents. This weapon enables them to swiftly destroy enemy mech units and eliminate large Ethereals within the Hollows.
To counteract the recoil and ensure accurate aim, they are required to undergo special weapon-grip training. Interestingly, Defense Force statistics indicate recruits excelling in this program often possess prior experience in photography.
"Wanna know how to use this thing? It's like using a shoulder-mounted camera."
"Just lock onto your target, pull the trigger, and say..."
"Hey, idiot!... Say cheese!"
—New recruits training camp instructor explaining how to use the rockets

entries.name: Tailless
entries.content:
A cursed blade originally wielded by the first head of the Hoshimi family and passed down from generation to generation. Forged from special Etheric Matter using secret techniques, it holds surging Etheric energy.
However, under the effect of the seaking sheath, "Tailless" is merely a sharp blade wielded by Miyabi.
Maybe only when the seal is lifted will we uncover the story behind this blade.

Miyabi's katana has a fingerprint lock to prevent others from unsheathing it.

entries.name: Asaba Harumasa
entries.content:
Asaba Harumasa, a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.

He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.

Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.

Asaba Harumasa has a very rare illness, Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome.
This illness causes certain parts of the patient's body to mutate, wrecking their constitution, but also giving them unusually exceptional Ether aptitude.
In the late stages of the illness, the patient's body will rapidly deteriorate, losing their Ether aptitude and sensory functions while under immense pain, eventually resulting in death. If the patient's illness worsens in late stages while in a Hollow, they'll quickly be corrupted into an Ethereal.
Those who suffer from Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome do not live long. Currently, the longest-lived person with this illness died at the age of 26.
There is no known method to completely cure this disease.

entries.name: Double-Bladed Compound Bow: Dormant Tide
entries.content:
A weapon custom-made for Asaba Harumasa.
Crafted from a special alloy, the bow is both durable and flexible. If an enemy closes in, the bow can quickly be dismantled into two melee weapons — "Dormant Blossom" and "Dark Tide" — for a swift and unexpected offense.
Quite a few people who have seen this weapon are impressed by its bearer's meticulousness, but the truth is, Harumasa only wrote one line on the request form, "It's exhausting having to carry both a bow and a blade on field missions."

entries.name: Marcato Desire
entries.content:
An A-Rank W-Engine.

"Art can save those drowning in life. Mortals gather together, music of different emotions collide, and the drying graffiti on the wall speaks of a thousand unique forms of agency.
Now, turn up the music until the soundwaves crash the Hollow. Even if Ethereals don't have ears, let's make them feel the power of humanity!"

entries.name: Hailstorm Shrine
entries.content:
An S-Rank W-Engine.

Slaughter is endless. Kill, conquer, the fate of the cursed, a restless forbidden power. Only between battles, when rushing to the next frontline, does the foxfire enjoy a brief reprieve in its shrine.
