How many more corpses, how many more sacrifices, how many more calamities until we reach the void on the other side?
She needs no answer. At the peak of martial power, the stench of blood will freeze in the air before being breathed in. Once all evil is eradicated, the world will be able to enter peaceful slumber with the blade sealed.
Hail falls before the shrine, waking the wielder of this power. The blizzard is coming.

"Perfect for training... If I could shrink to its size, that is." —Miyabi, muttering to herself as she gazes at the interior.

entries.name: Zanshin Herb Case
entries.content:
An S-Rank W-Engine. It contains pills.

Medicine is neither benevolent nor cruel. It merely heals what it must and brings its own side effects.
A warrior cares not how bitter and painful it may be to ingest. The ending is set in stone, so in order to shoot arrows that reach brighter places, he can do nothing but swallow them all.

"There's a medicine that is real useful for faking sickness to get sick leave. If you don't take it with other stuff, it'll give you a brief fever. Unfortunately, it's pretty expensive, and it's not included in health insurance..." —Harumasa, sharing his insights into how to slack off.

entries.name: Port Elpis
entries.content: Port Elpis is a District and port in New Eridu.

entries.name: Reverb Arena
entries.content: It is a small club and sporting center in New Eridu's underground tunnels.

entries.name: Autonomous Assault Unit - Typhon Destroyer
entries.content:
Autonomous Assault Unit - Typhon Destroyer , or Typhon Destroyer for short, is a Rebel Soldier unit.

As a heavy mech, the Typhon Destroyer is devoid of any added long-range firepower. Instead, its focus is on its Ether-Kinetic Armor.
Impact attacks, heavy blows, crushing... The Typhon Destroyer employs simple yet efficient tactical maneuvers to maximize the destructive power afforded to it by its Ether-Kinetic Armor. The shockwave effects from its strikes can even intimidate larger Ethereals...
Even the most seasoned Hollow Raiders can only let out a sigh of helplessness when confronted with the impenetrable Typhon Destroyer.
"The tall and robust physique, powerful and sturdy arms... It's my ideal type... I mean, ideal model."
—Grace playing with a model of Typhon Destroyer at the gadget store

entries.name: Shatterbug
entries.content:
A type of Ether Mutant.

According to research reports conducted by the Hollow Investigative Association, Blastcrawlers, with their low mobility and causing only small explosions, are classified as a "low-threat," "non-concern" lower-tier Ethereal.
However, astute businessmen have recognized the opportunities presented by their rounded bodies and short legs.
A film titled "Roll Over, Little Blastcrawler" gained significant popularity, leading to the sale of merchandise like Blastcrawler dolls and pillows at remarkably high prices.
"I didn't expect their dolls to be more deadly than the real deal... On your wallet at least. Looks like I'll be surviving on instant noodles next month, Billy..."
—Anby checking her wallet in front of the shopping street crane machine.

entries.name: Sacrifice - Bringer
entries.content:
From a drifter and survivor in the wilderness to the Deputy Commander of Janus Quarter, Bringer's life seemed an inspirational story.
But behind this inspirational story, unknown evils and conspiracies loom over Janus Quarter like dark clouds.
To achieve the ultimate goal of some grand cause, Bringer orchestrated the situation behind the scenes, scheming and plotting, and was willing to sacrifice everything for it.
In the final step to complete his plans, he even injected himself with the Sacrifice Serum, demonstrating his unwavering belief in his actions.
At that moment, all his desires and crazy beliefs manifested in a twisted and concrete form in the Hollow.
The surging active Ether energy, a supreme brute force that destroys everything... All bizarre beliefs and mingled desires reside within that newly born grotesque body...
Sacrifice - Bringer — his final identity and perfect form.
"Oh mighty Creator, refine me!"
—Bringer's heartfelt scream

In combat, Sacrifice - Bringer will transform into multiple weapons to perform a combination of close and ranged attacks, and will summon massive creatures from fissures to assist in his assault. After taking a certain amount of damage, he'll enter the second phase, during which he'll use more advanced attacks and continuously launch dense ranged barrages. Dealing sufficient damage while he charges up his Sacrificial Knife will interrupt charging and leave him exposed.

entries.name: Phee
entries.content: Phee is the sole employee of the Tater King food truck located at Port Elpis. The mobile eatery specialises in fries, which attracts seagulls. Players can purchase fries from her at midnight, but are unable to eat them due to the seagulls.

entries.name: Sycophant's Refinement
entries.content: A rare form of Etheric coagulum obtained from "Sacrifice" Bringer. There is no explanation, and further investigation is prohibited. This is Ether in a bizarre form, whispering to those who desire it of the consequences of greed.

entries.name: Scarlet Engine
entries.content: Etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, extracted from the Corrupted Overlord - Pompey. Although it appears to be merely a broken component, the immense etheric energy contained within seems to rumble incessantly.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Stealth Phantom
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Doppelganger - Jane, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Living Drive
entries.content: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Unknown Corruption Complex. It looks just like a normal joint, but keeps writhing around as though alive — like it's trying to power some colossus in a wild dance.

entries.name: Ferocious Grip
entries.content: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Dead End Butcher. Despite being completely shredded, it still retains the shape of something trying to grab.

entries.name: Finale Dance Shoes
entries.content: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Twin Marionettes. Just one look is enough to feel the hostile loneliness it exudes. Everything must come to an end, except in the Hollows.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Crimson Awe
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Troublemaker Wanted Bulky Enforcer, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Destructive Advance
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Typhon Slugger, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Ethereal Pursuit
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Notorious Armored Hati, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Falling Fist
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Notorious Armored Hati, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Murderous Obituary
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Notorious Dullahan, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Steel Malice
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous Investigators versus Hans the Energy Accumulator, including Investigators' most insightful impressions and assessments. It's enough data to see it "born and survive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Thunderous Dragon
entries.content: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Thracian, including their most profound impressions and evaluations of it. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

entries.name: Astra Yao
entries.content:
A member of the Stars of Lyra.

Completely different from The Queen she is under the spotlight, Astra Yao is more like an ordinary girl in her daily life... Though she has a curiosity that far exceeds that of a typical girl.
Astra doesn't seem to care much for things like company rules... She prefers sneaking out to hang out with her fans.
The imposing Queen and the bubbly girl — which one is the real Astra Yao? I can't help but feel like there's something inside her that drives her to be the way she is now...

Astra Yao is a singer and actress. She is known as the "most well known celebrity in New Eridu."

She had performed recently in her mega-concert "The Ultimate Voice", which led to a live album from that concert and a videotape labeled "f.f." being released afterwards. In an interview, she says that her new mega-concert is already in the works.

The last track on her album "Monologue" lasts for over 30 minutes and it is a compilation of her interviews on the "Jealous" magazine.

Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

Her fans are called Astranauts.

entries.name: Hemiola
entries.content:
Astra's exclusive performance instrument, handcrafted by renowned acoustics artisan Melody, is truly one of a kind.
When Astra's vocie merges with specific melodic frequencies, Hemiola unleashes awe-inspiring sonic waves, delivering a performance both graceful and lethal.

entries.name: Evelyn Chevalier
entries.content:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.

entries.name: Elegant Vanity
entries.content:
An S-Rank W-Engine. It's Astra Yao's signature W-Engine.

Light gradually begins to appear, and dazzling colors leak from the box, blurring the boundary between reality and fantasy. They reveal untold secrets behind the stage, where wealth and peril silently mingle, drawing in the observer and holding their gaze.

"This is my secret weapon~ All the gentleness, allure, strength, pride, and radiance of a girl are hidden inside!"
—Astra, blending her lip color with her ring finger, then closing the vanity case with a playful smile.

entries.name: Heartstring Nocturne
entries.content:
Evelyn's personal W-Engine.

The soft hum of hidden strings and faint light blooming in the deep night, where sharpness and calm intertwine, transforming into a silent melody. Thread by thread, it captures everything held dear within.

"The sound of the strings, sharp as blades, cut through the night, protecting the one."

"This? It's just a device for storing instrument strings."
—Evelyn, gently strumming the strings. A low hum fills the air, and as the final note echoes, the enemy falls silent.

entries.name: Lumberjack
entries.content:
Lumberjack is a heavily modified robotic Thug.

There are quite a few self-proclaimed "master inventors" among Hollow Raiders. Their most proficient skill is taking proper second-hand industrial materials and transforming the abandoned combat machines left by Public Security in the Hollow into not-so-proper personal creations.
High-speed chainsaws, toothed circular saws, hydraulic industrial arms... After simple assembly and rough welding, these common materials are stacked together to form a rare and dangerous piece of machinery.
To make it run smoothly, the creator has "thoughtfully" removed the safety restrictions of the machine and, based on its rugged appearance, named it the Lumberjack.
No one knows how long the Lumberjack can run stably.
Perhaps, at any moment, it could suddenly go berserk, swinging its high-speed rotating chainsaw and spikes with unmatched horsepower, launching an unstoppable logging fest that no one dares to stop.
But... this near-mad combat mode might just be the best modification outcome the creator had in mind.
"Why call it a 'Lumberjack'? There's no wood to chop in the Hollow, right?"
"Yeah, that's why it's so angry. When it starts up, it's reckless..."
— In the Hollow, a few Hollow Raiders are discussing the operating principles of the Lumberjack.

In combat, the Lumberjack constantly shifts its chainsaw's form to perform fluid combos, using its mounted wheels for swift movement. When enemies are out of reach, it fires saw blades to chase them down from a distance.

entries.name: Security Operative
entries.content:
These Security Operatives may look like ordinary security personnel, but don't be fooled — they're packing a whole arsenal of secret skills. Their job isn't just to stand at the door and look intimidating. They're the ones who step in when the boss has had one too many drinks, or who handle petty troublemakers with a cool "I've seen it all before" expression. Their mission isn't to fight crime — it's to keep the boss from falling over, fix the elevator at the entrance, and, above all, stay under the radar. In their world, the most powerful weapon is "looking like a total badass," and the best outcome is "having nothing to do." After all, a great Security Operative is someone you don't even notice — until the problem's solved and people realize, "Oh, they were here the whole time."
"If you can stand steady enough, no one's tougher than you."
— Written by a veteran security guard on the front page of the Security Personnel Operations Manual

entries.name: Terror Raptor
entries.content:
Terror Raptor is a Rebel Soldier Unit.

A veteran of countless battles, the Terror Raptor is New Eridu's most trusted weapon of war. Designed for a perfect balance of brutal melee and devastating ranged firepower, it delivers destruction with every charge, stomp, and strike. Armed with multi-missile launchers and rapid-fire guns, it dominates both close and distant combat. From leaping assaults to explosive barrages and swift aerial retreats, the Raptor adapts to any battlefield with ease. Its relentless attacks leave enemies no room to fight back, embodying both unstoppable power and overwhelming fear.
"Terror Raptor was the symbol of that era."
— As written in "The Battle of the Old Capital: Truth and Memories"

In combat, the Terror Raptor relies on its agile, powerful mechanical legs for close-range attacks while unleashing a barrage of ranged weapons to suppress its enemy. Use Defensive Assists to rebound its missiles back, leaving the Terror Raptor temporarily paralyzed.

entries.name: @AstraYao_Nomics
entries.content: @AstraYao_Nomics is an official account on X, formerly known as Twitter. It is Astra Yao's personal account in which she posts updates on her upcoming projects.

entries.name: Black Anchor
entries.content:
The Black Anchor is a gang. Primarily located in Port Elpis, they come into conflict with Phaethon after one of their thugs is caught threatening Venus.

At some point, the Black Anchor began making several unidentifiable transactions within the Hollow, the details and participants of which were highly classified. These activities were recorded by Bangboo Merchants, creating the risk of scandal should they be leaked to the public. As such, the gang opted to conduct an operation within the Hollow to wipe out all the Bangboo: the original plan to take out the specific Bangboo with the recording had to be changed due to the Hollow's complex nature making it impossible to find. To that end, the gang posed as normal clients on Inter-Knot and arranged for a rookie Proxy to guide them to the merchants, as hiring a simple rookie would make them easier to kill afterwards.

However, this operation would mark the beginning of the end for the gang. The hired Proxy witnessed the gang members silencing the merchants and secretly sabotaged them before sneaking away. Not long after, the vigilante Bangboo Kami North caught wind of their assault and began hunting the gang down. With the gang coming under pressure, they tracked down Venus (the broker who hired the Proxy for them) and began threatening her to reveal the Proxy's location to them. This attracted the attention of Wise/Belle, who was in Port Elpis at the time and threatened to report them to New Eridu Public Security. Upon learning the situation, they agreed to help relocate Venus to Sixth Street for the time being, only to fall into a trap set up by second-in-command Lana that nearly resulted in the pair getting brutally assaulted by gang members before Kami North arrived to save them. Taking out several thugs, they manage to find out the location of the gang's hideout from one of them before Gerant and Sita arrive on the scene. With the info in hand and Venus' safety assured, Phaethon and Kami North storm the gang's hideout to finally take them down. The members were successfully taken out, with Lana (who attempted to escape with the gang's ledgers and call upon reinforcements) being captured by Public Security thanks to Kami North's anonymous tip, bringing an end to the Black Anchor.

entries.name: Venus
entries.content:
She is a commission broker, sometimes providing Phaethon with challenging commissions to help them gain Inter-Knot Credit. 
She can sometimes be found sitting at a table at Coff Cafe's Sixth Street or Lumina Square locations.

entries.name: Criminal Investigation Special Response Team
entries.content:
The Criminal Investigation Special Response Team is a team within New Eridu Public Security.

The Criminal Investigation Special Response Team is a division of PubSec operating out of the Janus Quarter (namely, in its Lumina Square branch). They are tasked with the investigation of criminal activity, performing raids and in-Hollow operations. Officer Zhu Yuan is the current captain of the team, an exceptional member of the force with no unresolved cases. The Criminal Investigation team is shown to hire external assistance, most notably Jane Doe, an enigmatic criminal behaviour specialist who serves as both a consultant and an undercover agent for them.

entries.name: Faunus Quarter
entries.content: The Faunus Quarter is a district in New Eridu.

entries.name: Sarah
entries.content:
Sarah is a mysterious young businesswoman and member of The Order. Although she first appeared to be a secretary for the Vision Corporation, she has a major role in the greater conspiracy of making humanity enter the Age of Hollows.

Sarah first appeared under the guise of being the personal secretary of Charles Perlman, the CEO of the Vision Corporation. In reality, Perlman was no more than a puppet serving the interests of Sarah, Justin Bringer and The Order. While in this role, Sarah directed Perlman to demolish the Hollow-consumed Old Capital Metro in order to retrieve the Sacrifice hidden inside the monument at Pioneer's Memorial Plaza. The plan — which would have killed hundreds of trapped residents — was foiled by the Cunning Hares and Phaethon, who worked together to evacuate Canvas Street and expose Vision's crimes, despite Sarah's attempts to kill them. Though Perlman was arrested by New Eridu Public Security, Sarah managed to slip away.

Facing trial, an imprisoned Perlman tried to blackmail Sarah and Bringer, threatening to reveal their involvement with the evidence theft unless they helped him escape prison. Sarah appeared to accept his terms, giving him a suitcase for him to open during his airship transport to the New Eridu Supreme Court. This, however, was a ruse; the suitcase contained a sleeping agent which knocked out Perlman and everyone else aboard the airship. The airship was then remotely steered into the Lemnian Hollow by a kidnapped Rain, with the intention of killing Perlman and the other passengers. Having discovered the conspiracy in the nick of time, the Victoria Housekeeping Co. and Phaethon rescued Rain and prevented the airship's crash, allowing Perlman to escape into the Outer Ring.

With the elections getting closer, Sarah assisted Bringer in his election campaign with a plan to take down the H.S.O.S.6 Chief and Void Hunter Hoshimi Miyabi. She revealed that the Order was behind the hacking of Phaethon's Inter-Knot account and the Null_Face attack against Section 6 during the VR test.

The two aimed to steal the power contained inside the Hoshimi family's cursed katana Tailless by kidnapping Miyabi. After tricking Miyabi into entering custody, Sarah stole the energy from the katana and then forced Miyabi to being consumed by Foxfire, unleashing a possessed Miyabi on an unwitting crowd of civilians at Bringer's election speech, hoping for a massacre that would discredit HAND. However, Miyabi managed to overcome the possession and prevent a tragedy with the help of Zhu Yuan and Phaethon.

An exposed and cornered Bringer fled to Port Elpis, where he injected himself with Elixir P07, transforming himself into a Sacrifice. During the fight against Section 6, Sarah shot Bringer with another vial of Elixir P07, completing his transformation. Though Bringer was ultimately defeated, Sarah slipped away, declaring on a phonecall that the elixir was effective and that Bringer had accomplished his mission.

entries.name: The Order
entries.content:
The Order (official name unknown) is a religious cult in New Eridu.

The Order is a group of fanatics who embrace the Hollow disaster that befell the world long ago and adore the Creator: their goal is to "refine" humanity into the next step of evolution an make it enter the Age of Hollows. They have influential connections and moles within New Eridu's high society and government, such as Public Security (Justin Bringer), the White Star Institute (Alowyn Mystik) and big corporations (Sarah, who infiltrated Vision), but also with powerful hackers such as Null_Face and White Noise.

Its members are very faithful to the grand cause of The Order, and are thus willing to sacrifice themselves fully, to the point of killing themselves in the process. In fact, the people who are meant to get refined are called Sacrifices.

It is unknown when The Order was founded, but it safe to assume it was after the first Hollow disasters started happening. It is reported that they were publicly active as a religious group before the Fall of the Old Capital, as they held rallies in the open; it is unknown why they went undercover in New Eridu.
The Hollow Zero disaster seems to be tied to the Order, as someone tried to retrieve the Sacrifice sealed inside the monument at Pioneer's Memorial Plaza the night before the Fall, and on the same night Carole Arna was abducted by one of the Creator's hands while the Helios Academy was under siege by mysterious armed groups and "monsters". Moreover, their chanting can be heard inside Hollow Zero.
They were behind the attack at the Arpeggio Fault Old Laboratory two years ago, but at the last moment Alowyn betrayed the mission and instead saved the Institute researchers she got attached to, dying in the process. However, The Order managed to enter the Laboratory nonetheless, leaving a message behind.
The Order was also responsible all the major events encountered by Phaethon from the Prologue to Chapter 5. They have developed Elixir P07 to refine humans into their Ethereal perfect form, with the direct help of the Creator.

Members: Alowyn Mystik (formerly, deceased), Justin Bringer, Sarah, The Creator, The Prophet.

entries.name: Energy Production
entries.content:
To generate usable power, advanced pipe networks extract Etheric matter from existing Hollows. The absorbed Etheric energy is then converted into electricity, while any leftover Ether corruption is released into the air through a process called "Shiyu". This purification takes place at specialized pillars located in and around the city, where monsters created by the corruption are regularly purged.

Ether appears to be an incredibly potent power source, with most buildings, vehicles, and appliances in New Eridu using it as fuel. Ether corporations have yet to extend their reach beyond the city, where rural residents and biker gangs still use diesel fuel.

entries.name: Hoshimi Family
entries.content:
The Hoshimi Family is a notable family of powerful warriors in New Eridu.

Currently based in New Eridu, the Hoshimi Family are seemingly in terminal decline due to the Hollow Zero disaster many years ago. During the event, Hoshimi Miyabi was guided by her mother to end her life, as she had fallen under the effects of Ether corruption and was set to turn into an monster.

entries.name: Intelligent Construct
entries.content:
Intelligent Constructs are sapient robots who inhabit New Eridu.

Intelligent Constructs have artificial bodies with a variety of physical characteristics. Some, like Qingyi, look nearly identical to humans. Most, however, have obvious mechanical features such as metal plating, unconventional body shapes, or exposed charge ports.

Unlike Bangboo and non-sapient robots, Intelligent Constructs have free will. They can think, act, and make their own decisions without outside intervention, since Intelligent Constructs are, per definition, self-aware machines that have passed the "Forbidden Fruit Test."

As robots, Intelligent Constructs can customize their bodies more readily than humans. They also demonstrate much better Ether aptitude on average.

entries.name: Mountain Lion Gang
entries.content: The Mountain Lion Gang is a group introduced in Undercover R&B. Jane Doe was a double agent sent by the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. They were lead by Razor.

entries.name: New Eridu Defense Force
entries.content:
The New Eridu Defense Force is a military organization under the New Eridu City Administration. They are tasked with protecting New Eridu from external threats, primarily Hollows.
Not much is currently known about the Defense Force. They operate Scott Outpost, helping protect New Eridu by containing Hollow Zero. They have also been seen working in conjunction with H.A.N.D.

Rebel Soldiers are rogue members of the Defense Force who act for various private interests, or who have become bandits.

Typical Defense Force squads consist of light infantry (Jaegers), heavily-armored assault units (Gunners), and armed tactical mechs (Strikers, Rovers, Guardians, and Typhons).

Although the Defense Force once had multiple divisions, all but the Obsidian Division were wiped out when Eridu was destroyed by Hollow Zero.

Divisions:

Obsidian Division,
Obol Squad,
Diamond Divison (destroyed),
Chrysoberyl Division (destroyed).

entries.name: Oni
entries.content:
Oni, or Demons, are a species in New Eridu.

Oni are a race of humanoids with demonic traits. They have red, blue, or yellow skin, pointed elf-like ears, demonic tails, fangs, black-tipped horns extruding from their foreheads, and white hair. The lifespan of an Oni seems to be much longer than that of an average human, but with a slower maturity speed. The Oni's liver has stronger detox functions than an ordinary human or Thiren, allowing them to eat more without the concern of adverse effects.


Unlike Thirens and Intelligent Constructs, they were not among the races listed for New Eridu citizenship. It appears that a group of rebel Oni fought the New Eridu Defense Force to try to gain citizenship a few years ago, although they were unsuccessful: both sides suffered heavy losses, especially among Oni fighters. Tsukishiro Yanagi, the one responsible for the last leader's death, gained the trust of the latter and was infused with her Oni blood, which artificially turns her into a hybrid with newly improved strength and thus inherited the role as a new Oni leader.

Though it is unclear what is the current status of the Oni species in New Eridu after Yanagi's takeover as the Oni guardian, it is known that the young Oni Soukaku was able to join H.A.N.D., becoming one of the city's protectors and amassing a fanbase in the process.

entries.name: Cheesetopia
entries.content:
Cheesetopia is a diner in Blazewood that plays a major role in the Overlord's Feast Event. Though initially abandoned, Cheesetopia eventually becomes operational after Phaethon's aid.

It is owned and operated by Kasa.

entries.name: Bear Thiren
entries.content:
Bear Thiren are a distinct type of the larger Beast Thiren group. Known for their impressive size and intimidating presence, Bear Thiren are often mistaken for dangerous creatures. However, the common belief that they consume intelligent life forms is a myth.

Bear Thiren share many physical traits with other Beast Thirens, like their high "Ether aptitude," which surpasses that of most other people. This attribute allows them to excel in Hollow-related jobs and activities, explaining why they are a top-pick for in-Hollow construction projects, with Bear Thirens comprising around 80% of Belobog Heavy Industries' staff.

Bear Thiren have made significant contributions to New Eridu, notably in the field of space exploration. Historical records reveal that there were Bear Thiren cosmonauts who ventured into space, showcasing their resilience and adaptability.

Bear Thiren are known for their calm demeanor and resistance to stress. They maintain their composure under pressure, a trait that sets them apart from many other species. However, their patience has limits. Unlike Canine Thirens, who can often be placated with food, Bear Thiren require more than simple gestures to calm them. When a Bear Thiren loses its temper, fleeing is the most prudent course of action, as they rarely show patience in confrontations.

entries.name: Boar Thiren
entries.content: Boar Thiren are red-skinned Beast Thiren with a variety of appearances. Some (like Big Daddy) are relatively humanoid, while others (like Grassy, Woody and Bricky) are much more pig-like, having short stature similar to a Bangboo. These Thiren also seem to be extremely durable and have high pain tolerances.

entries.name: Pulchra Fellini
entries.content:
A cat Thiren and a member of the Sons of Calydon.

Pulchra is an Outer Ring mercenary whose loyalty constantly fluctuates depending on who she deems the strongest. After several run-ins with the Sons of Calydon, she gained respect for the gang and began to reconsider her allegiance to The Vanquishers.. In combat, Pulchra fights with a pair of 'Bladeguns' (which appear as revolvers with blades on the grip) and an array of gadgets, including stun grenades, explosives and reflex-enhancing tonics.

Pulchra Fellini was hired by Lucius of The Vanquishers[Note 1] to sabotage the Sons of Calydon before the Tour de Inferno began. She first helped the gang buy out vehicle suppliers' stocks under the Sons of Calydon's name, weakening other gangs and hurting the Sons of Calydon's reputation. Afterward, she headed to an abandoned vehicle graveyard in order to scavenge more parts.

Expecting the Sons of Calydon to come, she set up explosives in order to ambush them, she managed to get Burnice caught in the explosion, but was soon caught off-guard herself by the human's eccentric personality, granting enough time for her fellow members to catch up. After a small battle, Pulchra, recognizing her opponents' strength, surrendered, offering to hand over all the vehicle parts in exchange for them keeping quiet about the confrontation. Burnice accepted Pulchra's offer and invited her to join the Sons of Calydon, though Pulchra refused and waited to see if they are the strongest in the Outer Ring.

Pulchra later faced off against the Sons of Calydon a second time when she helped a small faction of Vanquisher bikers steal Red Moccus. After another battle, she surrendered again and left the bikers to fend for themselves, finally considering the Sons of Calydon to be the strongest.

Employment records for Pulchra were found for two Outer Ring mercenary groups that disbanded years ago. She was hired alongside a young woman named Milena, but her records completely vanished about eight years ago.
Around eight years ago, Pulchra briefly formed a small mercenary group, but no records were found regarding the team members or the reason for its dissolution. Her personal career suddenly began to take off after this.

Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds. Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu. Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods.

Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

entries.name: New Eridu Public Security Lumina Branch
entries.content: This branch of New Eridu Public Security is located in Lumina Square. It is the base of operations for the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team faction. The officers based here are in charge of both peacekeeping operations and administrative duties within the city center.
entries.comment: New Eridu Public Security Lumina Branch

entries.name: Port Elpis Hollow
entries.content:
The Port Elpis Hollow is a Companion Hollow of the Lemnian Hollow.

In Port Elpis, where slogans outnumber beacons, the city engulfed by the Hollow was formed by two layers of overlapping structures: Torchlit Lighthouse stands in the darkness, yet it guids the upper layers. The port walkway meanders through, with lost souls wandering in the labyrinth of containers, searching for the rescue number that's long been torn off.

At the edge of the city and the sea, you see the slogan that reads, "You can's cathc anything by the riverbank, and you certainly can't here." But the port authority would tell you that it's not a warning, but a fated prophecy. If you want to know, the port authority also believes that they do not embrace negativity, but the most positive things - Elpis is the deity of hope and expectation. This port later became a transit hub during the fall of the old capital, and thus has long been known as "Hope."

entries.name: Outer Ring Hollow
entries.content:
The Outer Ring Hollow is the name given to the Companion Hollow of Papago in the Outer Ring.

In the vast wilderness outside the central district of New Eridu, a group of wild and free souls uphold a unique way of life — motorcycles and fuel. Eternally Inextinguishable Cinder Lake allows them to live without relying on Ether, and because of this, they can escape the city's noise, freely roaming the dust of the Outer Ring.
The Outer Ring has its own rules and its own "Overlords." However, the Hollow haze is drawing near, as the Companion Hollow of the Papago begins to spread across this land...

entries.name: Ballet Twins Hollow
entries.content:
The Ballet Twins Hollow is a Companion Hollow of the Lemnian Hollow, that has currently engulfed the Ballet Twins. In recent times, the Hollow has shrunk, allowing parts of the towers to be exposed and visible from outside.

The Ballet Twins skyscraper was constructed by the Ballet Group, a once wealthy real estate company. Tragically, after the fall of the old capital, the Ballet Group went bankrupt, and the Ballet Twins were swallowed by a Hollow. Long ago, when the Ballet brothers were on the last tram, heading through the heart of Eridu, Bolt Ballet pointed to the bright lights and declared, "One day, we'll build the tallest building in all of Eridu there."

entries.name: Dead End Hollow
entries.content:
The Dead End Hollow is a Companion Hollow of the Cretan Hollow, that is located near Canvas Street.

Despite being a Companion Hollow, which are typically regarded as safer and easier to navigate than the original Hollows, the Dead End Hollow has become infamous for how dangerous it is, due to the presence of the Dead End Butcher.

entries.name: Papago Hollow
entries.content: The Papago Hollow, also known as the "Divine Maze," is one of the seven original Hollows and was first navigated by the Void Hunter "Joyous".

entries.name: Lemnian Hollow
entries.content:
The Lemnian Hollow is one of the seven original Hollows.

Located in the northwest of the Old Capital Chasm, Lemnian Hollow resides at a considerable distance from the citizens of New Eridu. However, it is also the most active among its six siblings in New Eridu, and the residential areas are frequently troubled by the presence of its Companion Hollows.
I was once told a legend from the old civilization: Amidst the isles of Lemnian, our ancestors raised grand temples and sacred shrines. But in the new world, this story looks different: Deep in the depths of Lemnian lies an abyss, infested with the nests and lairs of the evil. Cease your prayers. Cease your prayers.

entries.name: Cretan Hollow
entries.content:
The Cretan Hollow is one of the seven original Hollows.

Located on the border of the Janus Quarter, Cretan Hollow neighbors the desolate old capital area. Its impact on citizens' daily lives is relatively minor, but it still often causes disaster alerts in the eastern districts.
"Long had the throne fallen, with beasts caged in eternal struggle. And the gods, as ever, watch in silence." —A verse was carved onto the wall of a deserted tunnel in the old metro swallowed by the Cretan Hollow.

entries.name: Kirishima
entries.content:
Kirishima is a scientist who works on developing Ether corruption-suppressing technology.

Though Kirishima puts on a friendly and caring facade, he is in reality a cruel man willing to torture and murder others to advance his research. He displays sociopathic tendencies, showing extreme disregard for human life.

Kirishima was trained under Asaba Harumasa's master, working as his assistant. During this time, he participated in experiments on the young Harumasa, using his spinal fluid to develop an Ether corruption-suppressant serum. Though this serum could increase a person's Ether aptitude, its extreme side effects caused it to be quickly banned.

Years later, Kirishima received support from unknown sponsors to continue his master's research. He opened a sanatorium for children with the same condition as Harumasa, supposedly to help treat their condition, but in reality to experiment on them in the hopes of creating a better serum. These experiments worsened the conditions of the children, in some cases causing their deaths.

entries.name: Hitchspiker
entries.content:
A type of ether mutant.

Ether is a greedy, insatiable parasite, a vicious creature that devours once-vibrant lives.
The Hitchspiker is an even more malicious incarnation of Ether — dwelling within the bodies of its cruel counterparts, it enables Tyrfing and Alpeca to satisfy the voracious appetites of the Hollows in an even more ferocious manner.
"Get away from my face!"

They look like white scorpions.

entries.name: Gemina
entries.content: Gemina, the exclusive weapon of Soldier 0 - Anby, is a pair of twin blades imbued with thunderous power. Its core is embedded with a resonator-like device that can guide high-energy electric currents, capable of releasing intense electric jolts with each slash. Every strike is like a sudden surge of lightning, illuminating Anby's unstoppable battle fervor. The blades are like twin sisters calling out and responding to each other on the ravages of the harsh battlefield, severing the past and forging a new future.

entries.name: Mayflowers
entries.content: The family that played a large part in building Eridu. They are the the owners of the city administration / government. The head of the family is the mayor of the city. The Mayflowers are in constant struggle with the multi-company conglomerate known as TOPS.

entries.name: Lunalux Garrote
entries.content: A razor-sharp weapon crafted to meet Evelyn's particular professional needs. Made from strong, tough Porcelume fibers and linked at the tip to a brilliantly sharp Porcelume blade. This weapon is lightweight and discreet, making it easy to carry, while also being capable of bypassing security checks focused on uncovering more commonplace weapons. While capable of functioning as a noose, under special circumstances, the Lunalux Garrote can be set ablaze along its entire length. Its ingenious design ensures every strike is clean and precise. Much like Evelyn herself, the Lunalux Garrote is both restrained yet sharp, elegant yet deadly.

entries.name: Silver Squad / Silver Company
entries.content:
It was a squad under the Obsidian Division of the Defense Force that got wiped out during the Fall of the Old Capital, with the squad leader, Anby, and Soldier 11 being the only survivors.

It was secretly biologically replicating soldiers; they weren't mass-produced because they were expensive to train. Creating the body is one thing; recreating the individual's strength and skill is another. Those unique qualities couldn't be fully replicated in mass production. They were not seen as humans, inferior replicas were seen as disposable, defective replicas would have parts of their bodies given to others, as forceful organ donors, and they would need to replace those parts with mechanical life-like parts. It eventually fell, likely due to the constant agendas of those within it, and so the technology they had for replication was lost, that is, until Twiggy, one of the surviving replicas, tried to revive it. During the fall of the company, the army had decided to only keep one replica and have all others die by forcing the weaker replicas to take a suicide mission. They intended to keep the captain, Anby, who was the strongest replica, soldier 11 injured herself the night before the mission in training, and Anby used that opportunity to replace her and "die" in her place, as all other replicas were presumed dead with the exception of Twiggy. Anby had survived the mission, only remembering the rubble and her dead sisters around her, not knowing how she lived. Since soldier 11 was still alive, the higher-ups had told Anby to execute her; instead, she offered to exchange her life for soldier 11's and left, believing that they would spare soldier 11 as long as Anby was nowhere to be seen since she'd be their last asset. All replicas refer to each other as "sisters". Besides their organic makeup, there are some differences between them and normal humans, for example, anaesthetics do not work on them. When they are severely injured, they may lose their memories temporarily. Also, when injured, they can use all their energy to focus on recovery and healing. Eventually Twiggy, with the help of an unknown organisation, would try to revive the company; she would come close to perfecting the technology but would fail in making anything but replicas that are incapable of fighting. Instead they served as organ donors to fund her research. Anby and Soldier 11 would put a stop to this after defeating Twiggy, who had died after turning herself into an ethereal and failing to defeat them both. It is unclear whether Anby had completely destroyed the research or kept it partially in secret, as she was conflicted in her decision.

entries.name: Lady de Winter
entries.content:
Tessa de Winter is the widow of Joran de Winter, a musician whose work inspired the pop idol Astra Yao. After Joran committed suicide, a grief-stricken Tessa blamed his death on the studios who had warred over the rights to his work, Odeum and Fugue. Enraged, she resolved to take revenge on Joran's "murderers" no matter the cost.

Tessa chose to take revenge on Odeum and Fugue by sabotaging Astra Yao's "Astra-nomical Moment" concert at Starloop Tower. Knowing that Astra was one of Odeum's most valuable assets — and that Fugue was trying to take her for themselves — Tessa exploited the companies' rivalries, helping lure both their teams to Starloop Tower on the night of the concert. While Odeum and Fugue were busy fighting each other, Tessa sabotaged the tower's thrusters while it was in flight, planning to cause a crash that would kill Astra; the staff of Odeum and Fugue; and the concert's spectators, whom she resented for forgetting Joran so quickly.

Though Tessa's plan nearly succeeded, it was foiled by Evelyn Chevalier, a Fugue operative who was working undercover as Astra's manager and bodyguard. Having realized that something was amiss, Evelyn fought through both Odeum and Fugue's bodyguards to rescue Astra. As the two reunited onstage, Tessa revealed herself to them, using a powerful robot to attack them. After defeating it, Astra and Phaethon managed to re-align the tower's thrusters and save the concert from crashing into New Eridu.

After Starloop Tower safely landed, Tessa was arrested by New Eridu Public Security.

entries.name: Joran de Winter
entries.content:
He is the late husband of Tessa de Winter.

Joran de Winter was a famous singer whose work inspired the pop idol Astra Yao. He committed suicide, allegedly due to stress and despair caused by contract disputes and criticism from his fans.

Astra Yao's concert "Astra-nomical Moment" was to feature "Joran's Legacy", a never-before-seen recording of his final performance that he gave at a music store on Sixth Street.

entries.name: Twiggy
entries.content:
Twiggy was one of the members of the Silver Squad.

A defective replica from Silver Company idolises her former ex-captain, Anby. She was the worst at fighting but made up for it with her intelligence, being the strategic mind of Silver Company; her strategies involved unorthodox tactics, and she believed that there was no cost too great in order to win for worst-case scenarios. Anby had persuaded the company to keep Twiggy. She assisted in the research of the company and aided in creating new replicas or "sisters", as she calls it.

Cunning and smart, during her days in the Silver Squad, Twiggy made up for her lack of combat prowess with strategy and backup planning. The tortures she endured after being found limbless in the rubble made her cynical and heartless, although deep down she nurtured a strong desire to go back when her "family" was alive, together and "happy", hence the attempt at reforming the Silver Company.

Twiggy was one of the replicas used as soldiers in the Defense Force Obsidian Division Silver Squad. Like most younger "sisters" of Anby, she was not as well-versed in combat as her captain, and made up for it with her intelligence and strategy, coming up with battle formations and backup plans.

When the Silver Squad was sent on a suicide mission, Twiggy survived under the rubble and the corpses of her fellow squadmates, but all her limbs got severely corrupted, leading to amputation. The Hollow Raiders who found her sold her off on the black market, where she got treated like merchadise and traded multiple times, until she was bought by an ex military doctor gone rogue, who gave her prosthetic limbs and the chance to form the Silver Squad once again: combining incomplete research data stolen from the Defense Force archives with her memories, Twiggy managed to revive the technology behind replica creation.

Nonetheless, the data in Twiggy's hands was not enough to create replicas with fighting abilities, but only "defects" like Girl A, so she used her newfound "sisters" for organ harvesting to fund her research and get in touch with TOPS, particularly Hartman Ravenlock and his family. Her allies also managed to kidnap Soldier 11. Discovered by Anby and Trigger, Twiggy tried to persuade the ex captain to join her in the reformation of the Silver Squad; however, Anby was of the opposite idea, deeming the Silver Company as evil technology that should never resurface again.

When faced with Anby's refusal and the guilt of what she did to her fellow replicas, she began injecting herself with a serum provided by her client, only to get Girl A to snatch the syringe from her hands and inject herself with the other half. Under the effect of the serum, the two turned into the Ethereal Palicus, and were defeated by Soldier 0 - Anby and Soldier 11. In her dying moments, the corrupted Twiggy was still able to talk, briefly reliving her memories as a member of the Silver Squad under the care of Anby before passing away.

entries.name: Box Cutter
entries.content:
This W-Engine's design was originally much more modest. The focus during its creation was on offensive capability and stealth until its owner met a group of curious and loud individuals who had no concept of subtlety. Not only did they put flashy stickers on it, but after injuring their fingers, they often used it to cut ropes, open boxes, and even slice through sticky tape...
"That... yeah, that box cutter, lemme borrow it, thanks!" "Boss, it's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Hey, Kitty, lemme borrow your box cutter!" "It's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Mind if lil ol me takes your box cutter for a mo?" "..."

"Fine, it's a box cutter. Whatever makes you happy." — Pulchra

entries.name: Palicus
entries.content:
A pair of twin Ether Mutants.

Ethereals that are always seen in pairs, distinguished by their peculiar physical traits. A profound bond exists between the two.

In combat, the Palicus fight by combining both close and ranged attacks. When one dies, the other will enter a Frenzy state, increasing the speed and ferocity of its attacks.

"Whoa, that was close! Don't just deal with one. You gotta watch out for the ladies' sneak attacks!"
"Hold on, 'ladies'? Has being in the Hollow for so long made you see even the Ethereals as attractive?"
"Dude, I know Ethereals and I know ladies. I swear, Palicus are definitely 'ladies'."
"No way!"
"That long hair? Those legs? They're like total 'factory-made babes' — my sister taught me that term."
"How's your sister doing lately?"
"She's actually getting better. But next month's medical bills? Gotta hustle that cash from these Ethereal hotties."
"Ain't easy being an older brother, eh? Here's the deal: I'll keep Palicus busy, and you give me your sister's number."
"Hah. Like I'm actually gonna give you her number!" —The last words of two young Hollow Raiders

entries.name: Abyssal Enforcer
entries.content:
The leader of the phantom thieves syndicate "Mockingbird" is not only a master of disguise and deception, but also wields an unpredictable combat style that keeps foes on edge. His colossal scythe appears to exist solely for the purpose of harvesting the "injustices" of the world. The suitcase he carried with him was even more mysterious, concealing the clever tools and deadly weapons needed for his crimes, making every one of his actions filled with uncertainty and danger.

In combat, the Abyssal Enforcer will actively evade enemies and activate Vital View, followed by a powerful rush attack. This skill can be countered with Perfect Dodge or Perfect Assist.

entries.name: Specialized Assault Bomber
entries.content:
A heavy infantry unit belonging to the New Eridu Defense Force.
Equipped with "Gray Rhino" heavy combat armor paired with a complete arsenal enhanced using Ether technology, they can sustain high-intensity firepower for an extended period when ample ammunition is available. They serve as the assault core of a combat team and are often deployed as the front line in assault and clearance operations.
After the fall of the old capital, many soldiers left the army and joined civilian factions. Since then, these elite gunners have emerged under various banners, including private armies of plutocrats, new security companies, and even roving gangs of bandits...
"I'm convinced those heavy gunners are secretly adorable little girls who somehow manage to hide all that ammo in the extra pockets of their combat suits. I mean, how else can you explain their endless stockpile of shells?" —Comment on the Daydream page of the Planet of Disaster forum.

In combat, the Specialized Assault Bomber combines martial arts with various weapons to suppress enemies. Upon entering an overheated state, certain moves are enhanced by flames for even fiercer attacks. If enough damage is inflicted during this overheated state, their gear can be destroyed, weakening their abilities.

entries.name: Geppetto
keys: Parasitic Ethereal Swarm Code Name: Geppetto
entries.content:
A powerful Ether Mutant.

Among the most fearsome symbiotic entities in Hollow Zero, Geppetto, thanks to its distinctive posture, often leaves an unsettling first impression.
Its immense, terrifying form harbors violent Ether energy, yet it moves with the unsettling grace of a puppet, often performing strange and unpredictable actions. In the absence of sufficient observational data, an encounter with Geppetto in Hollow Zero typically heralds enormous dread and inescapable death for any investigator.
Some scholars speculate, drawing from the records of Parasitic Ethereal Swarm, that this horrific outer shell is merely a facade, while a volatile potent Ether Core lies in command within.
Regrettably, no investigation records regarding this mysterious core have yet come to light.
"I've never met the Grim Reaper, but I've definitely seen what his puppet looks like." —Special Feature of Interview on Back 2 Life, talks with an elite investigator of Hollow Zero.

In combat, Geppetto unleashes large area attacks using both its body and Ether energy. After its hands and tail take sufficient DMG, they'll be destroyed, leaving it paralyzed. Geppetto will repair these destroyed parts when summoning Ether enemies or deploying Curtain of Phantoms. Additionally, Geppetto's Curtain of Phantoms inflicts the Suspended status on enemies who touch it, reducing their movement speed and preventing Skill usage.

entries.name: Trigger
entries.content:
A member of Obol Squad, the designated Sniper of the team.

Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.
She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.
As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.
In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.

entries.name: Severed Innocence
entries.content:
"The sheen of silver is not innocence. Can the blades of the past cut through fate's connections?"

If a storm subdued still has the power to save a certain person... The ringing of the old sword in its crate speaks of the "good" old days that one doesn't want to remember.

"Nekomata, put it down. No, there's no secret... Nicole, please let me explain, she was the one who started it..." — Anby, just a typical day with the Cunning Hares.

entries.name: Vivian
entries.content:
A member of Mockingbird.

"Do not close the window, for the birds will bring love and carry away death."

She was born with the power to see the future, but it would always be a negative premonition; she was ostracised for it. Always sheds tears when she gets a premonition. She usually sees death, disease, accidents and disasters. No matter what she's tried, she's never been able to change them. Obsessed with the legendary proxy duo Phaethon, refers to them as "Lord Phaethon". 

Though she looks like a vampire she seems to be based off a banshee.

entries.name: Hugo Vlad
entries.content:
Hugo is a prominent member of Mockingbird who also has links to the Marcel Group. He is the owner of the Bangboo known as Robin.

Hugo was once friends and partners-in-crime with Von Lycaon, but after an unknown incident, this friendship turned into rivalry, with Hugo proclaiming the wolf Thiren as a traitor. After an incident involving a gang imitating Mockingbird, Hugo talked to himself about an upcoming reunion with Lycaon.

Hugo partook in Gilded Carrot Day with his Bangboo, Robin and accompanied by Vivian. Before the next round they met with Phaethon, Eous and Astra Yao, Hugo was allowed to inspect Astra's microphone, Hemiola, before leaving to prepare for the competition. After their round against the Proxy and Eous ended in a tie they withdrew, the Proxy then asked Astra to check her microphone, but nothing seems to have been altered. The next day, Astra Yao, per the request of Lycaon, checked Hemiola again and discovered that the self-produced copy of "Stars of Lyra" had been swapped out with a more expensive limited edition copy.

He is referred to as being from an impure bloodline and the "bastard son of a renowned family". He has one red eye and one blue. He apparently killed his half-sister Serena; his family worked off of rankings, and monthly assessments would be done to see who was number one. His father was strict; anyone who wasn't #1 was seen as a loser. Being underhanded and doing anything to get ahead was encouraged, even if it meant killing your own blood. His true full name is Hugo Vlad Ravenlock. He has the appearancec of a vampire though it is unclear if he actually is one, according to himself he has hypoglycemia.

entries.name: Robin
entries.content:
Robin is a bangboo owned by Hugo of the phantom thief group Mockingbird. He is a top coach for Marcel Group and is friends with Coach Aster.

Robin partakes in Gilded Carrot Day alongside Hugo. Despite their round against Eous and Phaethon ending in a tie, he and his owner forfeited, as they had succeeded in their mission.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries.content:
Sacrifices are creatures, once human, that have trascended their humanity by attaining the Refinement sought by The Order. Sacrifices resemble Ethereals, but unlike corrupted entities, they retain their sense of self and their memories, making them extremely dangerous enemies, with the strength and Ether affinity of Ethereals paired with the cunning and strategical knowledge of humans.

They can exist outside of hollows unlike ethereals, and they carry human genes, there is a core inside them that has the same properties, multiple sacrifices are hibernating in crystals in hollows across New Eridu and the exaltists plan awaken and use them to upend the city itself.

entries.name: The Exaltists
entries.content:
A religious cult.

The Exaltists are a group of fanatics who embrace the Hollow disaster that befell the world long ago and adore the Creator: their goal is to "refine" humanity into the next step of evolution and make it enter the Age of Hollows. They have influential connections and moles within New Eridu's high society and government, such as Public Security (Justin Bringer), the White Star Institute (Alowyn Mystik) and big corporations (Sarah, who infiltrated Vision), but also with powerful hackers such as Null_Face and White Noise.


It is unknown when The Order was founded, but it is safe to assume it was after the first Hollow disasters began occurring. One of their leaders, the Exaltist Overseer, was taken down by "Swordmaster" immediately prior the founding of Eridu. It is reported that they were publicly active as a religious group before the Fall of the Old Capital, holding rallies in the open; however, it is unknown why they went undercover in New Eridu.
The Hollow Zero disaster seems to be tied to the Order, as someone attempted to retrieve the Sacrifice sealed inside the monument at Pioneer's Memorial Plaza the night before the Fall. On the same night Carole Arna was abducted by one of the Creator's hands while the Helios Academy was under siege by mysterious armed groups and "monsters". Moreover, their chanting can be heard inside Hollow Zero.
They were behind the attack at the Arpeggio Fault Old Laboratory two years ago, but at the last moment Alowyn betrayed the mission and instead saved the Institute researchers she got attached to, dying in the process. However, The Order managed to enter the Laboratory nonetheless, leaving a message behind.
The Order was also responsible all the major events encountered by Phaethon from the Prologue to Chapter 5. They have developed Elixir P07 to refine humans, with the direct help of the Creator, into their Ethereal perfect forms, called Sacrifices.
Its members are extremely faithful to the grand cause of The Order, and are thus willing to sacrifice themselves fully, to the point of killing themselves in the process. In fact, the people who go through "refinement" are called Sacrifices.

Members: Alowyn Mystik (formerly, deceased), Exaltist Overseer (deceased), Justin Bringer (deceased), Sarah, The Creator, The Prophet.

entries.name: The Creator
entries.content:
Is presumed to be the leader of The Order (The Exaltists), who adore them as a deity.

Not much is known about The Creator, aside from the fact that the night before the fall of Old Eridu, Carole Arna was abducted by one of their hands while the Helios Academy was under siege by mysterious armed groups and monsters, presumably members of the Order; moreover, they have recently helped the Order to test Elixir P07, which is able to successfully turn humans into powerful entities known as Sacrifices. Members of the Order regularly invoke The Creator's name in a prayer of refinement as a form of blessing.

entries.name: Null Face
entries.content:
Null_Face is the name of a group of Hackers and Proxies, infamous for trespassing in the Hollows and falsifying Carrot data, then assaulting and robbing their victims, while also corrupting Hollow data. They were also regularly targeted by the HIA for Inter-Knot crimes, however would hack into the HIA to scrub their own criminal record, with conducting electronic warfare through hacker groups being one of their specialties. Despite their infamy, they rose to being one of the top-ranked Proxy accounts on Inter-Knot, following the downfall of Phaethon.

During the Special Episode: Virtual Revenge, Null_Face were the ones responsible for trapping the members of Section 6 inside the Virtual Reality program, in order to steal the team's deep sync modeling data and kill them, however, their plan was thwarted by Tsukishiro Yanagi and Null_Face were later arrested. During the events of Phaethon's Story Chapter 5: A Storm of Falling Stars (B), it was revealed that Null_Face were employed by Sarah to specifically target Hoshimi Miyabi, whose modeling data could be used to unsheathe Tailless, something normally only possible by members of the Hoshimi Family.

entries.name: Irradiant
entries.content:
Irradiant Core — another shiny new term coined by the Institute, and one that inevitably means more reports piling up on the office desk.

Yet, the disaster itself is no exaggeration. The Irradiant Phenomenon seems to amplify the unique traits of Ether — though it also brings catastrophes of equal magnitude. Otherwise, Public Security wouldn't have requested such high-level support from HSO, especially after that incident.

The Irradiant phenomenon exacerbates Ether's instability but also makes its activity easier to influence. The Institute seized this opportunity to develop the Ether disruptor probe, a tool capable of influencing and even manipulating Ether to a limited degree. While its current applications are limited to connecting paths and altering terrain, it's already a monumental breakthrough.

The members of Section 6, though adept in both combat and strategy, lack in-depth knowledge of such advanced devices... Fortunately, with a Proxy's assistance, Chief Miyabi managed to forge a clear path for those who would follow in her footsteps.

entries.name: Ether Disruptor Probe - Alpha II
entries.content:
The Hollows wield a power to warp reality itself, a power that naturally originates from Ether.

The ability to control Ether is the ultimate dream — not just for the White Star Institute, but for all of New Eridu. Yet, for all our advancements, we've only managed to reduce Ether to a fuel akin to firewood — a remarkable energy source, sure, but one that barely scratches the surface of Ether's true potential.

The Ether Disruptor Probe, however, offers a glimpse of that potential. It can untangle the spatial knots twisted by the Hollows, restoring spatial continuity. Or, to put it in terms Soukaku would understand, it's like rerouting both ends of a forked path back to a converged one. Then again, I'm not sure that analogy would make much sense to her either...

This Irradiant Crystal was retrieved by doing that exactly: using the Ether Disruptor Probe to forge a path forward.

entries.name: Ravenlock
entries.content:
A family that used to have good standing within TOPS until they had fallen. The previous head of the family encouraged betrayal. The family worked off of rankings, and monthly assessments would be done to see who was number one. The previous head was strict; anyone who wasn't #1 was seen as a loser. Being underhanded and doing anything to get ahead was encouraged, even if it meant killing your own blood.

Hartman Ravenlock had made himself the head of the family by taking out the previous head and all other children with the exception of Hugo Vlad who he assumed to be dead.

entries.name: Girl A
entries.content:
Girl A was one of the replicas created by Twiggy.

Although deemed by Twiggy as an idiot and a defect unable to talk, Girl A was an intelligent and compassionate being, grateful to Twiggy for creating her and protective towards her fellow replicas.

Girl A was one of the replicas Twiggy created during her attempt at recreating the Silver Squad, likely the first successful clone, given her name. She assisted Twiggy in carrying out her plan, taking care of her wounds and warning her when Anby infiltrated the laboratory.[1] She tried to make Twiggy desist from bypassing the middleman to contact the client directly, to no avail.

When facing Anby's refusal to help revive the Silver Squad, Twiggy began injecting herself with the serum provided by the client, Hartman Ravenlock, but Girl A snatched the syringe from her hands and injected herself with the other half in a desperate attempt to protect Twiggy and the other replicas. While Twiggy tried to scold her for her rash action, Girl A replied, talking for the first time: she expressed her gratitude to Twiggy for creating her, and the desire to never let her be lonely. Under the effect of the serum, the two turned into the Ethereal Palicus, and were defeated by Soldier 0 - Anby and Soldier 11.

entries.name: Feline Thiren
entries.content: Feline Thirens exist in both in Thiren and Beast Thiren form, the former with only ears and tail as visible traits, while the latter is also completely covered in fur. When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior, their latent animalistic tendencies emerge; these tendencies are, however, temporary. Cats show a higher degree of friendliness towards Feline Thirens.

entries.name: Cat Thiren
entries.content: They are sensitive to catnip, which makes them purr uncontrollably. They like fish and have a few dietary restrictions, for example avoiding teamilk due to its high sugar content, noodles for the oiliness, and any wheat product for how quickly they would digest it. They enjoy basking in the sun and the scent of grass. They have strong predatory insticts, enjoying gacha boxes (for their resemblance to prey in a trap) and games like hide and seek.

entries.name: Tiger Thiren
entries.content: Tiger Thirens tend to talk at a higher volume than an average person would.

entries.name: Canine Thiren
entries.content: Canine Thiren have have excellent sense of smell and hearing.

entries.name: Wolf Thiren
entries.content: Wolf Thirens are sensitive to moon phases, especially full moon.

entries.name: Fox Thiren
entries.content: A known Fox Thiren family is the Hoshimis. They have long fox ears and, unlike other Thirens, do not seem to have a tail.

entries.name: Shark Thiren
entries.content: A Shark Thiren's tail is strong to the point they might accidentally break someone's bones by simply swaying it.

entries.name: Rat Thiren
entries.content: Rat Thirens have rodent ears, a long prehensile tail, and have the tendency to rest their arms in front of them with both elbows and wrists bent, similarly to how rats keep theirs when standing.
